chapters.title: Chapter 201: His Second Move Shocked Even the Origin Titan
paragraphs: "Do you think he can do it?" Nyx asked quietly, his eyes fixed on Luke.
Caelith observed the Origin Titan for a few moments before shifting her gaze to Luke, who was silently gathering power.
After a brief pause, she slowly shook her head.
"Unless he uses his strongest attack."
"The most he’ll achieve is leaving a few cracks on the Origin Titan’s body."
"Shattering it is impossible."
Nyx’s eyebrows shot upward.
He hadn’t expected such an evaluation.

At Luke’s absolute limit, his attacks already possessed the might of an early Golden Knight. Yet even that, in Caelith’s opinion, wasn’t enough to destroy a body made from ordinary stone refined to the limit of a Peak Bronze Titan.
Meanwhile, Myrkhal remained as indifferent as ever.
He simply watched the scene unfold in silence, making it impossible to tell whether he cared about the outcome at all... or understood something the others didn’t.
Luke ignored their conversation entirely.
His full attention rested on the colossal figure before him.
He carefully studied every part of the Origin Titan’s body while, deep within him, the Cosmic System began rotating at an increasing speed.
The gathered cosmic power flowed through his body before converging into his right hand.
Luke took one final breath.
Then he looked up at the thousand-foot giant.
"This..." A confident smile appeared on his face.
"Is my first move."
BOOM!!
With a powerful push, Luke launched himself into the air like a meteor, heading straight toward the Origin Titan’s crossed arms.
The explosion beneath his feet echoed throughout the temple.
Yet...
Not a single crack appeared on the ancient stone floor.
"Hmm?" The Origin Titan’s curiosity grew as Luke rapidly approached.
From what he could sense, Luke’s overall strength hadn’t changed.
Even after transforming and equipping his armor, the aura surrounding him was only comparable to an Early Golden Knight by human standards.
However, one thing stood out.
Luke’s right hand.
The power condensed within it was vastly different from the rest of his body.
Its strength had risen dramatically, reaching the very peak of the Early Golden Knight realm.
’An interesting technique.’ The Origin Titan thought to himself.
Before he could analyze it any further, Luke had already crossed the remaining distance.
The next instant—
BOOOOOOM!!
A deafening explosion erupted throughout the temple.
The collision sounded as though two colossal mountains had slammed into each other.
An overwhelming shockwave burst outward from the point of impact, sweeping across the enormous chamber with unstoppable force.
It surged through the temple before crashing directly into the colossal gate that had sealed itself after their arrival.
BAAAM!!
Yet the ancient gate didn’t move.
Hell, Its didn’t tremble or even bend.
The tremendous shockwave that could have flattened mountains was treated as nothing more than a passing breeze.
"First attempt..." The Origin Titan inspected the point where Luke’s fist had landed before calmly announcing the result.
"Failed."
His heavy voice echoed throughout the temple.
Nyx immediately looked toward the giant’s crossed arms.
"Only? a small crack?" His expression was filled with surprise.
Caelith, however, wasn’t shocked.
She simply shook her head.
"His attack was powerful enough. But his body wasn’t."
"Luke still lacks the physical strength to withstand the force he can unleash."
And she was right.
"Tch!" Luke clicked his tongue in annoyance.
The Origin Titan’s arm had suffered nothing more than a thin crack.
In contrast...
Luke’s own right arm had been completely destroyed.
The terrifying rebound from striking the unimaginably hard stone had pulverized it from his fist all the way to his shoulder.
Blood scattered across the ancient floor as fragments of shattered bone fell beside him.
The Origin Titan silently looked down at Luke. ’Now, What will you do?’
He waited patiently. Surprisingly, despite losing an entire arm, Luke showed neither panic nor despair.
Instead. A smile slowly appeared on his face.
The next moment, his Cosmic Heart pulsed.
Vast streams of cosmic energy surged through his body and gathered at his severed shoulder.
Before everyone’s eyes...
A new arm began to form.
First came the skeleton.
Then muscles and tendons rapidly wrapped around the bone.
Finally, fresh skin covered everything until a completely restored right arm appeared, as though it had never been destroyed.
Luke flexed his newly regenerated fingers.
His restored arm looked no different from before, without even the slightest trace of the previous injury.
"Much better." He muttered with a satisfied smile before lightly jumping back to the ground.
The Origin Titan remained motionless.
"You have two attempts remaining." His voice was as calm as ever.
Luke nodded, slowly exhaling as he steadied his breathing.
This time he wasn’t going to hold back.
"Cosmos Manifestation.
The instant those words left his mouth, his body rippled with cosmic energy.
Then, something incredible emerged.
A miniature cosmic system slowly separated from his body.
At first, it was only a few meters across.
But as it ascended into the air, it expanded at an astonishing rate.
Within moments, a magnificent cosmic system revolved above Luke’s head.
At its center floated a 200-meter barren planet, acting as the heart of the entire formation.

Orbiting around it on the second ring were ten moons, each nearly 50 meters in diameter. Every moon embodied a different fundamental element—fire, ice, water, metal, earth, wind, lightning, wood, light, and darkness.

Beyond them, on the outermost orbit, one hundred asteroids and comets, each roughly 10 meters across, revolved in perfect harmony. Some blazed with crimson flames, others were frozen in ice, while a few shimmered with flowing water or metallic brilliance.
The entire cosmic system rotated with flawless precision, resembling a living galaxy condensed into a circular celestial formation.
As it completed its first rotation. An immense gravitational force descended upon the surroundings.
The pressure was so overwhelming that an ordinary Early Golden Knight would have been pinned to the ground without resistance.
Yet inside the ancient temple...
Nothing changed.
The floor remained perfectly intact. The walls didn’t tremble.
Even the thousands of lamps continued burning steadily.
Only one thing reacted.
The Origin Titan’s stone body became slightly heavier.
That was all.
"Interesting." The Origin Titan looked up at the cosmic system with genuine curiosity.
"Your methods are no less fascinating than those of certain beings I encountered long ago."
There was even a trace of praise in his ancient voice.

During his countless years of existence, he had witnessed many extraordinary techniques. Some beings fought by controlling mountains, others wielded stars, while a few even manipulated celestial bodies as weapons.
Yet...
Luke’s technique was different.
Despite the cosmic system’s relatively small size, it generated an astonishing amount of gravity.
By all logic. It shouldn’t have been possible.
Luke remained silent. There was no need for words.
Behind him, Nyx and Caelith watched intently, hoping this attack would accomplish what the first one could not.
Then...
The cosmic system moved.
The rotating celestial bodies rose higher into the air until they hovered more than a kilometer above Luke.
One after another, they aligned into a perfect formation.
The outermost asteroids and comets formed the front.
Behind them came the ten elemental moons.
And at the very end...
The barren planet silently took its place.

chapters.title: Chapter 202: Only One Attempt Remains
paragraphs: Fortunately, the temple’s interior was vast.
Had the ceiling been any lower, Luke wouldn’t have been able to use this technique at all.
The Origin Titan tilted his shattered face, observing the strange arrangement with growing curiosity.
What kind of attack is he planning?
But in the very next instant. His curiosity turned into surprise.
He sensed something impossible.
Something that should never had appeared from a Luke at this level.
Luke’s entire body suddenly lit up.

Veins filled with brilliant cosmic energy spread beneath his skin, shining like rivers of stars. At the same time, tiny cracks appeared across his body, only to heal almost instantly before new ones formed again.
The violent cycle of destruction and regeneration continued without pause.
However, the Origin Titan barely paid attention to those injuries.
His focus was locked on Luke’s chest.
More precisely...
His heart.
It radiated an astonishing amount of cosmic energy.
The quantity alone surpassed what even a Peak Golden Knight should have been capable of producing.
But even more unbelievable was its quality.
The energy flowing through Luke’s body wasn’t ordinary Aether.
It was Cosmic Aether.
A power so pure that it continuously healed Luke’s body while simultaneously constructing something deep within him.
Another cosmic system...
The Origin Titan immediately understood what was happening.
And he was right.
"Finally." Luke exhaled painfully.
"...Done."
Even with his Titan physique dulling most of the pain, repeatedly tearing apart and reconstructing his own body was anything but pleasant.
Fortunately, his efforts had succeeded.
A second Cosmic System had formed within him.
Without wasting a second, Luke synchronized it with the first.
This time, however, he distributed its power throughout his body.
All ten moons flowed into his right arm, reinforcing it so it could withstand the unimaginable gravitational force he was about to unleash.
The hundred asteroids and comets strengthened both of his legs, preventing them from collapsing the instant he moved.
Finally...
The central planet settled within his chest, stabilizing his body and allowing him to function normally.
Without that support. He wouldn’t have been able to move even a single shoulder against the weight of gravity.
Luke slowly raised his right hand.
His galactic eyes locked onto the Origin Titan.
Then, in a calm voice. He uttered the name of his technique.
"Cosmic Lock."
The next instant, an even more terrifying gravitational force descended. Unlike before, all of it was compressed into a single point directly above the thousand-foot stone giant.
CRRRRK...
For the first time, the Origin Titan’s body groaned under the pressure. Thin cracks spread across several of his stone joints, causing Luke’s eyes to light up with hope.
’So there is a limit.’
This move could actually damage the Origin Titan’s body. Perhaps... it could even shatter it.
The Origin Titan, meanwhile, looked genuinely surprised.
Another technique.

Luke had displayed one unbelievable method after another. Then the giant remembered something. This wasn’t merely Luke’s talent. Three Firstborn Titans, each with billions of years of experience, resided within him. It was only natural that he had inherited extraordinary techniques from them.
Down below, Luke bent his knees before pouring the strength of all one hundred asteroids into his legs.
KABOOOOOM!!
The ground exploded beneath him as a deafening sonic boom echoed through the temple. Luke shot forward like a beam of light, instantly appearing before the Origin Titan’s crossed arms.
"Cosmic... PUNCH!"

The moment he roared, the compressed gravitational force collapsed into his right fist. An unimaginable weight surged through his arm, making his entire body feel as though it would collapse under its own power.

Bones creaked, muscles tore apart, and fresh cracks spread across his Titan body. If he hadn’t redirected the gravitational pressure throughout the surrounding kilometer of space, the force would have blown his body apart before the punch could even land.
Even then, he couldn’t control it perfectly. His body simply wasn’t strong enough yet, and his mastery over this terrifying gravity was still incomplete.
Then it happened.
Luke’s punch blurred as it shot forward. Cosmic energy wrapped tightly around his fist, leaving behind a dazzling trail of golden-purple starlight that stretched through the air.
The next instant...
It collided with the Origin Titan’s crossed arms.
THOOOOM!! KRRRAAAK!! BOOOOOM!!
The impact shook the entire temple.

The Origin Titan’s crossed arms exploded apart under the overwhelming force, countless stone fragments the size of boulders flying in every direction. A far more violent shockwave erupted from the collision, surging across the enormous chamber with enough force to crush an ordinary Half-Golden Knight.
Yet the ancient temple remained completely unaffected.

The walls didn’t crack. The ceiling didn’t tremble. Even the countless blue runes continued shining steadily, without the slightest flicker. It was as though the temple had only been built to withstand the true power of the Origin Titan—not Luke’s comparatively insignificant strength.
The shockwave quickly reached Nyx and Caelith.
Nyx didn’t even move. The violent force disappeared the moment it touched his body, swallowed effortlessly by the Void as though it had never existed.

Caelith’s reaction was equally unbelievable. The flames surrounding her suddenly blazed brighter, forcing the incoming shockwave to split apart before flowing harmlessly around her body, leaving her standing calmly between the two currents of destruction.
Myrkhal, however, did absolutely nothing.
The shockwave struck him head-on.

Yet instead of being blown away, only gentle ripples spread across his pure white body, like a pebble dropped into a tranquil lake. A moment later, the ripples disappeared, leaving him completely unharmed and unmoved.
All three Titans had effortlessly withstood a shockwave carrying Half-Golden Knight-level destructive power.

The most astonishing part was that none of them possessed their original bodies. Their temporary elemental forms were only comparable to an Early Bronze Knight, the same realm as Luke, and they weren’t receiving any enhancement from their true Titan physiques.
Nyx’s survival could be explained by his absolute mastery over the Void.
Caelith’s by her unparalleled control over celestial flames.
But Myrkhal...
No one knew.
Not even reality itself seemed capable of explaining what principle protected the Faceless Titan.
"Second attempt... failed." The Origin Titan’s deep voice echoed through the temple.
A cloud of stone dust slowly settled, revealing the result of Luke’s attack.
Both of the Origin Titan’s crossed arms had been completely shattered, and a massive crack extended across his stone chest.
But...
That was all.
Luke stood there in silence.
’Even an attack at the peak of the Mid-Golden Knight realm... one that briefly touched Late Golden Knight power... wasn’t enough to destroy his body?’
The realization left him speechless.
Throughout the trial, the Origin Titan had merely been using the physical template of the second strongest pure Titan species at the Peak Bronze realm.
He hadn’t attacked even once.
’If he actually fought back...’
Luke looked up at the thousand-foot giant.
’Wouldn’t an entire city be wiped off the map?’
A Titan of that size alone was a walking catastrophe. Even without techniques or authorities, every movement carried enough force to flatten a city.
’If the real Origin Titan had appeared here. I’m not even sure I could survive a single exchange.’
A trace of disappointment flashed across Luke’s face.
He possessed the powers of three Firstborn Titans, yet even that wasn’t enough to overcome the body of one of the highest Titan species.

chapters.title: Chapter 203: Nyx Revealed His True Forbidden Power
paragraphs: At least not yet.
"One attempt remains," the Origin Titan said calmly, paying no attention to Luke’s expression.
To him, this outcome was perfectly normal.
Strength had never been equal among species.
Some races were born standing near the summit, while others had to spend hundreds of thousands of years climbing toward it.
However, the gap wasn’t absolute.

As one’s cultivation increased, the natural advantages of superior bloodlines gradually diminished. Lower species could create techniques, authorities, and combat methods capable of threatening even those born at the top.
But that only became possible at higher realms.
Luke was still at the very beginning of his path.
He had yet to learn that truth.
"Sigh..." Luke let out a long breath before turning around and walking toward the exit. Nyx, Caelith, and Myrkhal also quietly followed behind him.
Seeing this, the Origin Titan frowned in confusion.
’Is he giving up?’
That didn’t feel right.
’Did I misjudge him? Was the miracle I sensed merely my imagination?’
Unable to hold back his curiosity, he finally asked, "Are you giving up, Hero of Light?"
Luke stopped. By now, he had already put nearly a kilometer between himself and the giant. Slowly turning around, he looked at the Origin Titan with a puzzled expression.
"When did I say I was giving up?"
He shook his head before explaining, "The third move I’m about to use is too dangerous, even for me. So I was only making some distance."
The Origin Titan narrowed what remained of his shattered face in curiosity, but before he could ask anything else, Luke slowly raised his left hand.
"Cosmos Manifestation."
BOOM!

Luke’s Cosmic Heart throbbed violently as brilliant cosmic veins spread across his body again. An enormous amount of Cosmic Aether erupted from his chest, not to create another Cosmic System inside him, but to manifest a second one outside his body.
A new cosmic system gradually appeared beside the first, revolving with the same flawless rhythm.
The instant it fully formed, Luke’s expression twisted in pain.
Creating it wasn’t difficult.
Controlling two manifested Cosmic Systems simultaneously was.
It felt as though he were trying to restrain two enormous beasts with nothing but invisible chains. Every moment they pulled in different directions, constantly trying to break free from his control.
Luke had no choice but to pour vast amounts of Cosmic Aether into those invisible bindings, strengthening them while simultaneously suppressing the terrifying gravity leaking from both systems.
Even then, they remained on the verge of escaping his control.
Sweat trickled down Luke’s forehead as fresh cracks spread across his Titan body before rapidly healing again.
"Luke, concentrate," Caelith reminded him calmly from the side.
Luke didn’t reply.

Every ounce of his concentration was devoted to controlling the two Cosmic Systems. He didn’t even nod at Caelith’s reminder. At this moment, a single lapse in focus could cause everything to spiral out of control.

This wasn’t something he had mastered overnight. During his time inside the Time Chamber, while his clone handled the affairs outside, Luke had spent days practicing this technique. Even then, he had only grasped its fundamentals.
There was a reason he had gone to such lengths.

Although the self-destruction of a single Cosmic System had already reached the threshold of Peak Golden Knight power, Luke knew that wasn’t its true limit. In reality, it still fell just short of that realm.
That was why...
He intended to detonate two Cosmic Systems at once.
The thought alone sent goosebumps across his body.
The Origin Titan quietly observed the second celestial system taking shape above the battlefield.

The first, which had previously aligned itself into an attack formation, had already returned to its smooth circular rotation. Now the second revolved beside it, creating a breathtaking yet terrifying sight.
For the first time since Luke entered the temple, the Origin Titan let out a quiet sigh.
It seems... my time has come.
Earlier, he had dismissed those celestial bodies as nothing more than oversized rocks infused with elemental energy. But now that he observed them more carefully, he realized he had been mistaken.
Every moon...
Even the barren planet...
Possessed a living core.
They weren’t ordinary constructs. They were incomplete celestial bodies.
Looking at Luke’s battered figure and the two revolving Cosmic Systems above him, the Origin Titan understood his intention.
With both of his stone arms shattered and cracks covering his body, he silently awaited the attack that was about to decide the trial.
"AAAHHHHH!"
Veins bulged across Luke’s body as cracks spread from his legs to his chest, almost reaching his face.
"COME DOWN!"
He slammed both hands downward.
DOOOOOOM!!!
The two Cosmic Systems crashed into the Origin Titan’s colossal body before self-destructing at the same instant.

A catastrophic explosion erupted, instantly swallowing the thousand-foot giant in blinding cosmic light. Moons, asteroids, and the two barren planets exploded together, unleashing a destructive force powerful enough to flatten an entire small city.
Luke’s expression changed.
’The shockwave...!’
Before he could react, the expanding explosion was already racing toward them at the speed of sound.
Nyx silently stepped forward and stood before everyone. Without taking his eyes off the incoming explosion, he glanced at Luke and smiled faintly.
"Luke, this may be the only chance I get to show you a glimpse of my true power."
Luke frowned in confusion.
’True power? But we’re both only Early Bronze...’
Even though he didn’t say those words aloud, Nyx understood his expression immediately.
Smiling, he explained, "Luke, not every type of power is measured by raw strength. There are powers that exist beyond cultivation itself."
Caelith silently nodded in agreement, while Myrkhal remained as calm as ever, quietly watching the city-ending explosion rush toward them as if it had nothing to do with him.
"I will show you the power for which I am known as the Warden of the Void Path." Nyx calmly spoke before turning to face the incoming explosion.
Luke’s eyes lit up with anticipation.
The power of a Warden...
The next moment, darkness spread from beneath Nyx’s feet.
Not ordinary darkness.
Void.
It expanded silently, swallowing everything before it without making the slightest sound.
"There are Wardens," Nyx continued, his calm voice echoing through the expanding Void, "whose titles were given by the Cosmos, allowing them to wield the authority of their Path."
He paused briefly before adding,
"And then... there are a handful of forbidden existences who no longer need those titles."
Luke frowned in confusion, while the Origin Titan, whose stone body was still crumbling under the ongoing explosion, silently watched the expanding Void.
"Remember this, Luke," Nyx said. "There comes a stage of mastery where even a Warden’s title becomes as insignificant as an ant."
His eyes remained fixed on the approaching explosion.
"Because I have already reached the extreme of the Void Path." His quiet words traveled effortlessly through the endless darkness.
Hearing those words, the Origin Titan fell silent.
For the first time...
A trace of jealousy appeared in his eyes.
Although he possessed the power of the Void, he had never been acknowledged as its Warden.
Then Nyx spoke again.
"I AM NOT THE WARDEN OF THE VOID PATH BECAUSE THE COSMOS CHOSE ME!"
His voice shook the very Void itself.
"I AM THE WARDEN OF THE VOID PATH..."
"BECAUSE I EARNED IT!"
Luke’s pupils contracted.

chapters.title: Chapter 204: The Origin Titan’s Regret
paragraphs: Until now, he had believed Nyx was powerful because he possessed the title of Warden.
But he finally understood the truth.
It wasn’t the title that made Nyx extraordinary.
The title existed because Nyx himself had reached the pinnacle of the Void Path.
The Cosmos hadn’t bestowed power upon him.
It had merely acknowledged what he had already become.
Perhaps...
That was why, even in this universe where Nyx no longer possessed his Warden’s authority, he could still command the Void with such ease.
His understanding alone was enough.
As Nyx spoke, the approaching explosion gradually slowed.
No it wasn’t slowing. It was disappearing.
The expanding Void swallowed every trace of the explosion, dragging it into a place where even light, sound, and destruction themselves could no longer exist.
Then, in a single instant. The spreading Void engulfed the entire temple.

Even the runes flickering on the temples were sucked into the void, and the whole temple, which could resist the fragment of the Origin Titan for all these years, couldn’t even survive the being who was even held high above a warden.
The Origin Titan silently watched everything unfold. As the Void swallowed the explosion, he didn’t resist. Instead, his thoughts drifted back to the greatest regret of his life.
He had possessed every element, every authority, and nearly every form of power. Yet, because he had been born with everything, he had never truly mastered a single Path to its absolute extreme.

There had never been a need. No one in his universe could stand against him, and whenever a battle turned unfavorable, he would simply unleash his Origin Ultimate, ending the fight before anyone could push him further.
That overwhelming dominance was what had earned him the title of the Origin Titan.
Until... they appeared.

Somehow, they found a way to counter every technique he possessed. Even then, his Origin Ultimate still managed to take all of them down, making him believe victory was his. But then, the real being arrived.
For the first time in his life, his strongest technique failed.

It was only in that final battle that he realized his greatest weakness. If he had devoted himself to mastering even a single Path... if he had earned a Warden’s recognition through his own understanding instead of relying solely on overwhelming power... perhaps the outcome would have been different.
But regrets could never rewrite the past.
With that final thought, the endless Void engulfed him, and the last trace of the Origin Titan’s consciousness quietly disappeared from the stone body forever.
While the Void dissolved everything within the temple, the space surrounding them remained untouched, protected by Nyx’s control.
Caelith turned toward Luke with a gentle smile.
"The same goes for me. I don’t know when I’ll be able to manifest like this again."

She could already feel Valtharion’s will turning toward them. With the disappearance of the ancient temple, the world’s suppression would soon descend once more, forcing them back into their dormant state.
"So... let me leave you with a small gift."

As she raised her hand, elemental particles gathered above her palm. Fire, water, wind, earth, lightning, light, darkness, and many more intertwined in perfect harmony before rapidly compressing into the shape of a sword.

The blade was golden, radiating a soft divine glow. At first glance, it resembled a sword forged from pure light, yet the more Luke looked at it, the more he felt that it wasn’t light at all. It was something far deeper... something he couldn’t understand with his current realm.
"Here." Caelith held the sword out toward him with a warm smile.
Luke silently accepted it. His heart felt unusually heavy.
He knew this would likely be the last time he met them face to face. After today, only their consciousness would remain within him.
He gave the sword a gentle swing. Its balance was perfect, as though it had been forged specifically for him. However, instead of inspecting it further, he lifted his head and looked toward Myrkhal.
The Faceless Titan was already looking back at him.
Luke couldn’t help but wonder if Myrkhal had prepared a farewell gift as well.
As if reading his thoughts, Myrkhal spoke in his usual calm voice. though it was reality who soike in calm voice.
"I have unlocked a new transformation for you."
He paused briefly before adding,
"Though... it isn’t a Titan."
Having said that, he simply turned around, no longer paying attention to Luke’s bewildered expression.
’A transformation? that isn’t a Titan?’ Luke frowned.
Then he remembered, that the description of the Faceless Titan had never stated that Myrkhal could only store the forms of Titans.
Then Luke shifted his attention to the front.

The Origin Titan had completely disappeared. In his place floated only a thumb-sized crimson fragment, quietly suspended in the air. It emitted an ancient glow, and every time a trace of its energy leaked out, the surrounding Void rippled as though unable to bear its presence.
Luke narrowed his eyes.
’This energy... It’s on an even higher level than my Cosmic Aether.’
Without saying anything, Nyx gently brought the fragment over and placed it in front of Luke.
"Here."

Giving him one final smile, Nyx’s body dissolved into particles of darkness. Caelith followed soon after, her figure fading into streams of brilliant light, while Myrkhal simply disappeared without another word.
"Hmm..." Luke quietly hummed as he looked at the place where they had been standing. The temple suddenly felt much emptier.
Well someone was there.
[Luke, they have fallen into a deep sleep.]
Luke frowned. "A deep sleep? Why? Is it the same as last time?"

[No. This time is different.] The system replied. [They materialized outside your body and even used powers that are forbidden within Valtharion. As a result, Valtharion’s suppression intensified, forcing them into a much deeper sleep.]
Luke’s expression gradually darkened.
If merely manifesting outside and using their true powers caused Valtharion to suppress even Nyx, Caelith, and Myrkhal...
Didn’t that mean that one day, when he became strong enough to wield those forbidden powers.
Luke asked in a low voice, "Will Valtharion suppress me as well?"
[Affirmative.]
The system’s straightforward answer made Luke’s expression darken even further.
Fortunately, the system words continued before he could sink too deeply into those thoughts.
[That is a problem for a very distant future. At your current level, you don’t need to worry about Valtharion’s suppression.]

chapters.title: Chapter 205: The Paragon’s Judgment - SSS Rank
paragraphs: Luke let out a helpless sigh and nodded. Since there was nothing he could do about it now, he decided to ask another question.
"Then when will Nyx, Caelith, and Myrkhal wake up?"
[No idea for now.]
[Though when your new Titan will awaken, that one will awake.]
Luke’s expression fell again, but he could only accept it. Just then, however, he noticed the crimson Origin Fragment in his hand suddenly dissolve into particles before disappearing completely.
"What happened?" Before he could panic, the system answered.
[Luke, there is no need to panic. Your SSS-rank Origin Skill has already absorbed it.]
"WHAT?!"
Luke shouted in disbelief.
All this time, he had assumed that simply completing the quest by finding the Origin Fragment would evolve his skill, allowing him to obtain another Origin ability.
[Luke... don’t be so greedy.]
Luke’s mouth twitched before he silently listened.
[The Origin Titan’s arrogance was one of the reasons for his downfall.]
[Think about it. Do you believe the beings capable of defeating someone like him would simply leave all of his fragments behind as rewards for others?]
Luke froze for a moment before slowly nodding.
That... actually made perfect sense.
If he were the one looting an enemy’s territory...
Ahem.
If he were the one liberating another noble house. He would loot everything valuable first.
Seeing Luke was realizing, the system continued.
[Even though the Origin Titan fragment’s consciousness couldn’t be found, I can see that he was being corrupted.]
"What?!" Luke immediately looked at the hand that had been holding the fragment, his expression turning worried.
’Please don’t tell me it works like those corruption novels...’
He hurriedly inspected his palm from every angle, afraid that some strange corruption had already begun spreading through his body.
Fortunately nothing had happened.
[Which is why I’m certain some of the remaining fragments have already been completely corrupted, while others have likely fallen into their hands.]
[So don’t expect the next trial to be as straightforward. It may be far more dangerous... or simply far stranger. Though that’s a problem for another day.]
Luke slowly nodded. "Thanks for the warning."
Even so, he couldn’t help feeling a little disappointed that he hadn’t received a brand-new Origin ability.
The system’s exasperated face immediately appeared.
[Luke, I’ve already told you many times.]
[Everything produced by the System is the finest of its level.]
[Your evolved Origin Skill will naturally grant you a new ability.]
Luke’s eyes instantly brightened.
"You’re right, System." He nodded seriously. "Who cares about some corrupted Origin ability anyway? Mine is definitely better."
The system responded with a thoroughly unimpressed expression before a new screen appeared before Luke.
[SSS-Rank Origin Skill: TITAN KNIGHT, EVOLVING...]
A few moments later—
[Evolution Complete.]
[SSS+ Rank Origin Skill: NEXUS TITAN]
"Wow..." Luke couldn’t hide his excitement.
He had expected the skill to evolve into another SSS-rank ability at most. Instead, its rank had increased altogether.
That outcome alone was more than enough to make him forget about the so-called Origin ability.
Even the new name sounded far cooler.
A few moments later, Luke finally calmed down and looked around. Since Nyx’s Void had disappeared along with the ancient temple, rays of sunlight now poured down from the opening above.
"Hmm... it’s morning already." Luke sighed before suddenly remembering something.
’Please don’t let Aurielle be awake yet...’
Although she occasionally told him to sleep outside whenever she was annoyed with him, but if she woke up and found him missing from the bed without any explanation.
Then he knew he would be in deep trouble.
"Oh, Goddess of Luck," Luke clasped his hands together dramatically, "please keep blessing me with your luck like always."
The System fell silent for a moment before displaying a speechless expression.
Which brought a speechless look from the system, like he wanted to spread the word that the hero of the Goddess of Light had an affair with the Goddess of Luck.
After finishing his ridiculous prayer, Luke looked around once more.

The entire underground space had changed beyond recognition. It now stretched nearly fifty kilometers across, with a height of almost ten kilometers, as though an enormous piece of the land had simply vanished.
"What a huge place." Another exclamation escaped his lips.
"I’ll check my rewards on the way."
With that, he activated his first form of his second Titan.
Then using winged titan, he unfolded vast wings from his back, and with a powerful flap, he soared toward the opening above.

From the sky, the destruction looked even more unbelievable. The gigantic crater extended deep into the Stormhowl Mountains, giving the impression that an enormous portion of the land had simply been devoured.
"Nyx’s Void... was really something," Luke muttered to himself as he looked down at the golden sword Caelith had given him.
He had been holding it the entire time.
"System, can I inspect this?" he asked.

Normally, the System couldn’t inspect items unrelated to it. However, since the sword had been created by Caelith, who was connected to both him and, in a way, the System itself, perhaps it would be an exception.
The next moment, instead of receiving a reply, a familiar blue screen appeared before him.
[Paragon’s Judgment]
Rank: SSS
Type: Growth Artifact (Weapon)
Current Output: G-Rank
Maximum Output: Transcendent
Status: Sealed (99.99%)
Description:
"A transcendent sword that judges all elemental laws."
"Unlike ordinary weapons, Paragon’s Judgment possesses no fixed affinity. Instead, it can manifest any elemental attribute, allowing its wielder to adapt to nearly any opponent."
"However, the sword’s true authority remains sealed. Its current output is limited to G-Rank, restricting both the quality and quantity of elemental manifestations."
[Artifact Traits]
■ Growth-Type Artifact
• The sword evolves alongside its wielder.
• Higher cultivation unlocks greater output and releases additional seals.
■ Elemental Manifestation
• Can manifest elemental energy along the blade.
• The wielder does not require natural affinity to utilize an element.
• If the wielder possesses natural affinity toward an element, manifestation becomes significantly easier and consumes less energy.
• Elemental manifestations are limited by the sword’s current output.
■ Elemental Judgment (Passive)
• The sword instinctively analyzes the target’s elemental nature.
• It can manifest the most effective counter element against the opponent.
• Higher-ranked elemental authorities require greater output and a stronger wielder.
■ Affinity Synchronization
• Compatible elemental affinities greatly improve manifestation speed, stability, and power.
• Incompatible affinities consume more energy but remain usable.

Fortunately nothing had happened.
[Which is why I’m certain some of the remaining fragments have already been completely corrupted, while others have likely fallen into their hands.]
[So don’t expect the next trial to be as straightforward.
It may be far more dangerous... or simply far stranger.
Though that’s a problem for another day.]
Luke slowly nodded.
"Thanks for the warning."
Even so, he couldn’t help feeling a little disappointed that he hadn’t received a brand-new Origin ability.
The system’s exasperated face immediately appeared.
[Luke, I’ve already told you many times.]
[Everything produced by the System is the finest of its level.]
[Your evolved Origin Skill will naturally grant you a new ability.]
Luke’s eyes instantly brightened.
"You’re right, System." He nodded seriously.
"Who cares about some corrupted Origin ability anyway?
Mine is definitely better."
The system responded with a thoroughly unimpressed expression before a new screen appeared before Luke.
[SSS-Rank Origin Skill: TITAN KNIGHT, EVOLVING...]
A few moments later—
[Evolution Complete.]
[SSS+ Rank Origin Skill: NEXUS TITAN]
"Wow..." Luke couldn’t hide his excitement.
He had expected the skill to evolve into another SSS-rank ability at most.
Instead, its rank had increased altogether.
That outcome alone was more than enough to make him forget about the so-called Origin ability.
Even the new name sounded far cooler.
A few moments later, Luke finally calmed down and looked around.
Since Nyx’s Void had disappeared along with the ancient temple, rays of sunlight now poured down from the opening above.
"Hmm... it’s morning already." Luke sighed before suddenly remembering something.
’Please don’t let Aurielle be awake yet...’
Although she occasionally told him to sleep outside whenever she was annoyed with him, but if she woke up and found him missing from the bed without any explanation.
Then he knew he would be in deep trouble.
"Oh, Goddess of Luck," Luke clasped his hands together dramatically, "please keep blessing me with your luck like always."
The System fell silent for a moment before displaying a speechless expression.
Which brought a speechless look from the system, like he wanted to spread the word that the hero of the Goddess of Light had an affair with the Goddess of Luck.
After finishing his ridiculous prayer, Luke looked around once more.
The entire underground space had changed beyond recognition.
It now stretched nearly fifty kilometers across, with a height of almost ten kilometers, as though an enormous piece of the land had simply vanished.
"What a huge place." Another exclamation escaped his lips.
"I’ll check my rewards on the way."
With that, he activated his first form of his second Titan.
Then using winged titan, he unfolded vast wings from his back, and with a powerful flap, he soared toward the opening above.
From the sky, the destruction looked even more unbelievable.
The gigantic crater extended deep into the Stormhowl Mountains, giving the impression that an enormous portion of the land had simply been devoured.
"Nyx’s Void... was really something," Luke muttered to himself as he looked down at the golden sword Caelith had given him.
He had been holding it the entire time.
"System, can I inspect this?" he asked.
Normally, the System couldn’t inspect items unrelated to it.
However, since the sword had been created by Caelith, who was connected to both him and, in a way, the System itself, perhaps it would be an exception.
The next moment, instead of receiving a reply, a familiar blue screen appeared before him.
[Paragon’s Judgment]
Rank: SSS
Type: Growth Artifact (Weapon)
Current Output: G-Rank
Maximum Output: Transcendent
Status: Sealed (99.99%)
Description:
"A transcendent sword that judges all elemental laws."
"Unlike ordinary weapons, Paragon’s Judgment possesses no fixed affinity.
Instead, it can manifest any elemental attribute, allowing its wielder to adapt to nearly any opponent."
"However, the sword’s true authority remains sealed.
Its current output is limited to G-Rank, restricting both the quality and quantity of elemental manifestations."
[Artifact Traits]
■ Growth-Type Artifact
• The sword evolves alongside its wielder.
• Higher cultivation unlocks greater output and releases additional seals.
■ Elemental Manifestation
• Can manifest elemental energy along the blade.
• The wielder does not require natural affinity to utilize an element.
• If the wielder possesses natural affinity toward an element, manifestation becomes significantly easier and consumes less energy.
• Elemental manifestations are limited by the sword’s current output.
■ Elemental Judgment (Passive)
• The sword instinctively analyzes the target’s elemental nature.
• It can manifest the most effective counter element against the opponent.
• Higher-ranked elemental authorities require greater output and a stronger wielder.
■ Affinity Synchronization
• Compatible elemental affinities greatly improve manifestation speed, stability, and power.
• Incompatible affinities consume more energy but remain usable.
So as for thanksgiving, everyone can now access 10 Chapters of privilege for just 1 coin.
The_Book_Master, Daoist3B08dw, Almighty_Ken, Plagued_Reader and everyone whose name I have not mentioned.
-EternalVoidRuler.

chapters.title: Chapter 206: The SSS+ Evolution - Nexus Titan
paragraphs: [Artifact Growth]
■ Judgment Evolution (Passive)
"Paragon’s Judgment remembers every flawless verdict."
"Each time the sword successfully overcomes an opponent by manifesting the perfect counter element, it records that judgment."
"Accumulated judgments gradually release the blade’s seals, unlocking stronger elemental authorities and restoring its original Transcendent power."
[Current Limitations]
Current Output: G-Rank
• Only basic elemental manifestations are available.
• Rare, advanced, and conceptual elements remain sealed.
• The sword’s maximum output cannot exceed its wielder’s capacity.
• Forcibly releasing higher-ranked elements may result in severe backlash or complete manifestation failure.
"My first SSS-rank artifact." Luke muttered excitedly.
Of course, he wasn’t counting Voidfang. That sword came together with Valzareth and didn’t even have a rank displayed by the System.
However, the moment his eyes landed on the [Sealed] status, most of his excitement vanished.
"Looks like I can’t use its full power at my current realm. That’s why Caelith sealed it." As soon as he finished speaking, the System responded.
[Of course.]
[That is a Demigod-rank weapon.]
[How could a mere Bronze Knight possibly wield its true power?]
[Had Caelith not sealed it herself, you wouldn’t even be capable of lifting, let alone using, that sword.]
Luke nodded in understanding. He had already guessed as much.
"So... a Transcendent is equivalent to the Demigod rank."
He fell into thought.
According to the System, the realms above Diamond Knight were King, Saint, and finally Transcendent.

Saints already stood among the absolute powerhouses of Valtharion, while Transcendents had stepped into the realm of Demigods. Such beings rarely concerned themselves with the affairs of mortals, only interfering when events threatened the world itself or their interest.
Finishing those thoughts, Luke lowered his gaze and continued reading the weapon’s description.
The next line immediately caught his attention.
"No fixed affinity?"
His eyebrows rose in surprise.
This was great for him, at least now, since his human form didn’t have any element affinity.
Luke continued reading the artifact’s traits, and with every line, his eyes shone brighter. Each ability seemed more extraordinary than the last.
However, when his gaze stopped at Element Synchronization, he let out a helpless sigh.

"Looks like elemental affinity isn’t required for its basic functions," he muttered under his breath. "But if I want to unleash its true power, I’ll have to synchronize with the corresponding element."
This time, the System remained silent.
Luke then shifted his attention to the artifact’s growth requirements.
"I have to counter another element..."
He rubbed his chin thoughtfully.
On paper, the condition sounded simple. In reality, however, he had no idea how much mastery over an element was required before the sword would acknowledge it.
"Well... whatever."
Shaking his head, he dismissed the thought. He would unlock those elements sooner or later anyway.
Looking at the golden blade in his hand, a faint smile appeared on his face.
"From today onward. I’ll call you Paragon."
Satisfied with the name, Luke stored the sword before shifting his attention to the reward he had been waiting for the most.
His evolved SSS+ Origin Skill.
"Nexus Titan."
[Nexus Titan]
Rank: SSS+
Type: Origin Skill
Classification: Origin Authority
Status: Awakened
Description:
*"The Origin Skill born from absolute harmony."*

*"Long before many realities came into existence, there existed supreme beings known as the Nexus Titans. Unlike ordinary Titans, they wielded numerous Authorities and abilities simultaneously, ruling over entire realities through absolute mastery."*
*"To prevent their numerous Authorities from conflicting, they devised an Origin Method known as Titan Harmony—a supreme harmony that united every power into a single, flawless system."*

*"Those who inherit the authority of the Nexus Titan gain access to Titan Harmony, allowing every bound Titan to resonate as one. From that moment onward, they no longer exist as isolated powers, but as a unified Origin System."*
[Origin Authority]
■ Titan Harmony (Passive)
• Establishes perfect harmony between all bound Titans and Titan Armaments.
• Removes the synchronization restriction imposed by Titan Realm.
• Compatible blessings, authorities, and passive effects are automatically shared.
• Every newly awakened Titan or Titan Armament is immediately integrated into the Nexus.
[Unified Authority]
"The distinction between Titans no longer exists."
Effects:
• Every Titan Form can utilize the abilities, skills, and authorities of every Harmonized Titan.
• Titan Armament abilities remain accessible regardless of the current transformation.
• Form switching is no longer required to access another Titan’s abilities.
• Each Titan retains its own physical traits while inheriting the complete Harmonized Authority.
[Harmonized Blessings]
Effects:
• 5× Titan Stat Multiplier is shared across every Harmonized Titan Form.
• 3× Titan Armament Stat Multiplier is shared across every Harmonized Titan Form.
• Future stat blessings obtained from Titans or Titan Armaments are automatically synchronized.
[Harmony Synchronization]
Current Synchronization : 100%
Bound Titans
• Nyx, The Void Titan
• Myrkhal, The Faceless Titan
• Caelith, The Cosmic Heart Titan.
Bound Titan Armaments
• Valzareth Armor
• Nullex
• Elythos
[Sealed Authority]
■■ Titan Convergence
Status : Locked
Description:
"Perfect Harmony allows every Harmonized Titan to converge into a single Origin Form."
Unlock Requirement: ???
[Origin Law]
"They are no longer many."
"They are one."
"Holy sh*t!" Luke’s eyes widened in disbelief.
"System... tell me this is real!" He hurriedly asked, unable to believe what he was seeing.
[Yup.]
[Now praise me.]
Hearing that, Luke didn’t hesitate in the slightest.
"I knew it! The System is the best. Even though you’re a little horny sometimes, you’re still an amazing System."
The System’s unimpressed face immediately appeared. It had been quite pleased with Luke’s praise...
Until he added the second half.
Meanwhile, Luke remained completely oblivious to the System’s annoyance.
His attention was entirely focused on the evolved skill before him.
Ever since obtaining new Titan transformations, one regret had always lingered in his mind.

Every time he unlocked a stronger Titan, the massive stat amplification provided by his previous transformations gradually became less relevant. Although their abilities remained invaluable, their direct combat performance inevitably declined as stronger forms replaced them.
But.
It looked like that problem had finally been solved.
"The most absurd part." Luke’s grin widened.
"I can use every Titan ability regardless of which transformation I’m in."
Just imagining the possibilities made his heart race.
If his enemies ever saw that.
"Sir, there’s no point in fighting anymore."
"Please just kill us already."
"HAHAHAHA!"
Luke burst into laughter, completely immersed in his own fantasy.
Just imagine it.
He could transform into Voltrax, continuously summon lightning moons and asteroids from the Cosmic Heart Titan’s abilities, then absorb all that lightning to strengthen himself even further.
Or combine Void, Cosmic, and Lightning abilities in a single battle.

chapters.title: Chapter 207: The Power of Every Titan In One
paragraphs: The possibilities were practically endless.
Suddenly, his laughter stopped.
"Hmm..." Luke rubbed his chin thoughtfully.
"Wait a second-"
"The Cosmic System is an ability that requires Cosmic Energy to create."
"With Titan Harmony, I could convert my Aether into Cosmic energy to create them in another form, but-"
Luke’s thoughts immediately returned to the biggest issue he had discovered during the previous battle.
The *Cosmic System*.
More specifically, its terrifying Aether consumption.
The celestial bodies—the moons, asteroids, and even the miniature planet—required an absurd amount of Aether to summon and maintain.
Currently, only his *Cosmic Heart* could generate enough to sustain them.
"So the real bottleneck isn’t the abilities... it’s the Aether supply."
His brows gradually furrowed. If he couldn’t solve that problem, then no matter how powerful the Cosmic System became, he would never be able to unleash its true potential.
His thoughts naturally drifted toward the Nexus Titan.
"But... the Nexus Titan can’t combine different Titan body parts."
He paused mid-sentence. "No, wait a second!"
Luke’s eyes suddenly widened.
Since he could freely use every Titan’s abilities regardless of his current form...
Didn’t that also mean he could use *Myrkhal’s Form Assimilation*?
His heartbeat quickened.
Form Assimilation allowed him to borrow specific characteristics and even specific body parts from another Titan—wings, horns, arms, and even certain internal organs.
"So, what if I assimilate the *Cosmic Heart* while remaining in another Titan form?" The thought alone made his breathing grow heavier.
If it worked, his greatest weakness might disappear completely.
But the excitement quickly cooled.
"No." Luke frowned.
"Myrkhal’s abilities only worked on Titans below the Pure Titan lineage."
That was what Nyx had told him.
So he had no idea whether *Form Assimilation* would even work on a Pure Titan.
After all.
Borrowing the body part of a Pure Titan was no different from granting a mortal a fragment of a god’s body.
It simply didn’t make sense.
Yet.
The *Nexus Titans* had achieved exactly that in their own realities.
They had harmonized multiple Titans and Authorities into a single Origin System.
A slow grin spread across Luke’s face.
"If they could do it. Then why can’t I at least try?" His eyes gleamed with anticipation.
"VOLTRAX!"
In his excitement, Luke shouted the Thunder Titan’s name without holding back.
At that moment, he didn’t care who heard him. His mind was focused on only one thing.
The possibility of breaking yet another limit.
The next moment, Luke’s body expanded.

In an instant, he transformed into a 17-foot-tall Thunder Titan. His entire body became clad in dark-blue plate armor, while six sharp spines extended from his upper back. A pair of horns curved upward from his head, forming a crown-like shape.
Lightning coursed endlessly through every inch of his body.
Surprisingly, the huge wings on his back remained.
Luke smiled.
It seemed Form Assimilation from his Winged Titan had carried over. He no longer needed to transform into the Faceless Titan just to assimilate another Titan’s body part.
"Now time to find out the truth." His expression turned serious as he dismissed the wings.
At his current mastery, Form Assimilation could only maintain one assimilated body part at a time.
The moment the wings disappeared, Luke’s body stalled in midair before gravity reclaimed him, causing him to slowly fall toward the ground.
He paid no attention to it.
His 5× stat multiplier was still active.
Closing his eyes, Luke took a deep breath.
Then.
He activated Form Assimilation once more.
This time, instead of wings. He replaced Voltrax’s Thunder Heart with the Cosmic Heart.
THUMP!
A heartbeat echoed through his body.
It was completely different from the violent rhythm of the Thunder Titan.
THUMP!!
The second beat rang out, louder than the first.
THUMP!!!
The third heartbeat reverberated through the air itself.
Golden-purple Cosmic Energy surged from within his armor, gradually replacing every strand of crackling lightning flowing across his body.
Luke’s eyes snapped open.
"IT SUCCEEDED!!!"
His unrestrained roar exploded across the mountains, producing a violent air shockwave that rippled outward for nearly a kilometer.
Far below, the traveling merchants, Blackstone patrol knights, and adventurers moving along the Ashveil Trade Route all heard the thunderous roar.
Everyone instinctively looked toward the Stormhowl Mountains, their expressions turning pale.
The voice carried an overwhelming pressure, making it feel as though it belonged to a being standing at the threshold of the Golden Knight realm.

Horses neighed in panic, refusing to move forward, while thousands of beasts deep within the forest fled in terror. Trees shook as hundreds of creatures stampeded away from the mountains, unintentionally forming a small beast tide that rushed toward the Ashveil Trade Route.
Witnessing the scene, the merchants and adventurers grew increasingly anxious.
"Please don’t let it be another disaster."
"Baron Luke will deal with it... right?"

The Blackstone patrol knights tightened their grips on their weapons, while everyone silently prayed that the lord of Blackstone Territory would stop the incoming beast tide before it reached the trade route.
The person they were hoping to save them didn’t notice the ongoing commotion he had created.
"Now." Luke clenched his fist with a confident smile.
"I don’t even fear a Peak Golden Knight anymore."
Surprisingly, the System didn’t appear to crush his confidence this time.
Because.
Luke wasn’t exaggerating.

Although his raw strength still hadn’t reached the Late Golden Knight realm, the techniques and combinations now at his disposal were enough to make even a Peak Golden Knight think twice before facing him.
He no longer needed Valzareth to use Void Step, allowing him to escape almost any dangerous situation or pursue fleeing enemies with ease.
More importantly, he could now create clones, and each one could independently transform into the Caelith Titan.
Just imagine it...
Ten clones.
Ten Cosmic Punches launched simultaneously.
Even a Peak Golden Knight would struggle to remain calm.
They would be scared shitless.
"Now I can even summon more clones during battle." Luke smiled.
With the Cosmic Heart supplying an endless stream of energy, sustaining multiple clones would become far easier than before.
The more he thought about the possibilities, the brighter his smile became.
Every new discovery brought him one step closer to rescuing his wives.
"Soon I’ll have enough strength."
Just then, another outrageous idea suddenly flashed through his mind.
This time, however, he didn’t dare test it himself.
So he decided to ask the expert.
The horn—
Ahem.
"Almighty System."
"System..." Luke asked with hopeful eyes, "can my human form also use the 5× and 3× stat multipliers?"

He no longer needed Valzareth to use Void Step, allowing him to escape almost any dangerous situation or pursue fleeing enemies with ease.
More importantly, he could now create clones, and each one could independently transform into the Caelith Titan.
Just imagine it...
Ten clones.
Ten Cosmic Punches launched simultaneously.
Even a Peak Golden Knight would struggle to remain calm.
They would be scared shitless.
"Now I can even summon more clones during battle." Luke smiled.
With the Cosmic Heart supplying an endless stream of energy, sustaining multiple clones would become far easier than before.
The more he thought about the possibilities, the brighter his smile became.
Every new discovery brought him one step closer to rescuing his wives.
"Soon I’ll have enough strength."
Just then, another outrageous idea suddenly flashed through his mind.
This time, however, he didn’t dare test it himself.
So he decided to ask the expert.
The horn—
Ahem.
"Almighty System."
"System..." Luke asked with hopeful eyes, "can my human form also use the 5× and 3× stat multipliers?"

chapters.title: Chapter 208: The Gossip Spreads About The Womanizer Luke
paragraphs: Because if he could wield every ability at its full potential—instead of only partially as before—
combined with the tremendous boost to his stats, his combat power would become truly terrifying.
But excitement was short-lived.
[Oh? And what made you think your human form could do that?] the system asked mockingly.
Luke froze.
Only then did he remember the name of his Origin Skill.
*Nexus Titan*
To achieve perfect synchronization, he had to activate his Origin Skill and become the Nexus Titan.

Of course, it wasn’t a true Titan transformation capable of using Titan Harmony and his other Titan abilities. Instead, it was a unique Origin state that allowed his human body to perfectly harmonize and unleash the full power of every authority and ability.
[Yup, nothing changed for your human body.]
[Everything remains the same.]
Luke could only let out a helpless sigh.
He had completely forgotten that he was still a human, not a Titan.
His shoulders slumped slightly as he looked up at the endless sky, a hint of disappointment flashing across his face.
For a moment, he remained silent.
The excitement from earlier slowly faded.
Still, a few moments later, he shook his head and chuckled softly.
"What am I even disappointed about?"
At the Silver Knight realm, he would finally become a Titan.
Of course, only the lowest-level Titan.
But at least it was a start.
With that thought, the disappointment vanished from his eyes.
Whoosh!
Luke increased his speed and immediately headed toward Blackstone.
Inside Blackstone, new adventurers, merchants, and even residents continued arriving every day.
Ever since news spread that Blackstone’s Baron, Luke, was a Mid-Golden Knight powerhouse, many believed the territory had become one of the safest places to settle.
The once-quiet streets had grown lively, with vendors calling out to customers, caravans entering through the gates, and people from all walks of life filling the markets.
Among the crowd was Lucy Dawnwale, the young mage Luke had first met in Stormveil County before recruiting her.
When Luke had met Kai and Margaret yesterday, he hadn’t seen Lucy because she had already returned to the mansion to rest alongside the other exhausted knights after the long journey.
Now, after a full night’s rest, she was leisurely touring the territory. With nothing urgent to do, she decided to see for herself what kind of place Blackstone had become.
Her gaze swept across the bustling streets, the orderly shops, and the cheerful atmosphere surrounding the town.
"Sir Luke is really something." Lucy muttered, unable to hide the surprise in her eyes.
Even though she had heard a few rumors about Luke back in Stormveil, they were nothing compared to the stories spreading throughout Blackstone.
"Mid-Golden Knight." Lucy murmured under her breath.
The title still felt unreal.
She recalled the calm, unassuming Luke she had traveled with, never once realizing he had hidden such overwhelming strength from everyone.
Completely lost in thought, she failed to notice a figure soaring across the sky.
It was Luke.
The moment he crossed Blackstone’s borders, he immediately spotted Lucy among the bustling marketplace below.
"Ahh, the Lord is back!"
Someone suddenly shouted.
In an instant, every people present looked up, excitement spreading through the streets as they recognized the familiar Titan flying overhead.
"Lord Luke!"
The bustling market became even livelier.
Ignoring the commotion, Luke descended directly toward Lucy.
Whoosh!
He landed smoothly beside her.
"Ah!"
Lucy jumped in surprise, taking an instinctive step back.
She had been so absorbed in her thoughts that she hadn’t noticed him until he was standing right beside her.
Moreover, she had no idea Luke could transform into this form as well.
The towering Titan disappeared in a flash of light, revealing Luke’s human figure once again.
Looking at her startled expression, he smiled faintly.
"Seems like I was late, Lucy."
Luke’s gentle voice finally pulled Lucy out of her daze.
"H-Huh?"
A confused sound escaped her lips before she could stop it.
The moment she realized what she had done, her cheeks flushed crimson with embarrassment.
Luke couldn’t help but smile at her reaction.
Meanwhile, the surrounding crowd exchanged puzzled glances.
’Who is that girl?’
’I don’t think I’ve seen her before.’
Curious whispers immediately spread through the marketplace.
By now, almost everyone in Blackstone had heard the stories about their Hero Baron.
Among the hundreds of exaggerated rumors, one was particularly infamous—
That Hero Luke was an incurable womanizer who somehow still wasn’t satisfied even after marrying five breathtaking princesses.
If Luke could hear what they were thinking, he would immediately protest.
What the heck are you talking about?!
Fortunately for him, everyone wisely kept those thoughts to themselves.
"Come on, Lucy."
Seeing that she was becoming even more embarrassed under everyone’s gaze, Luke smiled and gestured for her to follow.
"O-Okay..."
Lucy hurried after him, still trying to calm the heat on her face.
As the two walked toward the mansion together, the crowd gradually dispersed.
Of course, the gossip didn’t.
Before long, several people were already convinced that their womanizer Hero had somehow brought another beautiful girl back with him.
"So, how was the journey?" Luke asked. "Did you run into any problems along the way?"
Lucy shook her head.
"It went smoothly. There weren’t any problems."
"That’s good."
Luke nodded.
As they continued chatting, he led her deeper into the mansion until they arrived before the Time Chamber.
The glowing portal quietly floated before them, its surface rippling like liquid light.
Lucy blinked in curiosity.
"What is this?"
Luke smiled. "I’ll explain everything inside."
Since he intended to nurture Lucy into one of his trusted subordinates, there was no better place to begin than the Time Chamber.
It would save years of training.
"Come on." Luke reached out his hand.
"Let’s go in."
Lucy hesitated for a brief moment before placing her hand in his.
The instant their hands touched, a faint blush crept onto her cheeks.
Without saying anything, she followed him toward the glowing portal.
Ripple...
The two stepped through together.
A few moments later, Lucy slowly opened her eyes.
And as soon as she took a deep breath, her eyes widened.
The mana...
It was unbelievably pure.

Every breath she took carried rich mana into her body. The concentration was comparable to the Magic Tower’s highest-grade training rooms—places that normally required reservations and huge contributions just to enter for a few hours.

chapters.title: Chapter 209: Darling~ Why Weren’t You in Bed~?
paragraphs: Yet here.
The mana flowed freely throughout the entire place.
She slowly looked around.
Rolling hills stretched into the distance, towering mountains pierced the horizon, and vast forests swayed gently beneath a calm sky.
The peaceful scenery only made the place feel even more extraordinary.
Unable to contain her curiosity any longer, she turned toward Luke.
"Sir Luke..." Her voice trembled slightly with excitement.
"What is this place?"
The longing in her eyes was impossible to hide.
As a mage, she understood better than anyone what an environment like this represented.
If she cultivated here, the speed at which she engraved Arcane circle upon her heart would increase dramatically.
It was nothing short of a paradise for mages.
Luke watched her reaction and nodded inwardly in satisfaction.
Just as he expected.
There was no need to force loyalty through fear or empty promises.
Real benefits spoke louder than words.
If he wanted Lucy to become one of his most loyal followers, then he had to give her opportunities she could never find anywhere else.
And once she experienced those benefits. Leaving would become the last thing she wanted.
"This is the Time Chamber," Luke said with a smile as he continued walking toward the Mage Residence.
Lucy froze for a moment.
"The Time Chamber?" The name alone was enough to leave her stunned.
Seeing that Luke hadn’t stopped, she quickly followed after him.
As they walked, her curious eyes wandered across the surroundings.
Some residents were busy working in the fields and workshops.
Groups of knights sparred with one another on the training grounds, the sound of clashing weapons echoing through the air.
Farther away, an enormous city was steadily taking shape, with workers moving back and forth in an orderly fashion.
The entire place was full of life.
’Does this place have something to do with time?’ The thought naturally surfaced in her mind.
As if reading her thoughts, Luke spoke again.
"The flow of time here is different." He glanced at her before adding calmly,
"It has a one-to-thirty time ratio."
"One day outside is equal to thirty days inside."
Lucy nearly stopped walking.
Her beautiful eyes widened as she stared at Luke in disbelief.
"W-What!
She had certainly heard of Time Chambers before.
However, those legendary training grounds belonged only to the strongest forces or ancient existences.
They were treasures that ordinary people could never hope to encounter.
After all, time itself was one of the rarest and most mysterious powers in existence.
Although true Time-related powers were unimaginably rare, high-level mages—especially those at the Demigod level—had spent countless years studying the laws of time.
While they couldn’t truly control it, their vast knowledge allowed them to comprehend a tiny fraction of its mysteries.
Over the generations, that knowledge was passed down and refined.
Eventually, it became possible to create artificial Time Chambers.
Of course, such facilities still belonged only to the greatest powers.
The cost of constructing and maintaining one was so enormous that most organizations couldn’t even dream of owning one.
"But..." Lucy swallowed.
"I’ve never heard of a one-to-thirty ratio."
She muttered the words under her breath, unable to hide the shock in her voice.
Luke heard her clearly. He wasn’t particularly surprised.
After all, there was always the possibility that somewhere in the vast Valtharion, even greater Time Chambers existed.
Lucy simply hadn’t reached a level where she could learn about them.
"We’ve arrived."
Luke’s voice interrupted her thoughts.
Lucy blinked before raising her head.
There, a vast lake stretched before them, its crystal-clear surface reflecting the nearby cottages like a flawless mirror.
A gentle breeze rippled across the water, carrying with it the cheerful giggles of several women.
Splash!
Splash!
They were clearly enjoying themselves in the lake.
"...Wait." Luke’s footsteps paused.
The corner of his mouth twitched.
’Why is it always like this?’ He inwardly groaned.
For some reason, every single time he came to the Mage Residence, he always ended up arriving while the resident mages were bathing—whether alone or in groups.
’What kind of ridiculous luck was this?’
[Kekeke.]
Luke shot the system a deadpan look.
The shameless system seemed to be enjoying the situation, far more than it should.
Suppressing the urge to argue with it, Luke cleared his throat.
"Ahem!
His voice echoed across the quiet lakeside.
Almost instantly Splashing sounds came to an abrupt halt.
A brief silence followed.
Then came the soft rustling of clothes as the women hurriedly got dressed after realizing someone had arrived.
A few moments later, the mages walked out from behind the lakeside cottages.
"Master." Their voices carried a hint of embarrassment.
Among them was Elena, the Holy Light healer, whose complexion looked noticeably healthier than before.
Luke gave them a small nod before gesturing toward the girl beside him.
"Everyone, meet our new mage—Lucy Dawnvale."
"She’s the eleventh mage of Blackstone."
Hearing herself being introduced so formally, Lucy became a little nervous.
Still, she stepped forward with a polite smile.
"Thank you for having me."
Her gentle greeting immediately earned warm smiles from the other mages.
Before long, several of them gathered around her, introducing themselves and asking questions about where she had come from and what kind of magic she specialized in.
Seeing everyone getting along so quickly, Luke nodded inwardly.
Looks like everything is going smoothly.
However...
The very next moment, the cheerful chatter came to an abrupt stop.
The smiles on the mages faces froze.
One after another, their gazes shifted past Luke’s shoulder.
They were all staring at something behind him.
’Behind—’ Before Luke could even finish the thought, a pair of soft arms slipped around his neck from behind.
A sweet yet dangerously calm voice whispered into his ear.
"Darling~ why weren’t you in bed~?"
Luke’s entire body froze.
He knew that voice.
A familiar warmth of melons pressed lightly against his back as he felt her gentle breath brush across his neck.
The faint fragrance of lavender drifted into the air.
Normally, that scent always calmed his mind.
Today.
It had the exact opposite effect.
A bead of cold sweat slowly rolled down Luke’s forehead.
’System...’
’Why do I have this strange feeling that if I answer this incorrectly. she’ll actually choke me to death?’ Luke asked inwardly, forcing a stiff smile onto his face.
