chapters.title: Chapter 225: Time to Become a Silver Knight!
paragraphs: Nothing could remain hidden forever.
Luke instinctively glanced toward Theia again.
She still stood quietly, gazing at Blackstone City with calm curiosity.
She hadn’t moved an inch.
’System, Is this passive really that overpowered?’
The System answered after a brief pause.
[Hmm... It is powerful.]
[But it isn’t invincible.]
Luke quietly listened.
[Since Dream Sight is a passive ability. Its effectiveness decreases dramatically against beings of the same realm.]
[She can still sense their presence and dreams.]
[However, their deepest desires, secrets, and intentions become blurred.]
Luke nodded. That sounded much more reasonable.
The System continued.
[And naturally, it has no effect on beings of a higher realm.]
Luke nodded once more. That was simply common sense.
Even Origin Skills had limits.
Passive abilities. No matter how extraordinary, could never be truly omnipotent.
Though active abilities were different. Many of them could temporarily threaten or influence opponents above the user’s own realm.
Still.
’I wonder how much would it actually reveal against a Diamond Knight?’
That would have to be tested another day.
[⚡ ACTIVE ABILITIES]
1. [Can’t be seen]
2. [Can’t be seen]
3. [Can’t be seen]
4. [Can’t be seen]
[🌙 ULTIMATE ABILITY] - [Can’t be seen]
Luke stared blankly at the status panel.
Then.
"What the hell?" He couldn’t stop himself from blurting it out.
Every single ability was hidden.
Only—
*Can’t be seen.*
Luke was so focused on the screen that he completely forgot someone else was standing nearby.
Still a moment later. He felt a gaze upon him.
Looking up, he found Theia watching him with mild curiosity.
Apparently she had heard his outburst.
Luke immediately coughed awkwardly.
"Ahem." Then he smiled as naturally as possible.
"Nothing."
Theia simply inclined her head slightly before returning her attention to the surroundings.
She didn’t ask another question.
The System finally spoke.
[Ahem!]
[Luke.]
[Your rank is currently too low to view her abilities.]
Luke frowned.
"My rank?" He immediately became confused.
What rank? The rank of my Origin Skill?
That couldn’t be right.
His Nexus Titan was an SSS+ Origin.
It far surpassed Theia’s.
So there was no reason it should be unable to inspect her abilities.
Then only one possibility remained.
’You’re talking about my cultivation realm.’
Luke sighed helplessly.
Currently, he was only a Bronze Knight. That explanation actually made sense.
After all, every summon he had inspected before had been D-Rank or below.
Despite many of them possessing S-Rank Origin Skills. None had ever exceeded his realm by such an enormous margin.
Theia, however was a genuine B-Rank Arcane Core Mage.
Though Luke decided not to ask the System, when he would be able to see Theia’s abilities. If the answer turned out to be, "Reach B-Rank first," it would only discourage him.
’Still...’ He glanced at Theia again. Even her passive is already ridiculously powerful. Her active abilities, especially her Ultimate. they’re definitely going to be terrifying.
With that thought, Luke opened the Monthly Claim and selected Bronze Knight Tempering Potion without any hesitation.
’System, use today’s 1,000× Return.’
The System immediately processed his request.

During his long stay inside the Time Chamber, it had repeatedly warned him that the higher a cultivator’s realm became, the greater the amount of cultivation resources required. That wasn’t unique to ordinary cultivators—it applied to System rewards as well.
According to the System’s calculations, advancing from the beginning of Bronze Knight to the peak required exactly 1,000 Bronze Knight Tempering Potions.
Luke looked at that number, then at today’s 1,000× Return, and his eyes narrowed suspiciously.
’System.’
’This can’t be a coincidence.’
The required number and today’s multiplier matched perfectly, almost as if everything had been planned from the very beginning.
The System, however, remained completely silent.
Luke sighed helplessly.
’Whatever.’
Whether it was coincidence or not, there was no point dwelling on it.
The very next moment, 1,000 Bronze Knight Tempering Potions appeared inside Luke’s inventory.
Each potion was stored in a crystal vial, shimmering with a soft bronze glow.
After confirming everything was there, Luke glanced around.
The surrounding hills were already far enough from Blackstone.
Even if his breakthrough caused a disturbance, it wouldn’t affect the territory.
"This should be far enough." So a smile slowly spread across his face.
"Let’s break through here."
Standing a short distance away, Theia quietly watched him.
A hint of curiosity appeared in her emerald eyes.
Ever since arriving in Blackstone, she had noticed something unusual.
Her liege and almost everyone in the territory. Cultivated through methods she had never seen before.
Only the eleven mages within Blackstone followed a familiar path.
Naturally she became curious about Luke’s own cultivation.
Meanwhile.
The System suddenly remembered something.
’...Oh. I forgot to tell Luke about her memories.’
Unlike his lower-ranked summons. Theia hadn’t forgotten everything.
Luke’s previous summons had almost entirely lost the memories of their former lives, retaining only fragments in a few rare cases.
The System had explained long ago that every summon was a soul brought back after death.
However the stronger the summoned being had been in life. The more of their memories, personality, and habits they retained after being summoned.
And Theia, she came from an entirely different world.
Even a different reality.
A reality where the Knight cultivation system didn’t even exist.
As the System was thinking about this...
Luke turned toward her.
"Theia."
"I’ll be breaking through in a moment." He looked at her seriously.
"If anything unusual happens during my breakthrough, protect me."
"And if the disturbance becomes too great, conceal it... or suppress it."
Theia listened quietly before giving a graceful nod.
"As you wish, my liege."
Her expression remained as calm as ever.
Apparently, she didn’t think that her liege breakthrough could produce much of a disturbance. Because she felt the energy in Luke was way too low.
Luke noticed that subtle indifference and sighed inwardly.
She truly wasn’t like his previous summons.
The others would have accepted every order without a second thought.
Still... Luke wasn’t worried.
After all she was an Arcane Core Mage.
According to the System, the defining feature of this realm was the Arcane Core itself.
Rather than constructing every spell from scratch. An Arcane Core Mage could store completed spells directly inside their Arcane Core.
And that ability was absurd.
Take a tornado spell, for example.
Other mage would have to chant and construct the spell every single time.
Theia didn’t.
She could prepare thousands of tornado spells in advance, store them inside her Arcane Core.
Then release them one after another.
Or even...
All at once.
Just imagining thousands of city-destroying tornadoes descending upon a battlefield was enough to make Luke shiver.
Of course.
That was only one example.
Mages commanded different elements and spell types.
The true terror of an Arcane Core Mage was something he would learn little by little in the future.

chapters.title: Chapter 226: A Body Built for Titans!
paragraphs: "Here goes nothing." With that, Luke uncorked the potions under the curious gaze of Theia and one by one gulped them down.
After gulping them down, surprisingly he got the same feeling, like all the previous tempering potions.
Because its taste also followed the same and even its effect was the same, or maybe the system’s tempering potions were like that.
Though, the next moment he felt the pain, ’Control.’ So he forcefully suppressed it, which didn’t start after the first potion, but occurred after the 10th potion.
WHOSH!

Next instant, the huge burst of Aether came out from Luke’s body, due to the breakthrough of the first realm and reaching the second realm, which even generated a small shockwave, resulting in the surrounding dirt and stones being swept away from the nearby hill area.
Meanwhile Theia’s hair just swayed more gracefully, and her purple robe fluttered a little, and nothing else happened to her.
’Interesting.’ Still, this thought came into her mind, as she felt curiosity towards Luke.
Because she could see that her liege was making his body strong with this cultivation method.
While mages followed the path of mana, so they didn’t focus on their body.
She also noticed that he didn’t have mana, instead he had Aether, which she already realized was the thinner form of mana.
So while she was being surprised by this, Luke’s breakthrough of the first stage finally completed, and his second realm of Bronze Knight also stabilized perfectly, all thanks to the system potion.

"Good." Which resulted in these words escaping his mouth, because the feeling of breakthrough was so great, like an euphoria, and right now he also felt that his body was filled with new strength and even his Aether increased so much compared to before.
"Let’s continue." So without wasting any more time, he uncorked another potion before gulping them as well.
Though this time, it took 20 potions before he completed his breakthrough from the second stage to the third stage.
And this continued for 2 hours, as he reached the 9th stage of Bronze Knight.
But this time, Luke had consumed 320 potions for his breakthrough from the 9th stage of Bronze Knight to the peak of Bronze Knight.
"Huff..." All this breakthrough took a heavy toll on his body and mind, which resulted in his breathing being rough.
So he paused for a few moments, while also taking a deep breath to calm down his nerves.
Even though his pain resistance seemed to have gone high up, since he kept bearing the aftermath of his titan transformation and all the pains that came after that.
As Luke was taking a break for a few moments, Theia watched calmly Luke’s sweat-covered body, and the black goo on his body.
Which was already stacked again in large quantity.
Even though she had already cleaned them many times, using wind and water magic, but even after that, his breakthrough from Bronze Knight to peak still brought too much of this waste outside.
’Why does his body contain more Aether than others?’ So while she cleaned his body with magic again, she was thinking about other peak Bronze Knights in the territory.
Who seemed like children, while Luke seemed like an adult, if they compared their Aether.
Though she didn’t know about their strength comparison, but seeing that he was lord here, it should definitely be high.
If the system heard her thoughts, he would just laugh. Since Luke was way different from a normal knight.
Because his body was being prepared to hold a titan bloodline, and even the lowest bloodline of a pure titan could destroy any Bronze Knight to paste in a matter of seconds.
Which was why Luke was better and stronger than even a peak Bronze Knight at this moment.
Of course, that didn’t include other high rank species, the system was talking about Humans.
Still one sarcastic remark the system would definitely throw at Theia, "If you get surprised by this, then see his titan transformation."
And the system was completely right regarding this, because in Theia’s world, only magic was the cultivation.
So they didn’t know much about Forbidden power and even more about the firstborn of the universe of their worlds.
"Finally." Luke muttered excitedly, as he looked at the last 25 potions in his hand, which would make his peak to absolute peak, suitable for breakthrough to Silver Knight.
Though Theia was standing at a distance with a calm expression, because Luke’s earlier talk about phenomena or disturbance didn’t happen, which she had already expected.
Luke also noticed this, at which his mouth twitched a little.
Since he always got unwavering respect from his summons, so this new feeling was hard to adapt to.
The feeling of being underestimated.
Of course he knew that his cultivation was right now an E rank, while she was B rank. There was definitely no comparison.
Still!
’Let’s wait for her reaction while I break through to Silver Knight.’ Luke thought with a normal expression.
Though there was a little bit of worry in there, since even he didn’t know what would happen, or what type of reaction this world would have.
Thinking this, he gulped down every single potion one after another.

And then finally, after half an hour of brutal process, of flesh tearing, Aether channels expanding, Aether core expanding, and bones becoming strong, while other processes which could make his body flawless, he was ready.
Ready for the breakthrough.
"Damn, that was one hell of a ride." Luke cursed out, because the last tempering pain or torture in one way was more than the combined previous nine stages.
If Theia had not soothed his mind overtime with her dream power, then he would have been knocked out for sure.
Still he became amazed by Theia’s control of dream power.

Even though everyone who had an Origin skill could control their Origin element to use them raw, but this brought the question of mastery, which was difficult at lower levels, due to the mind not having fully developed, or not being able to bear the burden of such complex data.

sentences.text: "Here goes nothing." With that, Luke uncorked the potions under the curious gaze of Theia and one by one gulped them down.
After gulping them down, surprisingly he got the same feeling, like all the previous tempering potions.
Because its taste also followed the same and even its effect was the same, or maybe the system’s tempering potions were like that.
Though, the next moment he felt the pain, ’Control.’ So he forcefully suppressed it, which didn’t start after the first potion, but occurred after the 10th potion.
WHOSH!

Next instant, the huge burst of Aether came out from Luke’s body, due to the breakthrough of the first realm and reaching the second realm, which even generated a small shockwave, resulting in the surrounding dirt and stones being swept away from the nearby hill area.
Meanwhile Theia’s hair just swayed more gracefully, and her purple robe fluttered a little, and nothing else happened to her.
’Interesting.’ Still, this thought came into her mind, as she felt curiosity towards Luke.
Because she could see that her liege was making his body strong with this cultivation method.
While mages followed the path of mana, so they didn’t focus on their body.
She also noticed that he didn’t have mana, instead he had Aether, which she already realized was the thinner form of mana.
So while she was being surprised by this, Luke’s breakthrough of the first stage finally completed, and his second realm of Bronze Knight also stabilized perfectly, all thanks to the system potion.

"Good." Which resulted in these words escaping his mouth, because the feeling of breakthrough was so great, like an euphoria, and right now he also felt that his body was filled with new strength and even his Aether increased so much compared to before.
"Let’s continue." So without wasting any more time, he uncorked another potion before gulping them as well.
Though this time, it took 20 potions before he completed his breakthrough from the second stage to the third stage.
And this continued for 2 hours, as he reached the 9th stage of Bronze Knight.
But this time, Luke had consumed 320 potions for his breakthrough from the 9th stage of Bronze Knight to the peak of Bronze Knight.
"Huff..." All this breakthrough took a heavy toll on his body and mind, which resulted in his breathing being rough.
So he paused for a few moments, while also taking a deep breath to calm down his nerves.
Even though his pain resistance seemed to have gone high up, since he kept bearing the aftermath of his titan transformation and all the pains that came after that.
As Luke was taking a break for a few moments, Theia watched calmly Luke’s sweat-covered body, and the black goo on his body.
Which was already stacked again in large quantity.
Even though she had already cleaned them many times, using wind and water magic, but even after that, his breakthrough from Bronze Knight to peak still brought too much of this waste outside.
’Why does his body contain more Aether than others?’ So while she cleaned his body with magic again, she was thinking about other peak Bronze Knights in the territory.
Who seemed like children, while Luke seemed like an adult, if they compared their Aether.
Though she didn’t know about their strength comparison, but seeing that he was lord here, it should definitely be high.
If the system heard her thoughts, he would just laugh.
Since Luke was way different from a normal knight.
Because his body was being prepared to hold a titan bloodline, and even the lowest bloodline of a pure titan could destroy any Bronze Knight to paste in a matter of seconds.
Which was why Luke was better and stronger than even a peak Bronze Knight at this moment.
Of course, that didn’t include other high rank species, the system was talking about Humans.
Still one sarcastic remark the system would definitely throw at Theia, "If you get surprised by this, then see his titan transformation."
And the system was completely right regarding this, because in Theia’s world, only magic was the cultivation.
So they didn’t know much about Forbidden power and even more about the firstborn of the universe of their worlds.
"Finally." Luke muttered excitedly, as he looked at the last 25 potions in his hand, which would make his peak to absolute peak, suitable for breakthrough to Silver Knight.
Though Theia was standing at a distance with a calm expression, because Luke’s earlier talk about phenomena or disturbance didn’t happen, which she had already expected.
Luke also noticed this, at which his mouth twitched a little.
Since he always got unwavering respect from his summons, so this new feeling was hard to adapt to.
The feeling of being underestimated.
Of course he knew that his cultivation was right now an E rank, while she was B rank.
There was definitely no comparison.
Still!
’Let’s wait for her reaction while I break through to Silver Knight.’ Luke thought with a normal expression.
Though there was a little bit of worry in there, since even he didn’t know what would happen, or what type of reaction this world would have.
Thinking this, he gulped down every single potion one after another.

And then finally, after half an hour of brutal process, of flesh tearing, Aether channels expanding, Aether core expanding, and bones becoming strong, while other processes which could make his body flawless, he was ready.
Ready for the breakthrough.
"Damn, that was one hell of a ride." Luke cursed out, because the last tempering pain or torture in one way was more than the combined previous nine stages.
If Theia had not soothed his mind overtime with her dream power, then he would have been knocked out for sure.
Still he became amazed by Theia’s control of dream power.

Even though everyone who had an Origin skill could control their Origin element to use them raw, but this brought the question of mastery, which was difficult at lower levels, due to the mind not having fully developed, or not being able to bear the burden of such complex data.

chapters.title: Chapter 227: The System’s Prediction Failed!
paragraphs: ’It’s good for me.’ At this, he smiled at Theia, bringing a confused gaze from her.
Luke shook his head before standing up.
"We have to go outside." Luke said to her, since the system had already warned that his breakthrough could not be handled by the Time Chamber.
When the system said this, at that time, he became completely afraid and thought that he had to do his breakthrough alone in the depths of the Stormhowl Mountains.
But fortunately, Theia came out, and now having her to protect him was a good idea.
As he was thinking this, Theia’s voice came, "Are you talking about the world outside?"
She muttered calmly, which shocked Luke. ’Does she feel the outside world?’
Though before he could process that thought further, the world blurred for a moment, before they appeared outside, in an alley of the Blackstone market.

"What!" Upon this Luke freaked out and looked around warily, because he was safe in the Time Chamber, but suddenly being dragged outside meant his authority over the Time Chamber couldn’t stop whatever process, person, or enemy had dragged him here.
However even after a few moments, nothing happened, which confused him, but then he noticed that Theia was beside him as well, and now smiling at his panicked behavior.
’Wait!’ Thinking this, his eyes widened, and a crazy thought came into his mind.
’Did she bring me out? or us? without my knowledge?’ Faced with this, he became a little afraid from the very thought.
As he didn’t know if she was able to do this because she was a B rank, a Platinum Knight level, or because she was special due to her S rank Origin skill.
Meanwhile, the system watched all this and thought about her ability.
⚡ ABILITY 4: DREAM WALK
Using the Dream Well, Theia can enter, traverse, and exit any dream within the range of her Dream Sight.
Yes, and because of this, the Time Chamber even couldn’t stop her actions, since she was using a one-of-a-kind dimension to travel, not space.
And since her mastery over her dream power was high, she was also able to bring Luke with her.
Which even Luke could do, using his Void Step, but his mastery over void or Void Step was low to none.
Or else, the thing called distance wouldn’t matter to him much and he could even bring other people with him instantly.
Still with Theia’s rank, she could also breach the Time Chamber’s space, but for that she had to use raw strength.
As the system was thinking this, Luke asked Theia worriedly, "Theia, can anyone of your level do this?"
In response, Theia just smiled and didn’t say anything.
Seeing this, Luke sighed.
But he still got the answer, ’Not everyone could do it, at least like she does effortlessly.’
With that thought, he summoned Valzareth and the next moment, appeared 1km away from Blackstone.
Though the next instant, Theia also appeared beside him, because she could use her Dream Well to connect realities within 100km range of anyone’s dream.
And Blackstone had many people who were sleeping. So she could appear anywhere within 100km in that area.
And her Dream Walk was not even limited to intelligent beings; she could also use Dream Walk from non-intelligent creatures like beasts and animals’ dreams to move.

"Hmm..." Luke nodded at her and didn’t become surprised like earlier. Even though he didn’t know how she was doing this, he just thought she was using some kind of teleportation magic, which seemed acceptable regarding her rank and her profession.
After that, he looked around and then to the farthest peak of a few hills which emerged on the Stormhowl Mountains.

"Theia, can you bring us there?" Luke pointed toward the location, on which before he could even hear her reply, they appeared there. ’Damn, so fast!’ He nearly cursed out loud, fortunately at the last moment he did it in his mind.
So his image as a Lord would not be destroyed. Or at least the remaining one.
Sadly for him, Theia could still feel Luke’s state with her Dream Sight.
Still, one thing was bugging her all the time. She couldn’t probe deep inside Luke.
Which shouldn’t be possible regarding his realm.
In the start, she thought that maybe she just came into this world, that was why.
But later, she found out that she could see everyone’s secrets if she willed. But only her liege was exempt from this.
’Is it because he summoned me?’ She blamed this and didn’t think anything else was hidden inside him, which was preventing her power.
Sadly for her, she was completely wrong, because Myrkhal was the holder of the Unknown path inside Luke.
So where he resides, how could anyone find something known?
That was why she could only feel Luke’s outer behavior, not inside.
"Let’s go further." Luke said with a serious face, because he didn’t want his breakthrough to point anything toward Blackstone.
She nodded upon this and with that, they teleported a few more times, before finally reaching deep inside the Stormhowl Mountains, which was said to even hold A rank beasts.
"Can’t be helped." Thinking this, Luke muttered under his breath, since all other sides of Blackstone held someone’s territory.
So only the north side, which was the Stormhowl Mountains, was left.
With that he nodded at Theia, before bringing out the Bronze Knight breakthrough potion, a crystal vial which held a bronze-colored potion, but there were also silver streaks present among them.
As he was holding this, the system’s words came into his mind.
[Luke, according to previous calculations, your integration should be able to succeed.]
Upon this he raised his brow, as the system didn’t mention this before.
[But since Myrkhal, the Faceless Titan, has appeared as one of your titans...]
After saying this, the system took a long pause, while Luke waited for his answer with a worried expression.
Because if something happened during the breakthrough, he didn’t know what would happen to him.
[I don’t know what the result will be.]

chapters.title: Chapter 228: The Gods Have Been Waiting for This Day!
paragraphs: Hearing this, Luke looked toward the vial with a hesitant expression, while the system continued.
[As it decided, your bloodline integration needs a huge amount of energy.]
[Which neither your body could produce, nor your body could absorb.]
[Since your body is going to hold a forbidden lineage, even at a minimal percentage.]
Luke nodded, because he knew that a human body couldn’t contain so much energy compared to a dragon or other races.
While Elementals were known to be beings who could produce a huge amount of continuous energy.
[That was why your starting titan was the Void Titan, to make your body able to absorb a huge amount of energy.]
[While the other titan is the Cosmic Heart Titan, who can produce a huge amount of energy.]
[And that was when their bloodline was reduced, as you know. At their peak, you can’t fill the Void, and the same for Caelith, her heart can produce infinite energy.]
Luke became surprised upon this, as he didn’t expect that his initial titan was planned for this moment.
That was why the system was annoyed when Myrkhal, the Faceless Titan, appeared.
’Because maybe the third titan was also equally important for his ascension.’ Luke thought with an enlightened expression, and the system’s next words also confirmed it.
[But we are missing the titan which could hold your body during this process, which would literally tear apart your body before giving you enough time to rebuild.]
Luke flinched upon hearing this.
Still he asked the question which always bugged him when Myrkhal was summoned.
’Then system, what was the original titan decided for my third titan?’
Hearing Luke’s words, the system paused for a moment, before giving him the answer. Since nothing could be done now.
[The titan who holds the forbidden power of Evolution.]
’o-o’ Luke’s eyes became wide at this.
Because he knew what evolution could do. Making an insect into a god was not difficult.
And that was for normal evolution power, so just think about it! that the titan who held forbidden power of evolution meant it had the peak of evolution method.
How strong would he or she be?
And for his human body, he knew evolution could make him perfect, since humans on Valtharion were not perfect beings born from birth.
They had to temper themselves continuously, and even then, they had to use different methods to overcome the comparison with other races, if they wanted to survive a clash against the same realm.
[Well, still let’s hope everything goes alright.]
[After all, even though Myrkhal holds the forbidden power of the Unknown path, he is still the Faceless Titan.]
[This means he has mastery over the unknown, or else he couldn’t even form, which was faceless.]

Hearing this, Luke also nodded. Even though Myrkhal was not the evolution power holder, but maybe his bloodline knew how to calm down his other two raging bloodlines, or at least let them combine with each other.
So, when Luke was thinking this, Theia watched her liege, who seemed to be talking to someone in his mind. But as usual, she couldn’t find who.
Then she saw him gulping the potion in one swift motion and close his eyes.
Likely waiting for the inevitable.
At this, she also spread her dream power in 1km with a flick of her hand, so anyone coming here would become confused and would not notice anything.
Sadly, she really underestimated Luke’s breakthrough this time.
Hell, even the system didn’t see this coming.
GRRRRRRRRMMMMMM...
The moment Luke’s breakthrough started, the heavens themselves growled as dark clouds churned violently overhead.
The whole Stormhowl Mountains the next moment seemed to be covered with dark clouds. Or at least, the part where Luke was.
Seeing this, every beast present in the vicinity, even the A rank beings, ran away instantly.
Because they knew what this was.
From far in the distance, Blackstone citizens, merchants, adventurers, even the four association guild masters, also saw this and became shocked.
"Essence clouds!!!"
Their eyes widened upon realization, because this meant that someone was breaking through from peak Golden Knight to Platinum Knight, or from C rank to B rank.

Somewhere far from Valtharion, a place which seemed to be another world, a world whose size seemed to dwarf Valtharion by a huge degree, that whole Valtharion, which seemed to be the size of a galaxy, would only be a small needle size compared to this place.
There, a few beings who usually slept for thousands of years were now fully awake and were looking toward the Valtharion direction with anticipation.
Which was surrounded by white fog that refused to let anyone see anything inside.
"So it’s begun." Then a gentle, calm voice came from the mouth of a beautiful woman, who was also residing somewhere among this world.
Whose beauty was so ethereal that no mortal could dare to look, or they would burn the next instant with the halo of light that floated behind her head.
"Yeah it’s begun." Another beautiful voice came beside her, but no one was present there.
Though the woman, or rather, the goddess of light, didn’t find this odd.
Instead, she just kept looking toward Valtharion, where Luke was undergoing his breakthrough.
Though the next moment, a surprised flicker appeared on her face for a moment, before disappearing instantly.
Still a word escaped her mouth, "Why are the essence clouds forming there?"
However this time, no voice came from beside her. At this she could only hope that... that Luke could get the power of the Origin Titan.
The same was happening with other gods and goddesses as well, who were also looking toward Valtharion, toward Luke’s location, with anticipation.
That soon, the moment would arrive.
Of course, they could also just feel his location, even after using their power, since Valtharion was not allowing anyone to peek inside.
Your support truly motivates me to keep writing more.
And you could also check my other novel as well, which consists of an MC having a Forbidden Death rank class and a shop, which could literally allow him to buy anything.
Obtained Forbidden God-Rank Death Class, Now I Conquered Other Worlds

chapters.title: Chapter 229: The Mountain Titan Descended!
paragraphs: "But why? Theia was standing so far?" Luke turn his gaze again toward Theia, whose was little worried this time.
As it seems, she also felt the threat it contain, for Luke.
[Well, as you have read in novel, when mc broke through to some stages, those heavanly thunder rain down at him.]
[His tribulation.]
[It was similar to this. And if she also came into range, then Valtharion would rain down thunder at her as well, but with more intensity and it could also result your punishment being increased.]
"So no help." Luke muttered calmly, like right now he was not worried about Essence clouds at well.
He looked toward Blackstone, there just now, his clone had disappered.
"I don’t know, why. But I couldn’t control any clone right now." Luke looked at his body lining, as these seems to reason for this.
Then, he thought for moment, before turning toward Theia, "Theia go back and stopped anyone coming from here."
He shouted toward her calmly, on which she didn’t respond. Just worriedly look toward the dark clouds, which was ready to rain down first thunder.
Meanwhile, down there Luke was already prepared, Because before even thunder could released.
"Come forth, Dromar!" He shouted towards the sky and next instant, his body rapidly grew.
His muscles bulged up and soon changed into Stone like materials, while thich armor began appearing all over his body.
His chest, legs, shoulders. Every part got covered by those armor, while golden lining could be seen.
Which pulsed with huge amount of aether.
Soon, his body become 25 feet tall and next moment Nullex also appeared and covered his entire body.
Seeing this scene, Theia became completely. Because right now, she felt the Aura Luke was emiting, was close to mid-golden knight, which she had found the info earlier in the territory.
But his realm, still remains at peak of Bronze knight.
Luke didn’t notice her expression, as he was also suprised by this.
The Bastion titan, was the new titan face, unlock by Myrkhal, after he reached Bronze knight.
This titan was known for their abosulte defense like body, which could tank even the mightest attacks of their realm, without being knockback.
"Hmm, my strength also increased." On giant Luke face a smiled appered, because Theia was right.
And his basic strength had reached peak of early golden knight.
Which was earlier, after 5x and 3x stats buff, was around early golden knight stage.
"Seems like, peak bronze really have effect when multiply to this number." He mutered, as he clenched his fist, which generated a shockwave, that shook violently the nearby tree.
Then he look above, "Peak golden..."
At that, he voiced became low.
Right now, his defense was peak of mid golden knight, he could tell for sure.
But it was still not enough.
"Then let’s increase it." He thought with the smile, before using another new titan, which Myrkhal had unlocked on Iron knight and was also an defense type.
And finally today he was going to use it.
"Montarok." Luke whispered the name of the Mountain Titan slowly, and used form assimilation to merge its body structure with Dromar.
Then the very next moment, his body started rapidly growing again.
But this time, his outer stone-like skin turned completely to stone, rocky-like structure, since Montarok was a pure Mountain Titan.
The being who was even supreme among them, and also was one of the few starting Titans whose size could rival galaxies at its peak.
RUMBLE!
As his body grew, stone clacking sounds also followed suit, because new stone parts were originating beneath the armor of Dromar, while Nullex adjusted itself to the new ever-growing size.
At the Iron Knight, this titan was of 20 feet size, and at Bronze Knight, its height had reached 30 feet.
But now, since he was combining its body form with the already 25 feet tall Dromar, the new size resulted in a 40-foot tall titan, a mixture of Fortress Titan and Mountain Titan.
"ROAAR!"
Unconsciously, a loud roar escaped Luke’s mouth. Since he had become two titans who focused on defense, he also felt his thinking power reduce somewhat.
’System, is this normal?’ So he worriedly asked the system, even though he knew he was right.

[Yes. Your every titan affects you in their nature. Though not completely right now, since you can’t use their full power yet, but with more realm upgrades, you could even risk losing control and become the very own titan.]
’Are you kidding me?’ Upon this, Luke panicked, but before he could ask further, the sky rumbled, likely provoked by his earlier roar.
Upon this, Luke’s mouth twitched, ’Seriously? you are a fucking Valtharion, a world, and you are getting provoked by this?’
Though, Luke didn’t know that Valtharion was not provoked by his earlier roar. Instead, it was provoked by his continuous use of new power which Valtharion had not possessed,
or not available on Valtharion.
"Then fine." Luke muttered, raising his left hand, which the next instant transformed into a huge shield that was 20 feet tall and 10 feet wide.
Completely made of his Fortress Titan Aether, which was known to have insane hardness.
Feeling the weight of the shield in his hand, Luke smiled, before shouting towards the sky.
"COME!"
And it did.
KRAAAK!!! BOOOOOOM!!!
An earth-shaking thunder roar echoed in the surroundings, which was even heard by everyone within 1,000km.
After that, many people from far distances noticed the unusual gathering of dark clouds, while higher realm beings,
like Golden Knights and above, even able to identify what this was, "Essence Cloud."
At that, many individuals and groups immediately moved toward the location with excited expressions, to see the birth or failure of a new B rank being.
And this same situation was happening nearly everywhere around 1,000km. Even from the borders of Blackstone, soldiers could see this, and the same for demi-humans as well.
Meanwhile, Theia was completely surprised by her liege’s power and felt she had really underestimated him so much.

sentences.text: "But why?
Theia was standing so far?" Luke turn his gaze again toward Theia, whose was little worried this time.

[Well, as you have read in novel, when mc broke through to some stages, those heavanly thunder rain down at him.]
[His tribulation.]

chapters.title: Chapter 230: Even the Strongest Heroes Stop at Ninth Lightning
paragraphs: But earlier, when he told her to go, she hesitated.
Because she knew his realm and defense were still not on par with the upcoming attack.

As she was thinking this, he suddenly grew again and became a 40-foot tall giant, filled with a rocky surface and his face now seemed like a mountain face, while his full body was surrounded by golden armor, which had some stone-like texture.
"COME!"
There, he shouted towards the sky, before a huge shield formed in his hand, followed by his armor, which also rapidly grew.
And covered the whole surface of the newly generated shield. But it didn’t stop there.
As huge conical metal-like structures erupted from the upper surface of the shield, and its edges also extended downward from the four sides of the shield, and embedded themselves in the ground.
’Is he trying to transfer the lightning into the ground?’ She thought confusedly, because it would not work.
As those were not ordinary thunder, but were essence thunder. Even though it contained only peak Golden Knight power,
but still...
Before she could think further, the earth-shaking roar of thunder came, followed by its lightning strike.
KRAAAK!!! BOOOOOOM!!!
A dark bluish, thick thunder collided with Luke’s shield, resulting in a huge explosion.
Then came the shockwave, which blasted apart every tree in the 100m area into splinters.
And everything in its path. Though when it came to Theia, who was 1km away, she dispersed it easily.
Still she looked worriedly toward Luke.
’Should I have intervened earlier?’ And this thought came into her mind, which she shook the next moment.
Because for a few attacks she could manage for both of them, but after that, things would become ugly.
So she hoped that Luke would be alright.
"Cough!" Luke coughed out, which resulted in blood escaping his mouth.
As the location where he was now had formed a 20-foot wide and 5-foot deep crater from the earlier attack.
While Nullex’s elongated part on the shield had been destroyed completely, and even his shield bore a few cracks.
"Heh." However, Luke provocatively smiled toward the sky with a bloodied mouth.
Because now he had survived a peak Golden Knight attack using his peak Bronze Knight realm.
’Though, Aurielle would definitely be mad if she finds out about this.’ Luke sighed and removed his smile before looking at Theia.
Who was stunned, not because he had survived, but stunned because he had survived with little bit of wounds.
"Go now and also stop my wife, Aurielle, if she tries to come here." Luke said to her again.
Upon this, Theia came out of her stunned state and looked toward the sky again, because the next attack would be equal to two peak Golden Knight attacks.
And she was worried that if something happened to him, she could at least step up at the last moment, even at the rage of Valtharion.
But if she moved away, then saving him from a far distance would be very difficult.
As she was thinking this, Luke’s words came again, but this time it was not asking or saying.
"GO! this is an order." His authoritative shout came, followed by the surrounding air, of 100m diameter suddenly trembling.
As visible cracks appeared among the space, which were filled with void.
Upon this, Theia flinched and backed away before looking toward Luke.
There the black and white lines covering his body increased.
And in this giant state, it was looking even more wrong, because those black lines were connecting like threads to the nearby void.
"Yes, My liege." So she bowed respectfully and disappeared the next moment.
"Hah..." Luke inhaled the air, because earlier due to his anger he lost control and the void power suddenly increased in his body, which resulted in this spectacle.
Fortunately, the sky was taking time in brewing new thunder, which resulted in getting a few breaths of time to relax.
"System, how many more of these lightning attacks will come?" He asked, while looking toward the sky with curiosity.
[There are total 10 lightning strikes in the essence clouds.]
"The fuck!" Luke freaked out upon hearing this. Because even though it seemed he had survived easily, it had consumed a huge amount of Aether.
Which was surprisingly his Cosmic Heart was generating, even though it had not fully manifested.
And currently, it was filling both his Void lines and his consumption of the attack.
So hearing about facing ten of these more, would naturally freak out anyone.
Also the new attacks seemed to be stronger than the earlier one.
[Ahem!] The system coughed, to reduce Luke’s panicking expression and told.
[Even though there are 10, even geniuses have only survived 8 attacks of those. As for 9...]
Upon hearing this he became shocked, but waited for the last part.
[As for 9, even only a few heroes dare to face.]

"Really?" Luke’s mouth fully opened, because heroes were supposed to be the best of the best, at least on lower levels. And now the system was telling him that even only a few dared to face the 9th lightning attack.
So he asked why.
[Well, because the 9th lightning contains the attack power of 1,000 peak Golden Knight essence attacks.]
’ ’ He became completely silent upon this, ’1,000?’
’Seriously?’ He was not freaked out this time, because that was totally absurd.
Of course, if he were a Golden Knight, he would dare to say that even 1 million peak attacks couldn’t do anything.
But surviving using his peak Bronze realm, he knew it would be difficult as ascending to the heavens, unless he found some more methods to counter this.
As he was thinking this, another thought came into his mind.
"If the 9th attack is so overwhelming, what about the 10th lightning?" Hearing Luke’s curious voice, the system glitched for a moment and explained something else to him first.
[Luke, since you are already facing essence, then I will tell you a few things about its property.]

chapters.title: Chapter 231: I’m Literally Being Scammed by Heaven!
paragraphs: Upon this, Luke nodded, as he always wanted to find this, but the system didn’t mention it since it was related to Platinum Knight or B rank.
And told that high-level information was not so good for his mind.
[First, Essence is a higher form of Aether and Mana.]
[Essence can devour Aether/Mana, that’s why it is said that in front of B rank, at least those using Essence, even 1,000 peak Golden Knights couldn’t survive.]
[And regarding not having Essence in B rank, there are many, like your Theia, a Mage. But we will not discuss that here.]
Luke nodded at this. Even though he became surprised about this revelation of Essence, he still waited for the system to finish its words.
[Example, Aether is like steam, then Essence is like water.]
[So you can already see the difference in mass, property, everything, and who is superior.]
Luke gulped and nodded, because the difference was huge.
Though, the system’s next words were nothing compared to this.
[And now peak Golden Knights can use Essence, or fake Essence.]
[Example, if Aether is like fire which is burning at 100 degrees Celsius,]
[then a peak Golden Knight’s attack contains that Essence, which would act like fuel and increase the fire temperature to 1,000 degrees Celsius.]
’Damn, that’s crazy.’ Luke thought with a flabbergasted expression. Because if fake Essence or partial Aether which had been converted into Essence could do this,
’then what the heck can real Essence do?’
And his thinking was answered by the system in the next moment.
[As for Essence, even for fire, it starts at 10,000 degrees Celsius.]
"You are kidding me, right?" Luke’s mouth fell completely, because even for comparison, that was absurd to another level.
Though the system had not planned to reduce his shock.
[Or else, why do you think B rank is the first major hurdle of cultivation?]
The system paused for a moment, before also adding.
[And that’s where basic features come in. When you fight or face a real B rank being, you would face the real terror of B rank.]
[Hell, even if you become a peak Silver, your raw strength and raw Aether quantity after titan transformation would be nothing in front of a real B rank.]
[Since, what can a huge amount of steam do against thousands of degrees of fire?]
Luke nodded with a grim expression, because that was true.
Because for that level, you need at least water, not steam, if the person even wants to counter their Essence.
So thinking this, a bad premonition rose in his heart.
"Don’t tell me?" With wide eyes and open mouth, he asked the system, which confirmed immediately.
[Yes, the 10th lightning is an attack of a B rank being.]
"Well, what can I say." Luke didn’t react to this, because only a freak would face this attack.
And that was the reason none of the previous heroes faced this.
Because they were intelligent. "If it were a peak Silver Knight facing an early Golden Knight as the 10th lightning,"
"then maybe many heroes could try, but facing a B rank being." Luke shook his giant head smilingly.
Even those peak Golden Knight heroes didn’t dare, so how could he do that?
As he was thinking this, another lightning, the 2nd strike came, with the power of two peak Golden Knight attacks.
KRRRZZZT!
Its crackling sound was heard clearly by him, and by everyone who was already trying to reach this place.
Then came the impact sound.
KABOOOOOM!!!
This time the lightning strike created a small mushroom cloud, even though it had nothing related to an explosion.
Though, Nullex again at the last moment had formed those outer edges again, with thicker material this time.
Which resulted in Luke again surviving without any serious wounds.
Only the cracks on his shield had increased from a few cracks to more cracks, which would need more Aether to repair itself.
"Huff!" Luke exhaled after getting hit and used the excess cosmic energy to repair the damage and also repair the shield.
"This breakthrough is a little blessing for me." He muttered with a smile, although his face was bloodied.
Because using Form Assimilation, he could bring only one part, type, or characteristic of another titan.
But right now, his Cosmic Heart manifested due to the breakthrough, and the same went for his void power,
which belonged to Nyx’s titan.
"When do I have the opportunity to merge two or more parts using Form Assimilation?" Luke muttered distantly.
As he got a new titan from Myrkhal after crossing from Iron Knight to Bronze Knight,
but the ability of Form Assimilation didn’t give him anything at the Bronze Knight.
"No point in delving into them." Luke shook his head to remove those thoughts. Then he paused.
"Wait a sec!" His pupils became wide, because right now, he found one glaring issue.
"In novels, those tribulations always gave benefits, right?" Luke paused, and another bad premonition rose in his heart.
"But this tribulation is for Golden Knights to reach Platinum Knights, or becoming B rank!" He looked toward the sky with an aggrieved expression.
At this, the system’s voice also came, [Sadly, Luke you are right. Since you are a Bronze Knight becoming a Silver,]
[your Aether would not convert into Essence.]
[Because Silver Knight bodies are not even strong enough to hold Essence.]
[Even Dragon bodies were not capable of this at Silver rank.]
"So I am getting a beating for nothing?" Luke asked back, because his Silver breakthrough was supposed to be his.
And Valtharion couldn’t say that it was allowing him to reach Silver realm, and that was the price for this tribulation.
[()〔〕) Sadly yes.]
Hearing this, Luke’s mood got even worse, and somehow now he was feeling anger toward Valtharion.
Because he didn’t get any shit benefits from it, and now was facing all types of tests and punishments.
The sky didn’t care about his expression, as they readied the third strike, containing 10 peak Golden Knight power.

chapters.title: Chapter 232: "When Did Master Womanize Another Woman?!" Aurora Thoughts
paragraphs: Aurielle, Aurora, Vaelira and others all felt the thunder vibration even from inside the Time Chamber.
Like the world wanted to announce it to everyone.
"What’s going on?" Aurielle asked the knights who just entered the Time Chamber.
"My lady, near the Stormhowl Mountains, someone is breaking through to B rank." They shouted with urgency.
Because even though the place was far, many powerhouses would soon come to watch this phenomenon,
which could jeopardize the security of Blackstone.
Upon hearing this, everyone’s expression became worried, because they also felt this would happen.
Then, Aurielle felt something was off. "Where is Luke?" So she asked this out loud.
As this major occurrence was going on and Luke as a lord was not here, bringing an uneasy feeling to her.
Hearing her words, others also looked around and found that none of them knew about Luke’s whereabouts.
Seeing this, the uneasy feeling in her heart increased and she immediately headed toward the outside.
Others also saw her expression and followed immediately.
After coming outside, Aurielle could already see the panic state of the maids and knights.
While she could even hear loud voices from the market area.
As many new people were coming into the territory, while even territory adventurers were preparing to go outside.
And the merchants were closing their stalls, because theft could easily occur in this haste-filled environment.
Then she looked toward the Stormhowl Mountains, where huge dark clouds had appeared.
’Luke, please don’t tell me you are there.’ She controlled her trembling hand while trying to stop those ominous thoughts.
After that she summoned her golden chains, but the next instant, her pupils dilated.
"LUKE!" She freaked out, because the direction the golden chain was pointing...
Was toward the same location where the dark clouds had gathered.
She didn’t know why Luke had gone there, but at this moment, she had only one thought in her mind.
’I have to save him.’ In her panic she even forgot that Luke had fought earlier with mid-Golden Knights easily.
So how could she help him?
"My lady, please calm down." Margaret from the side held Aurielle’s trembling body to calm her down.
Because she saw that Aurielle was about to rush there, to the deep part of Stormhowl, where B and even A rank beings resided.
Upon this, Aurora and Vaelira also exchanged a glance and without waiting for anyone, they immediately charged toward Luke’s location.
"I have to go." Aurielle shouted toward Margaret and removed her hand from in front of her worried eyes.
Though, before anyone could even cross the Lord’s estate, a calm voice came.
"No one is going anymore." Theia materialized in mid-air, while looking down at everyone from above.
Aurora and Vaelira instantly paused, before bringing their weapons out.
And looked warily toward the newcomer.
Because just now, they didn’t feel anything when she appeared here, which rang alarms in their minds.
’Space user or higher rank.’ Vaelira immediately calculated the threat level, still she didn’t rashly move.
While Aurora already transformed into Judgment State and was pointing her sword toward Theia.
Theia watched all of this calmly.
Which increased their wariness to another level. Even Aurielle’s earlier panic lessened and she also became wary toward the newcomer.
Though, before she could ask who she was, Theia’s calm voice came again.
"By the order of Liege, none of you can leave this place for now."
Hearing her words, everyone’s expression turned to confusion.
’Who is her liege? and why does that person want to stop us?’
Seeing their confusion, Theia thought for a moment, before announcing Luke’s name.
"Luke Voidheart, the lord of Blackstone and the hero of the Goddess of Light."
Upon this, everyone’s eyes became wide, because that was their lord.
While Aurora blinked in confusion as she looked at Theia.
Then she tilted her head.
"When did Master womanize such a high-ranking, beautiful woman?
She muttered absentmindedly, genuinely unable to remember when Luke had met someone like her.
Which resulted in glares from everyone.
Seeing this, she closed her mouth shut with both hands, but still she was confused as to why she was getting glared.
’After all, master indeed womanized this woman, or else why would she work for him.’ She complained inwardly absently.
And didn’t relate Theia to Luke summoning another unit. Though only Aurielle and Vaelira thought from this angle.
That was why Aurielle stepped forward and said with an authoritative voice.
"Then you should know that I am his wife and you should not stop me."
Hearing her reply, Theia raised her brow slightly with surprise.
Because in her words, she didn’t feel arrogant, which took for granted that she could also command her like Luke.
Rather she asked for not stopping.
Still, Theia shook her head and said, "He has especially mentioned that you should not be allowed to leave this place."
’Damn Luke, you always do this.’ She cursed him in her mind. Because it was not the first time he was doing something dangerous and expecting that his wife would be worry-free and stay in his home.
With that she looked at Theia’s eyes, which clearly stated, no means no.
At this, she gritted her teeth and clenched her fist, then Aurora from the side said.
"Then we could go, right?"
Upon this, Theia turned her gaze toward Aurora, before shaking her head. "No one."
Hearing this, everyone’s expression fell, because they didn’t know what Luke was doing out there.
Which worried them most about their master and lord.
Seeing that nothing could be done, Aurielle asked Theia, "Then you are here to protect him, right?"
She paused after saying this, because her instinct was screaming at her.
*Don’t provoke this woman.*
Which meant that even after her recent breakthrough to Silver Knight and bloodline awakening, she still could not defeat her.
’B rank?’ So this thought came into her mind immediately, and that was why she asked this question.
Because if a B rank would protect Luke, then his safety would be more guaranteed, and then her going or not would not affect much.
But the answer she got confused her. "No."

chapters.title: Chapter 233: I Survived Eight Lightning Strikes... Then Heaven Went Crazy!
paragraphs: Theia calmly stated, without changing any expression on her face.
Though the faces of everyone changed, as she was not allowing them to go and not even going there by herself.
So if their lord needed help, then who would do that?
Theia noticed this, so she added, "My liege has ordered me to guard the area and stop anyone from coming."
She said, but not the full part, ’At least at the last moment, I will go, regardless of whether he becomes angry or not.’
Plus she could also check his condition using her Dream Sight.
Although it was being suppressed near Luke’s area, she could still make out a few pieces of information.
"Are you kidding with us?" Aurielle shouted angrily, because she didn’t know what the problem was with this woman.
As Luke was her liege, so she should protect him, as his life was way more important than some orders.
"Well, I am done here, so all of you sleep." Theia added her final words, before using her dream magic to put everyone present to sleep.
"What!!" Before they could react, everyone fell into a deep sleep.
After that she transferred them inside the mansion, before looking far.
As a few C rank beings were already here, and one or two B rank beings could also be seen at a far distance.
"I hope not many higher levels come." She muttered under her breath, before disappearing.
And the next moment, the path going toward the Stormhowl Mountains from Blackstone was submerged into dream power,
which could easily make everyone lost.
Meanwhile, thousands of kilometers away, Luke’s condition was bad.

His Aether shield had been completely destroyed along with his left hand, and his armor was also shattered in many parts, while Nullex was totally destroyed and was now recovering inside his soul space.

"That was rough..." Luke coughed out a huge amount of blood, but since he was in his titan form, his pain resistance was still high. So even though his body was damaged beyond repair, he was still in the mood for jokes.
"System, what do you think? my chances of surviving the 9th lightning?" Luke asked jokingly, despite the fact that he already knew the answer.
As currently he had survived the 8th strike already, but now his titan body couldn’t keep it up anymore.
Even his supply of cosmic energy was running thin.
The system saw Luke’s expression and then his body, which was now fully covered by crossed lines of black and white.
As a result, his facial expression couldn’t even be seen.
[You have already used your new ability to survive the 8th attack and you know the result by yourself.]
Luke heard the system’s calm words and nodded with a sigh.
*Authority of Primal Awakening* was Myrkhal’s 3rd ability, that was unlocked at Bronze Knight.
With that, he could access the dormant abilities of unlocked titans.
And for Bastion Titan, he got one at Bronze Knight.
⚡ PASSIVE ABILITY: UNBREAKABLE
A simple name, but the effect was absurd.
Even though it was passive, he had to use it at a certain moment due to some limitations.
Like, after using this, he would literally become unbreakable.
Gaining Physical and Energy damage reduction by 80%, also he cannot be knocked back, staggered, or moved against his will during that duration.
"Cool, right?" Luke sighed, because with that came the glaring issue.
Limitation: Speed is reduced by 80%.
Yeah, freaking 80%. So he could not move or at least move with speed.
And because of this ability, he survived the 8th strike without being broken into pieces.
Since essence attack also came into Energy type, which surprised him to his core.
Because this meant he had many tools already to counter B rank beings. It was just that his body was too weak right now.
"Ok, let’s get back to the topic." He stood up with his broken, cracked body, which was not visible because of those black and white lines.
And looked at the sky, where the dark clouds were preparing the 9th strike.
"You sure have become big." He also noticed the size difference of the clouds, since the size of dark clouds kept increasing with each strike.
In the start it was 10km, and now it was already 100km.
Then he looked around, but didn’t find anyone else. "Theia sure is working hard." At that, a small smile appeared on his face.
If anyone saw Luke smiling now, they would think he had gone crazy.
Because this indicated he was not taking the upcoming attack seriously at all, which even only a few heroes dared to face.
[Luke, you know the consumption of Cosmic energy is already high. So are you sure to use that move?]
As he was looking toward the sky, the system’s words brought him out of his thoughts.
Upon this, he nodded, because he was going to use the Cosmic Punch.
But with a different titan.
"Give me your strength, Azrion." Luke slowly whispered the name of the Atlas Titan.
And the next moment, his body reverted back to 25 feet, while hair appeared on his head.
Which was gone during his Bastion Titan.
Though, even the new hair was being covered by black and white lines. So nothing new could be seen on Luke’s body.
"Hah!" He exhaled, before clenching his fist, which was now filled with raw strength.
Earlier, he thought about using Voltarox to use Thunderfall with Cosmic energy.
Sadly, charging an attack of that level would take time, which he didn’t have.
So he chose the second best: the Cosmic Punch.
And surprisingly, the Atlas Titan was more suited for this, even more than Caelith’s form herself.
Which he came to understand later.
During his earlier training, he had tried this in the Time Chamber and was surprised by the result.
Because Azrion’s massive arms could hold the backlash of the Cosmic Punch without using Moons as support.
At that time, even Caelith was surprised, since in their time, other titans couldn’t use their power, so many new methods were not created.
"And this new ability." Luke thought about the unlocked ability of Azrion.

chapters.title: Chapter 234: The 9th Lightning Is Strong—But So Is My Punch!
paragraphs: Which earlier, Myrkhal had told him, that all of these dormant abilities were not only belonging to the titan he held.
Rather, it belonged to the titan who had reached the apex in their species. And he held their faces inside him.
So as always, Luke was not using an average Atlas Titan, but he was using Azrion, the being who stood at the apex of the Atlas Titans.
"Now I understand how broken this SSS rank skill is, or Myrkhal himself..." Luke smiled upon this.
And prepared to counter the strike this time...
With his own attack.
Even though this sounded foolish, but let it be.
"Because my titan body is not strong enough to bear the brunt of a full-fledged attack of 1,000 peak Golden Knights." He muttered with annoyance.
As this was true, so his plan was simple. Using overwhelming force to negate all the damage of the lightning strike, or at least the major part.
While his own body would only face the backlash of his punch.
[You are dreaming, Luke.]
Then the system’s words came, which was kinda true. Because for the plan to succeed, his attack had to be equal to 1,000 peak Golden attacks, or close.
Which seemed totally impossible.
"Or is it?" Luke brought his one hand toward his face and started laughing like crazy.
"HAHAHA!"
Because the move he was trying all depended upon Azrion and his new ability.
[ABILITY NAME] Absolute Strength
[ABILITY TYPE] Ultimate Ability
[DURATION] 10 Seconds
[DESCRIPTION]
Upon activation, the user’s physical power is instantly tripled, granting overwhelmingstrength for a short period of time.
[EFFECT] Physical Power ×3
[WARNING] The effect lasts for only 10 seconds.
Yes, because of this.
As earlier he had noticed that even the titan, doesn’t matter pure or not,
he was getting abilities randomly whenever they unlocked.
Like with Bastion, he got a passive one, while for Nyx, his Shadow of Nyx was also his ultimate.
But Authority of Severance was an authority type.
So he lucked out and pulled the Ultimate ability of Azrion, the Atlas Titan.

Meaning, just think about using Cosmic Punch with 3x! How crazy that sounds, and he was going to do that crazy thing because he was trusting the system’s one-line description of Azrion, the Atlas Titan.
*A body created to carry impossible weight. A Titan whose every muscle, bone, and movement exists for one purpose—overwhelming force.*
"Yeah, since none of his other titans could even pull the Cosmic Punch when it got 3x."
"After all the weight of that punch would be insanely heavy, that even mountains would shatter by the weight alone."
RRRRRUUUUMBLE!
KRRRZZZZZT!
As he was thinking this, the sky roared even more heavily, likely declaring that it was ready.
Ready to show everyone what would happen if they used forbidden power.
"I am also ready." Luke said with a mocking smile, and used Form Assimilation to bring the Cosmic Heart Titan’s heart fully.
THUMP! THUMP! THUMP!
The next instant, it started beating more actively and pushed the black void lines, which seemed to have consumed other white lines.
He also generated a cosmic system inside his body with the leftover energy.
"Cosmos Manifestation." Afterward, he raised his left hand and brought the cosmic system outside.
"It’s time." With that he used the gravity of them to float above and bringing himself toward their front, while they were in a lower position.
So now, Luke was facing the dark clouds above, while being in the center position of the Sky and the cosmic system, below.
"Cosmic Lock!" Another word escaped his mouth, followed by planets, moons, asteroids, and comets aligning in a straight line behind him.
Then he used the overwhelming gravity toward the dark clouds’ center, while also using some to hold his body in the sky.
After that, he generated another cosmic system inside his body, before bringing them toward his right hand as a whole.
Yes, he was completely trusting that Azrion would be able to bear all this weight, even for a few seconds.
And it did.
Though Luke didn’t react to this, just looked toward the dark clouds, while slowly bringing his right hand in a punch gesture toward them, and waiting for the right moment.
The moment when the 9th lightning would descend and he would also strike.
Meanwhile, the goddess of light raised her eyebrow in surprise.
Even though right now she could not see clearly what was going on down there, since Luke was her hero—not completely,
unless he survived the awakening ceremony—
she could still get more information about him, compared to other gods and goddesses.
And currently she could feel that Luke was carrying a weight so heavy that it was impossible to lift, unless he was a peak Golden Knight.
"Fate, do you know why I cannot see through him at all?" So she slowly asked the air.
Because when Luke was summoned, she could clearly see everything about him.
And it was fine, even when she placed the golden chains.
But after one day later, Luke got surrounded with colors she had not seen before.
For which she blamed this on the Origin Titan experiment. Or else it would not make any sense.
Without knowing that it was the system which got attached to Luke and was hiding Luke from everyone’s gaze.
So currently she didn’t know anything about the system and the titans residing inside him.
That was why when Elena awakened, she used her fragment as a blessing to get more information about Luke.
But the answer was the same.
’Nothing.’ So this time, she asked the goddess of fate.
"Don’t know." And that was the answer that came.
At this, she lost in thought, while also waiting for Luke’s result.
If he could survive the 9th lightning or not.
KRRRZZZZZT!
Thousands of arcs of golden lightning began to surge through the dark clouds.
Luke also increased his focus, because each of those lightning contained peak Golden attack.
And he also activated his Absolute Strength, since he knew that the attack would come the next moment.

"I am also ready." Luke said with a mocking smile, and used Form Assimilation to bring the Cosmic Heart Titan’s heart fully.
THUMP!
THUMP!
THUMP!
The next instant, it started beating more actively and pushed the black void lines, which seemed to have consumed other white lines.
He also generated a cosmic system inside his body with the leftover energy.
"Cosmos Manifestation." Afterward, he raised his left hand and brought the cosmic system outside.
"It’s time." With that he used the gravity of them to float above and bringing himself toward their front, while they were in a lower position.
So now, Luke was facing the dark clouds above, while being in the center position of the Sky and the cosmic system, below.
"Cosmic Lock!" Another word escaped his mouth, followed by planets, moons, asteroids, and comets aligning in a straight line behind him.
Then he used the overwhelming gravity toward the dark clouds’ center, while also using some to hold his body in the sky.
After that, he generated another cosmic system inside his body, before bringing them toward his right hand as a whole.
Yes, he was completely trusting that Azrion would be able to bear all this weight, even for a few seconds.
And it did.
Though Luke didn’t react to this, just looked toward the dark clouds, while slowly bringing his right hand in a punch gesture toward them, and waiting for the right moment.
The moment when the 9th lightning would descend and he would also strike.
Meanwhile, the goddess of light raised her eyebrow in surprise.
Even though right now she could not see clearly what was going on down there, since Luke was her hero—not completely,
unless he survived the awakening ceremony—
she could still get more information about him, compared to other gods and goddesses.
And currently she could feel that Luke was carrying a weight so heavy that it was impossible to lift, unless he was a peak Golden Knight.
"Fate, do you know why I cannot see through him at all?" So she slowly asked the air.
Because when Luke was summoned, she could clearly see everything about him.
And it was fine, even when she placed the golden chains.
But after one day later, Luke got surrounded with colors she had not seen before.
For which she blamed this on the Origin Titan experiment.
Or else it would not make any sense.
Without knowing that it was the system which got attached to Luke and was hiding Luke from everyone’s gaze.
So currently she didn’t know anything about the system and the titans residing inside him.
That was why when Elena awakened, she used her fragment as a blessing to get more information about Luke.
But the answer was the same.
’Nothing.’ So this time, she asked the goddess of fate.
"Don’t know." And that was the answer that came.
At this, she lost in thought, while also waiting for Luke’s result.
If he could survive the 9th lightning or not.
KRRRZZZZZT!
Thousands of arcs of golden lightning began to surge through the dark clouds.
Luke also increased his focus, because each of those lightning contained peak Golden attack.
And he also activated his Absolute Strength, since he knew that the attack would come the next moment.

chapters.title: Chapter 235: His Cosmic Punch Shattered the Ninth Strike!
paragraphs: After the activation, his eyes blazed with golden energy, and golden veins bulged all over his body, which even black and white lines could not hide.
At this moment, Luke felt that all of his muscles, bones, and every part of his body was filled with so much strength, that he could literally...
Destroy the world with one punch.
Of course, that was an illusion created by the huge influx of strength, and he also understood this.
So he brought back his full concentration toward the dark clouds, since he had only 10 seconds of absolute strength, or maybe even lower, as his body was not even in perfect condition.
Then it came, and his attack also followed suit.
THOOOOOOOOOM!!!
A colossal bolt combining the strength of all those 1,000 peak Golden attacks descended from the sky, striking toward Luke with catastrophic force.
And with only one objective.
*Erase the forbidden user.*
Luke also roared in defiance and shouted toward the heavens themselves.
"COSMIC PUNCH!"
Then he punched toward the colossal bolt, which anyone would call suicide, because the size difference between the attack was huge.
Like comparing a fly to a truck. So how could Luke’s punch even stop that?
Though, the lightning and Cosmic Punch didn’t stop because of the disparity.
And the instant Luke’s Cosmic Punch touched the colossal lightning, the world seemed to hold still.
As time froze itself.
And then came the result. Not in any form of declaration, but in the form of blinding light.
So bright that it blinded anyone within 100km.
"AHHHH!"
"MY EYES!!!"
Their cries echoed, but no one helped them, since they were also blinded.
While the people coming toward this area also stopped, because they could see this blinding light even from thousands of kilometers away.
Which resulted, that the Diamond Knights, who were waiting earlier for the essence cloud to disperse before checking it out,
immediately flying toward the area.
Since at A rank, everyone got the ability to fly.
Among them included Count Magnus and the demi-human marquis powerhouse who had destroyed the Barrus brothers’ family.
From afar, Theia watched all of this with a worried expression, because earlier she had completely lost vision of Luke’s area.
And now she could feel many new dreams entering her sight.
"I have to stop everyone." Theia muttered with quiet determination before activating her Origin Skill’s Ultimate Ability—Dream Well.
"Let all dreams become reality."
Her voice was soft, yet the moment those words fell, her lustrous purple hair began glowing with brilliant light.
Then her voice suddenly rose.
"DREAM CONVERGENCE!"
BOOOOOOM!
A vast surge of purple dream power erupted from Theia and swept across Luke’s surroundings.
In an instant, the world around him changed.
The land, the sky, and the distant mountains.
Everything within a 100-kilometer radius became enveloped by a mysterious dream world.
Reality itself seemed to blur as countless dreams began manifesting across the landscape.
Yet despite how massive the transformation appeared, it happened in an instant.
Far too fast for ordinary beings to react.
Even those at lower realms had no chance of responding before the dream power swallowed their surroundings.
Meanwhile, after the blinding light...
Came the deafening explosion.
BOOOOOOOOOOOOOM!
The sound alone was catastrophic.
The world-shaking roar spread across nearly 100 kilometers, violently assaulting everyone’s ears and worsening the suffering of those who had already been blinded by the earlier light.
But Luke didn’t care about any of that.
His eyes remained fixed on the sky.
Because his Cosmic Punch had won.
The enormous storm of dark clouds covering the sky for nearly 100 kilometers had been pierced through its center.
A gigantic 1-kilometer-wide hole now existed within the dark heavens, as though something had punched straight through the sky itself.
Even the ninth lightning strike had been defeated.
Yet...
The resulting backlash was something far higher than Luke had anticipated.
The immense shockwave tore through the Cosmic System beneath him.
One after another, the celestial bodies began collapsing.
The asteroids exploded first.
Then the comets.
Then the moons.
And finally even the planet couldn’t withstand the overwhelming backlash.
BOOM! BOOM! BOOM!
One celestial body after another shattered into millions of fragments, filling the Cosmic System with debris.
But even after destroying everything in its path, the shockwave continued.
It descended toward the surface of the Stormhowl Mountains, accompanied by the fragments of the destroyed celestial bodies.
BOOOOOOM!
The mountain surface within nearly a 1-kilometer radius was instantly obliterated.
The earth erupted outward as a devastating shockwave tore through everything in its path.
Trees were ripped from the ground.
Massive boulders were launched into the air.
Hills were flattened.
Even beasts hiding deep beneath the earth were caught in the destruction.
"What is this?!" The newcomers trapped within Theia’s dream domain cried out in panic.
Even though the shockwave had already weakened considerably by the time it reached them...
It was still terrifying.
As Golden Knights were injured by its impact, Silver Knights suffered serious injuries.
And for those below the Silver Knight Realm...
The result was far more brutal.
The moment the shockwave reached them—
Their bodies were torn apart instantly.
The impact caused the side part Stormhowl Mountains to shake violently, as though a high-magnitude earthquake had struck the region.
The tremors spread far beyond the essence cloud region.
Even some slumbering A-Rank beasts within a thousand kilometers were disturbed from their deep sleep.
Their massive eyes opened.
Their instincts immediately sensed the source of the disturbance.
And in their anger, they began charging toward it.
Meanwhile, Luke—the very person responsible for all of this—had absolutely no idea what he had just awakened.
Instead, one thought occupied his mind.
’Seems like I f*cked up.’ He was currently caught directly in the middle of the explosion and the devastating shockwave erupting beneath him.
The backlash from his Cosmic Punch was far beyond anything he had anticipated.
His body was being erased by the overwhelming force.
His hand had already disappeared.
Then his arm.
Then half of his body.
Luke watched helplessly as his flesh turned into dust and scattered into the raging energy.
