chapters.title: Chapter 236: The Birth of a True Titan!
paragraphs: Yet strangely...
His outer frame of black-and-white lines remained completely intact.
Luke stared at his remaining body for a moment.
’Seems like I haven’t completely f*cked up.’
Because earlier when breaking through, he noticed one thing.
That he was becoming a titan, but his human bloodline was getting in the way.
Which resulted in his three bloodlines deciding to rewrite his existence, and rather than metamorphosis,
they chose to transform into a pure titan, of course at a lower level.
At the start he panicked, because being another species completely was so unreal for him.
But later he accepted it, since nothing he could do would save him.
And because of that his body was already getting destroyed from the inside.
Which Luke felt at the 8th lightning strike.
In the start he panicked, because he thought this method was crazy.
So after talking with the system and finding that this was done by his titan bloodlines and they had their own ways,
at that time he accepted the result. Fortunately, his current form was reducing his pain to an absurd level.
That was why he used this crazy move, because he was not worried about his body anymore.
So this brought a new question.
Would he die if his body was lost?
The answer was simple...
A BIG NO!
All this time, his body had not been completely rewritten at all, instead it was in the process of erasure, while those black and white lines were like a cocoon.
A cocoon which would start the creation of his new body.
A Real Titan Body!
While his soul would be left behind and become the center of creation.
Even the system agreed upon this, or else he would have done something else, not this risky move.
But now he was facing a glaring issue. So glaring that his creation of a Titan body could literally stop the next moment.
"The Energy..."
"Huge amount of energy.
Yes, his fake Cosmic Heart, or at least a peak Bronze fake Cosmic Heart, did not have sufficient energy for creating a real Titan body.
Which was born at minimum A rank.
Though his one would be lower, but still it didn’t have enough energy to create a B rank body.
RRRRRUUUUMBLE!
Another rumble followed through the sky, as Valtharion was angry at the audacity to strike back.
So the whole dark cloud suddenly changed color and became red.
A crimson red.
Even the lightning running through them turned crimson, and the previous hole also filled up completely.
"Valtharion, scamming me was the last thing you should do." Inside the cocoon, Luke’s half body smiled, or at least tried.
Earlier when he was getting beaten by Valtharion, Luke thought about how to get benefits from it.
Then he remembered the novels in which the MC devours the Tribulation.
Of course, that was totally an absurd idea. But he had all the tools for that.
Sadly, his tools were different. Like Void could devour it, but it would not give anything to Luke.
So he chose to trust Myrkhal.
Or more like, Myrkhal’s bloodline.
Earlier in the temple, those ancient lamps held fire which was powering the runes of the whole temple.
But Myrkhal, just after a few moments, was able to get that same power, even in his weakest form.
The power of those beings or methods which had even imprisoned the Origin Titan.
And the last gift of Myrkhal was also this new titan, which could use that power.
So he was betting that Myrkhal’s bloodline would command the other two bloodlines in a way that all the energy would be used to create his new titan body.

’Then let’s do it.’ Luke thought with determination, and without wasting any more time, he summoned Valzareth, before using Void Step a few times to appear in the center of the Crimson Essence Clouds.
’I hope this much essence will be enough.’ His consciousness scanned the nearby area, where the surrounding lightning was coming toward him like he was prey.
But this time they were wrong.
Since Luke entered here now as a predator.
Then it happened, the void lines tried to expand to devour the huge essence, because it was its nature.
But Myrkhal’s bloodline controlled it, and allowed his white lines to devour them or convert them into energy required for building the body.
Soon his consciousness started getting heavy, because he was about to go into a deep sleep.
Until his body fully formed.
’I hope Theia will save me.’ That thought came into his mind, because earlier he had sent Theia away for two reasons.
First, to stop everyone, and also Aurielle.
Second, to prevent her from making any rash decisions.
Since he was sure she would stop him the moment he tried this suicide move by entering the essence cloud himself.
And now it seemed he had succeeded in both plans.
That was the last thought that came into his mind, before Luke slept for real this time.
Without knowing that the moment he slept, tendrils of white lines from his cocoon came out.
And immediately covered the whole area of 100km essence clouds, which disappeared the next moment.
Then they reverted back into the cocoon, where the previous clear cross lines of black and white had disappeared.
While countless mysterious symbols in pure white color, not of Caelith’s bloodline, but of Myrkhal’s bloodline appeared on the cocoon.
"My liege!" Theia’s expression changed the instant Luke disappeared from her Dream Sight.
She immediately vanished from her position and reappeared at his previous location.
But Luke was nowhere to be seen.
Instead...
The essence clouds had completely dispersed. Floating in the air was a strange cocoon.
Half white.
Half black.
Mysterious symbols continuously revolved around its surface, emitting an ancient and profound aura.
Theia’s emerald eyes narrowed.
"My liege." She could still sense him.
But before she could investigate further, her expression became solemn.
"They’re here." Theia looked around.
Earlier, she had used her Ultimate Ability to temporarily stall the incoming A-Rank beings.

chapters.title: Chapter 237: Theia’s Desperate Battle to Protect Luke!
paragraphs: Even for her, that had taken a considerable toll.
Now that the essence clouds had disappeared, those powerful beings had become much more serious.
Theia’s mind rapidly raced.
’I need to move my liege.’
’But where?’
She wasn’t certain she could safely transport the strange cocoon back to Blackstone.
And leaving it here was even more dangerous.
She hadn’t even reached a conclusion when—
SHING!
Five crimson claws suddenly materialized beside her.
One claw aimed directly at her heart.
The other four targeted her head, lungs, kidneys, and liver.
Theia’s pupils contracted.
’Ambush.’
Her concentration had been heavily divided while dealing with the A-Rank beings.
She hadn’t detected these attackers approaching.
But now that they had revealed themselves. She immediately recognized their aura.
Five B-Rank Vampires.
Their crimson claws gleamed with murderous intent as they simultaneously attacked her vital points.
Surprisingly, these were the very same vampires who had been sent by Selene’s step-sister and brother to capture Luke.
Earlier, Luke had assumed that the strongest enemies they could send would be Peak Golden Knights.
But he had been dangerously wrong.
Selene’s siblings had already decided to capture Luke at any cost.
That was why they had dispatched actual assassin vampires, while using high-rank artifacts to completely conceal their auras.
Theia, however, knew nothing about this.
And right now, she didn’t even have time to think about where they had come from.
PUCHI!
She teleported at the final moment, barely avoiding the fatal attacks.
But she wasn’t fast enough to escape completely.
Two crimson claws pierced into her side.
Her liver and kidney were punctured.
The five vampires finally materialized, revealing their figures.
They didn’t waste even a second.
Two immediately moved toward the black-and-white cocoon containing Luke.
The remaining three surrounded Theia.
’They’re after him.’ Theia’s expression became solemn.
She was already injured.
After using her Ultimate Ability against the A-Rank beings, she couldn’t fight these five B-Rank Vampires at her full strength.
Worse...
She couldn’t unleash her Arcane magic recklessly.
If one of her attacks struck the cocoon. Luke could be injured or even killed.
’I have to protect him.’ Theia gritted her teeth.
Then she raised one hand.
"Dream Legion."
WHOOSH!
The surrounding dream power surged violently.
Thousands of figures materialized across the battlefield.
Every single one possessed the strength of a Peak Golden Knight—a Peak C-Rank being.
The vampires’ expressions changed.
But before they could react. Theia’s emerald eyes flashed.
"Dream Prison."
The entire area suddenly fell silent.
An invisible force of dream power enveloped the five vampires.
Their movements slowed, along with their consciousness faded.
And within moments...
All five B-Rank Vampires were dragged into a temporary slumber.
Theia didn’t hesitate.
"Attack!"
Thousands of Peak Golden Knights simultaneously raised their weapons.
BOOOOOOM!
And next moments, thousands of Peak C-Rank attacks struck their bodies at once.
Yet when the dust settled. The five B-Rank Vampires remained completely unharmed.
WHOSSH!
Theia didn’t care about this and appeared beside Luke’s cocoon, before grabbing it.
Since he had returned to human size, she could easily hold it.
"Stop!"
Though the next moment, from 100km distance away, where those A rank, the Diamond Knights there,
their shout came, clearly thinking Luke inside the cocoon was some kind of treasure and wanting to take him.
’I can’t let them.’ She hardened her resolve and bit her lips.
Because just now, she felt her dream world was almost about to shatter, while also her mana was running thin.
’These Diamond Knights are so strong.’ This made Theia’s face even more pale.
Which she was right and wrong at the same time. Because Count Magnus had also appeared at the edge.
And his one strike nearly destroyed her ultimate.
At this moment, the vampires almost came out of their sleep state and looked angrily toward Theia.
Because during their sleep, they were shown their worst regrets, pain, and other fears.
So right now their mood was also very bad, and they wanted to kill her first.
Seeing this, Theia didn’t react, instead she urged her Dream Well to help her.
’Dream Well!’
She shouted her ability name in her mind, because just now she felt she couldn’t bring Luke through dream teleportation.
Even though this confused her, she didn’t think further.
The next moment it happened.
The original cracking dream world suddenly strengthened again, but Theia also felt the weakness.
Which she had never faced before.
Even her mana, along with her spirit, had been completely sucked dry, and now she couldn’t use her spells for a few months.
That was the price of overexerting her Origin ability.
Even then Theia didn’t care and wiped away the blood from her lips. For her, saving Luke was now the most important mission.
Then she ran toward the far deep North-West side.
Because her earlier use of ability had trapped the vampires in Dream Prison again. Even the A rank beings were held for a moment.
And that was all she had, which was enough.
Soon she disappeared deep into the Stormhowl Mountains.
"Damn it, where has she gone?" The A rank beings, after freeing themselves from the dream world, shouted angrily, because now they could not feel their presence.
While the five B rank vampires didn’t give up and randomly chose a direction into the Stormhowl Mountains, before entering deep as well.
The three A rank beings, along with Magnus, saw this but didn’t say anything.
Even though the appearance of vampires was suspicious here,
since they were not holding the treasure, there was no need to waste unnecessary time.
So each of them turned their gaze toward the far north, from where those awakened A rank beasts were coming.
"Seems like the treasure is not in my fate." Magnus quietly muttered, before flying back toward his territory.
Among the remaining three Diamond Knights, two exchanged glances, before also returning back.

As he felt that this treasure was related to his earlier search, which he had been finding for years, from the Barrus family.
So without thinking any further, he also headed deep into the Stormhowl Mountains.

’But where?’

And leaving it here was even more dangerous.
She hadn’t even reached a conclusion when—
SHING!
Five crimson claws suddenly materialized beside her.
One claw aimed directly at her heart.
The other four targeted her head, lungs, kidneys, and liver.
Theia’s pupils contracted.
’Ambush.’
Her concentration had been heavily divided while dealing with the A-Rank beings.
She hadn’t detected these attackers approaching.
But now that they had revealed themselves.
She immediately recognized their aura.
Five B-Rank Vampires.
Their crimson claws gleamed with murderous intent as they simultaneously attacked her vital points.
Surprisingly, these were the very same vampires who had been sent by Selene’s step-sister and brother to capture Luke.
Earlier, Luke had assumed that the strongest enemies they could send would be Peak Golden Knights.
But he had been dangerously wrong.
Selene’s siblings had already decided to capture Luke at any cost.
That was why they had dispatched actual assassin vampires, while using high-rank artifacts to completely conceal their auras.
Theia, however, knew nothing about this.
And right now, she didn’t even have time to think about where they had come from.
PUCHI!
She teleported at the final moment, barely avoiding the fatal attacks.
But she wasn’t fast enough to escape completely.
Two crimson claws pierced into her side.

The five vampires finally materialized, revealing their figures.
They didn’t waste even a second.
Two immediately moved toward the black-and-white cocoon containing Luke.
The remaining three surrounded Theia.
’They’re after him.’ Theia’s expression became solemn.

After using her Ultimate Ability against the A-Rank beings, she couldn’t fight these five B-Rank Vampires at her full strength.
Worse...
She couldn’t unleash her Arcane magic recklessly.
If one of her attacks struck the cocoon.
Luke could be injured or even killed.
’I have to protect him.’ Theia gritted her teeth.
Then she raised one hand.
"Dream Legion."
WHOOSH!
The surrounding dream power surged violently.
Thousands of figures materialized across the battlefield.
Every single one possessed the strength of a Peak Golden Knight—a Peak C-Rank being.
The vampires’ expressions changed.
But before they could react.
Theia’s emerald eyes flashed.
"Dream Prison."
The entire area suddenly fell silent.
An invisible force of dream power enveloped the five vampires.
Their movements slowed, along with their consciousness faded.
And within moments...
All five B-Rank Vampires were dragged into a temporary slumber.
Theia didn’t hesitate.
"Attack!"
Thousands of Peak Golden Knights simultaneously raised their weapons.
BOOOOOOM!
And next moments, thousands of Peak C-Rank attacks struck their bodies at once.
Yet when the dust settled.
The five B-Rank Vampires remained completely unharmed.
WHOSSH!

And his one strike nearly destroyed her ultimate.

chapters.title: Chapter 238: Luke’s Mysterious Transformation Is Complete!
paragraphs: Elsewhere, the goddess of light and goddess of fate’s expressions turned to complete shock.
"How is this! even possible!" her voice raised this time, because in the history of Valtharion, this had never happened.
That someone could survive the 10th lightning of Essence clouds.
"And he did this at peak E rank?" She continuously looked toward the earlier essence cloud location, which now had completely disappeared.
"How did he do this?" she muttered with a confused expression. Since she didn’t know that Luke had consumed the essence clouds.
And this question was going into the mind of every other god and goddess present in this world.
"Fate, do you know how?" So she asked the professional, but the answer was not satisfactory.
"Some mysterious symbols are all showing, and nothing more." Her calm voice came, but if the person who knew her heard this,
they would be amazed, because her voice contained faint shock.
"Sigh," At this the goddess of light sighed, with an expression that was hard to tell.
"Everything is going haywire." She muttered while leaning back into her golden throne.
As right now she was worried about whether Luke had awakened the Origin Titan bloodline or not.
But this time, she didn’t ask fate, because even she knew the answer would be "I don’t know."
During this period, many adventurers, solo or with groups, also reached the earlier location of the tribulation.
Only to get disappointment. "We are late."
One old man sighed, seeming to have already anticipated that maybe higher realm people took the treasure before they could even come here.
"Still let’s search around..." He paused before giving a thorough look to the surroundings and completed his words.
"Since even the remains of the earlier event could be worth it." At this, his party members nodded, before starting their search in the hope to get rich and strong.
This same scene was happening throughout the mountains, where different ranks of adventurers and mercenary groups could be seen.
"Luke..." Aurielle looked toward the distant Stormhowl Mountains, with tears in her eyes.
After waking up, they immediately arrived upon the earlier location, only to find nothing.
There was no sign of Luke and the luster purple-haired woman.
Which increased her worry, but fortunately her golden chains that were connecting to Luke were still attached.
And this gave a little relief to her heart.
"Aurielle." Elena muttered softly, worried that Aurielle would take the rash decision of marching straight into the deep Stormhowl Mountains.
Aurielle heard her worried voice and turned to look toward them.
There Aurora, Vaelira, and Elena were all looking toward the distant mountains, with worry in their eyes.
’Hah’, somehow at this time, she couldn’t bring herself to be angry anymore. Earlier she often became annoyed when more and more women started appearing near Luke.
And now these same women were worried about him and her.
’After all, they are part of Luke’s strength... Luke’s army.’ She sighed helplessly, before muttering in a low voice.
"Don’t worry, I am not going there."
Upon this, Elena breathed a sigh of relief, because if something happened to her while Master was away,
then Master would be very sad.
Aurora and Vaelira just looked calmly toward the horizon and surprisingly weren’t rushing there this time.
Which normally they would have done already.
Because they knew they couldn’t guarantee the safety of their lives in the deep mountains and knew that Master would be very sad if something happened to them.
So they were hoping that the earlier woman would protect Master.
’Master please be safe.’ Thus both of them could only pray for his safety.
Then Aurielle gave one last look toward the distant mountains and said to them, "I am sure Luke will return back to me..."
"It is just, I have to wait for him." With that she started walking back toward Blackstone.
Since they had to manage it in the absence of Luke.
Elena, Aurora, and Vaelira also gave one last, longing look toward the mountains, before following Aurielle toward Blackstone.
At another location...
Among the rocky cliffs, a cave was hidden perfectly. Its entrance also closed to make sure nothing could enter unless huge force was applied, which would be enough to alert the inside inhabitant.
The inside of the cave was cold and wet. Also so quiet that you could hear your own breathing.
The walls were rough stone, slippery with moisture and covered in patches of dark moss. While water dripped from the ceiling here and there, hitting the floor one drop at a time.
Drip... drip...
That was the only sound present inside.
Even then a little bit of pale light came through some cracks way up above, but it didn’t reach most of the cave. The corners stayed dark.
The corner, where a cocoon covered with mysterious symbols lay, was completely silent.
Or not anymore.
The oval-shaped cocoon suddenly began to compress, shrinking tightly around the figure within until it clung closely to the body, revealing the outline of a human form beneath its surface.
Then it again became still, like there would be no more movement.
But the person inside didn’t think that.
Because the next instant, something miraculous happened. Rather than the outer shell breaking, it dissolved or became completely transparent.
Until a silhouette of a man became visible.
The man was so handsome, like the universe itself had crafted him. Which could win any maiden’s heart.
"HAAH!"
The man suddenly sucked in a deep breath, his chest rising sharply.
For what felt like an eternity, he had been unable to breathe.
But now—
Air finally rushed into his lungs. So he greedily inhaled again and again, as though each breath was a precious gift.
"Kh—Cough! Cough!" Though, the next moment the man choked because of his fast breathing, which resulted in a rough cough.
But this also broke his sleep, the sleep he didn’t know how long it had been.
"Wh-Where... am I?" These words escaped his mouth, as he used his hand to stand up from the cold stone slab.
But then pain hit him and the man tightly held his head with both hands.
"Ugh!" A low pained grunt escaped his mouth as he shook his head to reduce the pain.
Which after a few minutes later finally calmed down, and earlier memories of the incident also rushed into his mind.
"Seems like I survived." Luke sighed, while trying to steady his breathing.

chapters.title: Chapter 239: Luke Awakened to Find Theia Dying!
paragraphs: Because all he remembered was going into the essence clouds, then a heavy sleep struck him.
"Now where am I?" He muttered while looking around, but then the system window appeared in front of him.
[Luke, you should focus on something important for now.] The system said with its casual tone.
And pointed toward another dark location, where a woman was leaning against the wall.
But her body was badly damaged, as blood could be seen from her rough bandages.
"Theia!" Luke’s eyes became wide, before he immediately moved toward her.
Though the next moment in his haste he didn’t realize his increased strength and the area where his step landed.
BAM!
Shattered the ground and his leg also stuck in them.
"Huh?" Seeing this he became confused, but he still ignored the changes to his body and moved toward Theia, but this time with his strength controlled.
That did help somewhat, as now his legs were making less deep holes in the ground.
"Theia." He called out after reaching her, but she seemed unconscious.
Her usual robes were ripped apart in some places, while her blood slowly came out from her kidney and liver through the bandages.
’System, what happened earlier?’ His expression was totally confused at this moment.
[Well, after you fell asleep, five B rank vampires appeared, so while protecting you she got injured.]
[And she also stopped those A rank beings, but when she overexerted her power, she ended up exhausted.]
He became shocked about the involvement of A rank beings and even more shocked that Theia was able to stop them.
Didn’t matter even for a moment.
But then his face became angry. "Five B rank vampires." He gritted his teeth. As everything went completely out of his calculation.
"They will pay." Luke tried to calm down his anger, then looked worriedly at Theia.
Because from her wound, not only blood was coming out, but some kind of red miasma was also there.
[That’s the essence of a B rank vampire.]
Hearing the system’s words, his expression fell, and an ominous thought came into his mind.
Which the system’s next words confirmed.
[Unless she herself removes them using her mana, or you can also find some talented B rank being or a healer for her.]
[And you can also find an A rank, for them it is too easy.]
Luke gave the system window a speechless look. "From where would I be able to find them?
After that he ignored him, but one thing was bugging him.
"It’s been 20 days and her mana or dream power is still exhausted?" He muttered with confusion.
Or else, why she didn’t heal herself.
[Well, she can’t. Because to escape from the groups of vampires and A rank beings, she overexerted her Origin ability.]
[Resulting in her connection with the Dream Well being severed and even her mana pathways being damaged.]
"What!" Upon this, Luke’s mouth opened wide. "Doesn’t this mean she became crippled?"
Hearing Luke’s panicked voice, the system calmed him down and told.
[Well, for now... Yes!]
[But she is still a B rank, so she needs time, like 2-3 months. Then she would be able to recover by herself.]
[Or you can use the earlier told methods.]
At this, Luke’s worry lessened somewhat. And he brought his hand toward Theia’s face, before gently removing the strands of purple hair.
Her face was covered in sweat, and even her body temperature was high.
"Theia." He whispered her name again, but this time his eyes were filled with gratitude.
Because if she was not there, then he would have died.
"Thank you." He gently caressed her face, before slowly carrying her in a princess carry.
Even at this, her face grimaced, likely feeling deep pain.
"Don’t worry, your liege is here." He whispered those words to calm her down, before bringing her to the stone slab and putting her down gently there.
But just as he was about to let her go, her eyes opened.
"My liege." She slowly whispered those words with confusion.
Because she just awoke, so her mind was still sleepy and her injury also made her vision hazy.
"Yes, I am here, Theia." Luke’s expression brightened seeing her awake.
While clarity also returned to Theia’s eyes and she felt genuinely relieved that Luke was fine.
"Seems like, liege, I can’t help you anymore." She said with a resigned expression.
Because in those 20 days, she tried to heal her wounds, but to no avail.
And with the monsters outside roaming, she couldn’t even move freely with her injured body.
Plus, currently she was only a weak B rank being whose body strength was somewhat higher.
Even that, she couldn’t use properly because of her deep injury.
So she barely gathered some fruits and water to sustain herself, while waiting for Luke to awake.
And now he was fine, she was happy. That even if she died now, she wouldn’t feel sad at all.
"Theia, don’t talk about stupid things." Luke angrily rebuked her, but his voice still couldn’t hide the worry it held.
Seeing Theia was now looking at his blue eyes, he smiled and said.
"Your liege is here, so you don’t have to worry about anything."
"And regarding your injury, don’t worry, I will heal it... Soon."
He finished his sentence while caressing her face.
Upon this, Theia was stunned. Because just now she realized that she was very close to Luke and their bodies were almost touching.
Which brought heat to her face, resulting in a blush forming on her cheeks.
Because as far as she knew, even in her last life, she wasn’t close to any men.
So now getting close to a handsome man...
’Huh? handsome??’ She looked toward Luke again and clearly felt that he was way more handsome than before.
And even his black hair was now shoulder length.
While his height seemed to have increased to 7 feet, following that, his body had become more heavy and muscular.
Of course, not some huge muscles type, but his muscles seemed like inward-growing.
’Did liege go through metamorphosis?’ She thought confusedly, because all the signs indicated that was the most likely answer.
"Theia." Seeing Theia staring so intensely at Luke, he called out her name. Upon which she flinched.
As just now, she realized that she had been staring for a long time at her liege.
"I am fine, master." So without knowing when, she whispered those words, completely forgetting that she had just called Luke ’master’.
But Luke just smiled and nodded at her, before putting her down completely.
After that, he looked around, because now he had to find where they were and also had to decide what to do next.

’Did liege go through metamorphosis?’ She thought confusedly, because all the signs indicated that was the most likely answer.
"Theia." Seeing Theia staring so intensely at Luke, he called out her name.
Upon which she flinched.
As just now, she realized that she had been staring for a long time at her liege.
"I am fine, master." So without knowing when, she whispered those words, completely forgetting that she had just called Luke ’master’.
But Luke just smiled and nodded at her, before putting her down completely.
After that, he looked around, because now he had to find where they were and also had to decide what to do next.

chapters.title: Chapter 240: Luke Discovered the Secret of Titan Cultivation!
paragraphs: [Ahem!]
As he was thinking this, the system interrupted him.
’What?’ He asked nonchalantly, while looking toward the system window.
[You are naked.]
For a moment, Luke just kept staring at the screen, while the system also stared back.
’Did she see?’ So he calmly asked, or at least that’s what it would seem to anyone, except the system.
’And why are you happy?’ He asked with annoyance, before bringing another magical clothes from the system.
Since he had left his spatial ring in the territory before coming for breakthrough.
Upon this, the system didn’t say anything, just showed another weird emoji.
Seeing this, the corner of his mouth twitched and he just shrugged to the system.
’Not a chance.’ He stopped the system’s thoughts.
The thoughts which clearly suggested, "Go make love with Theia."
[Luke, just look at this situation.]
But just as he ignored the system screen, while looking around the cave to find something.
So that he could inspect if some hidden danger was around.
[You and Theia, alone in this cave.]
[Far from the world, far from any distraction.]
[Plus, she also saved you. Then shouldn’t you be a good lord? and teach her the method of being a real maiden?]
’Keep trying system, but I am not going to fall this time.’ He just shrugged and sat down beside Theia.
Who had just fallen asleep, even then he could see the pained expression on her face.
A few moments later, he removed his gaze from her, before checking what he had gained from becoming a real titan.
’System, tell me.’
Seeing Luke’s behavior, the system sighed helplessly. Still, he told him one by one all the new changes.
[First, since you are now a real titan, you can use your previous abilities more freely, without worrying about backlash.]
[Unless you again pull some crazy level move.]
Luke nodded calmly, because he already expected this to happen. So he waited for the system to continue.
[Second, this is also related to the previous one, but in a more explained way. You can now use your titan abilities with more freedom compared to before.]
"Oh, that is good." He smiled upon this, as this meant from now on, the power of his abilities in titan form and normal form would be close.
Of course, the gap still remained, since he was not a complete titan.
Then he asked about the thing which the system had previously declined.
’Will my normal form also be able to use 5x now?’
At this the system paused for a moment, before answering with a calm tone.
[No.]
’Huh?-’
Though, before Luke could ask anything more, the system continued.
[Your titan forms are close to pure titans, not your current form... at least now.]
[That’s why they bring the huge stats buff.]
After saying this, the system also told that since he was now a titan, his base strength had increased, which resulted in his titan form strength also being higher.
’Well, that’s good news.’ Upon this, Luke breathed a sigh of relief. Because this meant he was way stronger than a normal knight, even in human form.
[Now, this brings us to the third thing.]
At this, he didn’t interrupt the system, but listened even more focused. Since he could hear the system’s tone was different this time.
[From now on, you can cultivate.]
As he finished those words, a long silence appeared in the cave.
Because Luke was completely stunned.
He was always told he was talentless, which often hurt him. Even though he knew he could increase his strength with system potions,
but still, not being able to use other resources for faster growth while seeing other people increasing their rank
hurt him, even though he never mentioned or showed it.
[Sadly, you can’t cultivate the knight method anymore.]
As he was starting to feel happy, the system brought bad news.
’What do you mean?’ He stood up and moved close to the entrance with a normal face, while waiting for the system’s reply.
Fortunately, he had developed certain immunities to the system’s bad news. That was why he was able to remain calm.
And surprisingly, even his new titan body was helping in these.
Because from the earlier outburst after seeing Theia’s state, his emotions were in somewhat control.
’Is this related to the titan body?’ He thought absentmindedly, which seemed to be the most logical answer.
As he was thinking this, the system’s previous answer also came.
[Well, in simple terms, Luke, you are now a titan.]
[Even the lowest, the worst kind, which every titan would like to beat, like a punching bag-]
’Come to the point.’ He took back those words about remaining calm after becoming a titan.
Because the system’s annoying personality still irked him.
Though the system still reacted like he did nothing wrong and told him the rest.
[So you are way stronger than a human knight, which is why you can’t follow their cultivation path anymore.]
Luke nodded, because that made sense. Like a dragon didn’t need to cultivate the knight method, since by birth they would be way stronger than a Bronze Knight.
So they would develop their own cultivation methods. Even if every race’s cultivation path made them strong and closed the gap at higher levels,
[Well, theoretically it is true. But in action, the outcome would always be in favor of the higher species.]
Hearing the system’s words, he nodded. Because that was completely true. After that they didn’t discuss this topic anymore, and the system told him about his cultivation.
[Now, you have a choice. Follow some ancient cultivation, titan cultivation, or pure titan cultivation.]
The system presented him the list of ways from which he could cultivate and become strong.
Like ancient methods, belonging to primordial beings. The beings of the start, using their methods he could cultivate.
And then came the titan methods, like beast titans. They eat every type of prey to gain energy for their ascension.
And the last came pure titan, like Void Titan, Cosmic Titan.
For Void Titan, he could absorb energy from the void to become strong, but there was a glaring issue.
Though not one, but more than two.
[Sadly, only pure titans can touch the forbidden element, like Void.]
[And if you dare to touch void with your body, then even with your increased void affinity, the void will erase you.]
Then the system also mentioned that he could not even access the pure void from Valtharion, unless he knew how to open up the dimension or tear apart space.
’Then what about my clone skill? and other skills of Nyx?’ So he asked the question about how his Nyx transformation could use them if there was not any pure void here.
[Ohhh, that’s not pure void. It’s just the passive affinity of Nyx, allowing him to bring some void from space.]
[Resulting in you being able to use those abilities.]
"Damn it." Luke cursed slowly, because this would cross out one way for him to cultivate.

chapters.title: Chapter 241: Luke Wants a B-Rank Beast as a Pet?!
paragraphs: "Seems like cultivation has to wait." He exhaled in frustration. Because he couldn’t even ask Nyx and Caelith, since they were still asleep.
"Well, let’s forget about that." So he removed those thoughts from his mind, before asking the system about his new titan.
Only to get the absurd answer.
[Ahem! Luke... actually, your new titan form is loading, so it will take some time to unlock it.] The system with an embarrassed expression, repeating the same words earlier to Luke.
Upon this, he looked toward the system, with something wrong expression.
"Wait a minute." He paused and remembered that the same words the system had said before.
So before he could say something about being cheated, the system’s defending words came.
[Luke, each new titan came with more power unlocked. So bringing them inside Valtharion is not easy.]
Though the system didn’t mention that if they were not forbidden titans, then he could do it easily.
Plus, he was also bringing those titans from a prison created by some high-level beings.
"I don’t know what to say anymore." So he ignored the system and asked for his daily rewards.
[Well, you have only one reward. Since you had not interacted with your wife in the remaining 19 days.]
And this time he didn’t even need to think, because he really didn’t have any words for this.
Since he always remained near Aurielle, which resulted in a daily supply of rewards.
So now suddenly getting the news that 19 days’ worth of rewards had been wasted, he somehow felt cheated.
"Aurielle, I miss you." So those words escaped his mouth, which meaning no one knew. As he was missing her for real, because she was his wife or because he was not getting any rewards without her.
[So do you want to draw the random reward?] At this, the system also didn’t dare to gaslight him and asked this question.
Hearing this, Luke paused and thought for a moment.
Healing Theia was his utmost priority and next, getting out of this place.
’But the random rewards...’ Thinking about them, he shook his head.
"Unless it’s an emergency, there is no point in drawing them." So he decided to stack charges.
And for the current situation, he would have to explore outside.
Still, before going outside, he gave one last look toward Theia, who was sleeping with a pained face.
"I will be back soon." With that, he summoned Valzareth, before teleporting outside.
Just after Luke teleported, Theia’s sleeping eyes opened suddenly. And her gaze turned toward the place where Luke was standing earlier.
Then she looked down toward her deep wound. But this made her expression sad.
"Seems like I don’t have much time left." She muttered those words with resigned fate.
Even then, one regret remained. ’I couldn’t serve him properly.’
After that, she closed her eyes, hoping to die fast. So Luke wouldn’t have to suffer for her.
’I am sorry, my liege.’
This was her last thought, before she was engulfed into a deep sleep.
But a small drop of tear escaped her closed eyes, which fell quietly onto the ground.
Luke was standing at the peak of a tall tree, without knowing what had happened with Theia.
"I can’t fly here." He looked toward the sky, where the huge shadows of a few beings were roaming around the sky.
Like their playground. Which brought dread to his whole being.

"Then let’s try a different method." He shook his head to remove those huge images and the next moment, his shadow glitched, before 100 other Lukes appeared in the mid-air. And the next instant dropped to the ground with a thud.
"Now, this is called power." Seeing this, a big smile bloomed on his face.
As after his breakthrough, he could now summon 100 clones for a long time. But even then, summoning them for an infinite time was tough for him.
"Go, search everything, without provoking A rank beings." He said those words loud.
Since now, he could face an early B rank being alone and even had huge chances to defeat it.
So with these many clones, he was sure he could face even some high-ranking B rank beings.
But not any A rank.
"What’s the real strength of those beings?" He thought about them, as he had only seen one A rank until now, which was Count Magnus. Even then, he had never seen his strength.
[If those beings fight, then their aftereffects would destroy your body.]
[So pray, that unless you have strength, you wouldn’t see them at all.]
The system intervened and poured the coldest water he got onto Luke’s thoughts.
"I know, I was just thinking." So Luke muttered calmly, without giving any chance for the system to rebuke.
Then he surveyed the area, which was covered with nothing but huge tall trees.
Which could rival even 100-story buildings.
Even the sunlight barely reached here.
"I am not in the endless forest..."
"But this place doesn’t seem less compared to that." He thought about the endless forest description, which stated an endless forest situated underground, filled with only brown-colored trees.
As he was thinking this, one of his clones sent him an interesting piece of information.
"This will do." He muttered slowly, before using Void Step a few times to cross 100km.
Yeah, 100km with a few Void steps. Because now his Void Step range also increased from the previous 1km to 10km.
After coming to the location, he looked at the scene, while hiding behind a huge boulder.
"ROAR!"
There, one early B rank Lion-type beast was fighting against three B rank Deer-type beasts.
"Heh???" Seeing this scene, he felt his worldview shatter.
Because since when did deer get bold enough to fight a lion.
[Luke, this is a fantasy world.] So the system brought him out of his stupid state.
"Ahem."
"I know." He replied with a cough, like the system’s earlier mention was not necessary at all.
Though the system didn’t comment any further.
And kept observing the ongoing fight.
"Hmmm... a lion..." In the start, Luke thought about killing it. But seeing its fighting power, Luke changed his plan.
"My home needs a guardian pet, and you will do." So with that he smiled sinisterly, and the fighting lion suddenly felt goosebumps.
Like some dirty old man wanted to do bad things with it.
So it looked around, but couldn’t find the dirty old man.
But this distraction gave the three injured deer an opening.

chapters.title: Chapter 242: The Lion Fired a Solar Beam at Luke... Big Mistake
paragraphs: Luke observed the ongoing battle calmly.
First, the lion was 30 feet tall, covered with dark golden mane and brown fur all over its body.
But there was something else mixed in there.
"The beast seems fire type." He muttered after noticing its tail end was burning with continuous fire. Which in the case of beasts like apex beasts, the B rank,
showed its element.
Even in earlier realms, faint signs could be seen, but not as clearly as in the apex stage.
While the other three deer were 25 feet tall, covered with their usual orange and brown fur.
But their horns were glowing with cyan light.
"So they are wind type." He nodded thoughtfully, before looking toward the far distance.
For which he had come here, after getting info from his clone.
A small tree, around 20 feet tall, stood in the middle of a pond. Its entire body radiated a brilliant red glow, illuminating the surrounding water with a crimson hue.
Several branches extended from its trunk, and upon them hung a few bright red fruits, each one shimmering with an unusual energy.
"An early B rank treasure." He assessed the situation, before asking the system as well about its effect.
[Even though the fruit has fire element, Theia would be able to digest its energy to heal herself, and with the glow around the fruit, it could also remove the blood essence from her body.]
Hearing this, Luke breathed a sigh of relief.
After that, the system also told him that those vampire attacks contained raw poisonous blood essence, while the fruit’s energy was refined.
Which was the reason for the lion defending it.
"So how much energy do you think all of them contain?" Upon this he asked for another reason.
Because if this fruit could rank up, even a small realm, then it could be sold for another treasure.
[Seeing the number of fruits, if one being digests all of them, then the person would gain around 2% progress in its realm.]
"heh? that’s it??"
"So low..." he muttered the last words with a speechless expression. Because an early B rank treasure was supposed to make more progress.
But the system clarified his doubt, that higher realms need huge amounts of energy to progress and also other factors.
Or else, everyone would have become A rank beings and higher.
The system also added that consuming the same type of resources often diminishes their effects.
"Sigh." Hearing that, Luke sighed helplessly. Because now he was feeling that even his future realm progress would be slow.
Since the system said that from now on, he wouldn’t be able to use Knight potions to rank up.
As he would be doing a different cultivation.
"Whatever, we will see when the time comes." So he ignored those unnecessary thoughts and focused on the fight.
Because during his thinking, all three deer got injured by the lion’s flame claw, resulting in one of the deer horns also shattering.
"This lion sure contains more strength." He commented with a surprised expression. As the lion had already used 2 active abilities, while the three deer only had used one.
[Luke, did you forget something?]
As he was thinking this, the system’s voice came into his mind, which made him confused. ’What did I forget?’
"Ahh." But the next moment, he understood. "Bloodlines."
[Correct.] The system also replied.
Because the bloodline of beasts decides their growth, their potential, and even their chances to mutate.
As he was thinking this, an earth-shaking roar came from the front.
RROOARR!!
"What the f*ck!" Luke cursed, because a huge amount of solar energy, pure golden, had gathered into the mouth of the lion.
Like he was going to use some kind of huge beam attack.
But he cursed, not because of that!
He cursed because that f*cking lion was pointing toward the direction where he was.
So Luke immediately teleported to another place, and the very next moment, the releasing of the beam sound came.
KRAAAAAASH!
He looked behind him, toward the solar beam that had just erupted from the lion’s mouth.
The 10-meter-wide beam tore through the air, warping the space around it from its overwhelming heat.
SHOOOOOM!
In the next instant, it collided with the first deer beast.
The beast didn’t even have time to react.
Its body began melting within a fraction of a second, despite the thick layer of Wind Essence covering its body.
"Gulp."
Luke swallowed hard at the sight.
Yet the beam didn’t stop.
It continued forward with terrifying momentum before finally colliding with the area where he had been hiding earlier.
BOOOOOM!
An earth-shattering explosion erupted.
The ground violently collapsed beneath the impact, forming a massive crater.
The surrounding trees were instantly reduced to ashes, while the nearby stones melted under the overwhelming heat, flowing across the ground like molten lava.
"If that lion throws one or two of these toward Blackstone..." he shook his head to remove those ominous images and looked toward the two injured deer.
Right now, their expressions were also filled with panic, because they never thought to find someone of this level.
Then the lion suddenly let out a thunderous roar.
"ROOOOOAR!"
The sheer force of its voice shook the surrounding forest, making the beasts’ bodies tremble in fear.
They instinctively backed away before turning around and sprinting toward the depths of the forest, desperate to put as much distance between themselves and the terrifying lion as possible.
"Huh? No more fight?" Luke became confused seeing this.
Because even though the lion could bring this level of attack, he was sure that it wouldn’t be able to do that again in a short time.
And this thing should be known to those deer as well, since both of them were B rank, which meant they had certain intelligence.
"Wait a sec." Then suddenly came the important info that he missed earlier.
"They are wind type." He muttered thoughtfully, before looking toward the pond, where fruits containing fire energy were hanging.
So even if they ate, they would definitely get less energy compared to fire elements.
Which resulted in them not betting their lives on this.
Thinking this, Luke let out an annoyed sigh, because none of them were able to injure the lion.
"And it also has some strong bloodline related to fire." Luke rubbed his chin thoughtfully, but the next moment, a big grin appeared on his lips.
"I like it." He said excitedly, because this meant even his territory’s pet would not be average.
If the lion knew Luke’s thoughts, then it would definitely spit not one or two, but tens of those solar beams at him.
Though just as he was about to go, the system gave a small warning.
[Luke, since this lion is still an early B rank, it would not have that special move of B rank.]
After saying this, it also added,
[But still, be careful, because this lion would probably hold some kind of innate skill.]
[And the innate skill of B rank is no joke.]
The system finished its words, on which Luke nodded.
Even though he had complained about the system not having an inspect skill, still, sometimes the system did give some important info.
After that Luke stretched his body and extended one hand toward the lion, a mischievous smile slowly appearing on his face.
"Seems like I have to teach this kitty some manners."
He muttered excitedly, his eyes gleaming with anticipation.

showed its element.

The system also added that consuming the same type of resources often diminishes their effects.

RROOARR!!

KRAAAAAASH!

chapters.title: Chapter 243: His New Titan Body Is Absolutely Ridiculous!
paragraphs: With that he moved toward the Lion with steady steps.
Since it was dirt and soil, the sound of his footsteps weren’t loud. But still the lion heard them clearly.
Growl!
At that, it growled annoyingly, before turning toward the source of the sound.
There a puny human was walking toward it with steady steps, like he was not afraid of it at all.
Roar!
So the Lion roared with a slightly loud voice, to shoo away the little human. Since it didn’t want to waste time killing a weakling.
Luke noticed the lion’s gaze and even its action.
’Seems like, I am getting underestimated because of my size.’ But at this, a big grin appeared on his face.
Then he said calmly.
"Come forth, AZRION."
’The Atlas Titan.’
The next moment, under the shocked eyes of the lion, his body rapidly grew, his muscles bulged to perfection.
And soon, at the place where Luke was standing earlier, a being of 50 feet tall appeared.
Its whole body was perfect, like not a single muscle would waste any movement or energy while performing any actions.
Which was true, since Atlas Titans were known to have perfect muscle control, or else they would not be able to bring every inch of their strength into action.
"Ok, little kitty~"
"Greet your master~"
Azrion Luke playfully said to the Lion, who gave it a speechless look, which clearly said,
"Who are you calling little kitty!"
[Luke, it’s not the expression. The Lion really said that.]
Luke’s steps paused when those words entered his ears, and he gave an interesting look to the Lion.
Because what he heard, that even after reaching certain heights, the lower bloodline beasts couldn’t talk.
And that rule applied to B rank as well.
But since this Lion could talk at B rank, which clearly indicated the purity of bloodlines in its body.
"HAHAHA!" Thinking this he laughed loudly, but the Lion flinched and backed away.
Because even though it seemed a B rank Lion was a being of many years old, this one was different.
"Mom said, always stay away from weird laughing humans."
"Because they are perverts." The Lion thought with a worried expression.
As it seemed, he had encountered the same pervert.
Poor Luke didn’t even know that he had become a pervert in the eyes of Lion.
"So let me teach you!" Luke stopped his laughing and brought his fists together.
"How to respect your master." With that he took one step and the distance between them instantly reduced, before his normal punch moved toward the lion.
The lion saw this scene and got goosebumps, ’I would not survive this.’ So it immediately used its full strength to dodge to the other side.
And the very next moment, a huge impact sound came from its previous location.
BAAMM!
Then it looked toward the back and its eyes turned to horror. ’What the heck monster, am I facing.’
Because, where Luke’s punch landed, a huge crater of 100m wide and 10m deep had formed.
Then came the embarrassing voice from the pit.
"Hahah, Sorry my bad." Luke came out from the pit, where his Valzareth armor didn’t let any dust on him.
"I just broke through, so I couldn’t control my strength." He rubbed his hair embarrassingly.
Like the action he did earlier was some child’s play and now he was asking for forgiveness.
’System, this much strength increase is crazy!’ But inside his mind, he was shouting excitedly.
Because he thought that maybe, with titan and armor buffs, his strength would have reached peak Golden Knight.
But now it seemed he was wrong and it reached early B rank being, in terms of physical strength.
And he was talking about raw power.
So just think, how much Azrion, the Atlas Titan, could draw physical strength from that?
Which he didn’t need to say, as the newly made pit was created by his full force punch of Azrion.
[Luke, I told you earlier. That now you have become a real titan. Even at a lower level, your base strength has increased to another degree.]
Hearing that, Luke nodded. Because he really underestimated his real titan body. But still he asked the difference in strength of different realms, which he never did before.
[Well, here is a basic summary. Iron Knights are ten times stronger than Body Temper.]
[Bronze Knights are 100 times stronger than Iron Knights, and then for Silver Knights, they are also 10 times stronger than Bronze Knights.]
[They are just specials because of their Ascension series art.]
[As for Golden Knights, they are 100 times stronger than Silver Knights.]
[And lastly, Platinum Knights or B rank beings are 1,000 times stronger than Golden Knights.]
’What the f*ck!’ Luke nearly cursed out, but controlled it at the last moment.
Because the system was telling about raw strength and raw amount of Aether and Essence.
So finding the huge disparity, he freaked out earlier.
The system also told, that earlier Luke was beyond normal peak golden knight and he was around 500 times golden knight strength.
After using those crazy moves. then system continued.
[All this is done by Essence, which makes their body so strong that even deep cuts could be healed normally, and if they used Essence, then it would be instant.]

’No wonder, everyone earlier said that for defeating a B rank, another B rank was needed.’ Luke thought, with absurdity, because they could heal any wound instantly and even had more reserves of energy compared to lower ranks.
So the enemy had to block their healing using their Essence.
"Sigh." Thinking all of this he sighed.
Because even though he had overwhelming strength and he could also use Cosmic Heart for nearly infinite supply of energy,
he couldn’t do anything about healing.
’Unless my control over void element increases.’
With that he shook his head to remove those thoughts away. Because if the worst came,
’I would blow hundreds of planets at them.’ Thinking this, the smile returned to his face, which freaked out the Lion again.
’This pervert human wants to do bad things with me.’ The Lion panicked about the suffering it would endure in the future under the hand of this pervert.
So it immediately used its trump card.
’ULTIMATE ABILITY: SOLAR NOVA’
The moment it used this ability, Luke’s titan sense also picked up the danger warning.
Even though it was not extreme, it was there. Like with his current strength, if he were not careful, he could even die.
Feeling this, he became curious. But when he saw the solar core inside the Lion’s chest glowing with intensity,
he immediately used Void Step to teleport away. Because he was no fool to face an ultimate ability burst head-on.

chapters.title: Chapter 244: “Meow...” The B-Rank Lion Finally Surrendered!
paragraphs: ’Well, even though Azrion could bring out more strength than an early B rank, its defenses were not extreme.’ Luke sighed, thinking about how each titan was good at something, but a little lacking in other places.
Of course, overall they were almost perfect. But since he usually depended on stats multipliers, those small differences became huge.
As he was thinking this, a loud air vibration sound came from the lion.
HUMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMM...
Followed by a pillar of golden fire erupting from the ground around 1km area and reaching toward the sky.
BOOOOOOOOOOM!!!
Which destroyed everything in the area. Even the stones present melted to lava, while trees burned to ashes in mere fractions of time.
Seeing this level of destruction, Luke felt goosebumps and when he thought it was over.
But it wasn’t.
WHOOSH! WHOOSH! WHOOSH!
Fire pillars randomly erupted from the ground in the 1km area.
"What the hell?" His mouth opened slowly at this. Because he was sure that if he didn’t have Void Step, he would be inside those areas.
And would also be burning right now.
Though, there was someone else even more baffled than Luke.
’What the heck!’
’How did he reach so far!’ The Lion shouted in its mind. Because this was its domain skill, in which it became twice as strong and the other person was suppressed.
So the lion was betting on this. But now all of that seemed useless.
Luke from the far also noticed this, which brought a mocking smile to his lips.
"Little kitty, I told you to behave!" He shouted toward the depressed lion.
Hearing this, the initially depressed lion felt anger burning inside. And the domain skill was also pushing that anger out.
"Don’t you dare underestimate me." So the Lion also shouted, and the next moment, two huge horns appeared at its head.
’Ember charge.’
After that with one push, it instantly appeared in front of Luke.
"What the f*ck!" Luke cursed out at the sudden appearance, but he still controlled himself and punched out at the Lion’s horns.
And the result?
CRACK!
The huge horns of the lion cracked and broke apart. Then Luke’s giant fist connected with the Lion’s head, where its eyes turned to horror.
Because in its earlier rage, it had forgotten the strength of that punch.
So now it was facing its own karma.
BAAAAMMMM!
The lion’s massive body was blasted backward with terrifying speed.
BOOOOM!
The force tore through the air, creating a violent shockwave as hundreds of enormous trees were ripped apart in its path.
Even after its body crashed through them, it didn’t stop.
BOOM! BOOM! BOOM!
Tree after tree shattered as the lion continued flying backward for thousands of meters.
Only after breaking through thousands of trees did its momentum finally begin to slow.
BOOOOOM!
Its massive body crashed heavily into the ground, sending dirt, rocks, and shattered wood flying in every direction. But after a few moments later, they burned away.
"Huh?" Seeing the scene, Luke let out a surprised exclamation. Not because of his insane strength.
But also because of the Lion’s domain-type skill.
"Even after all of this, its domain is still on." He muttered before teleporting directly near the lion.
"Ngh... Gnh...!"
There, the lion was crying with pain.
Seeing this, Luke got baffled. Because lions were known for their pride, at least in his previous world.
But Luke didn’t know that the lion in front of him was a child.
After getting close, he bent down and asked playfully.
"Little kitty, do you want more beating?"
But this time, the lion didn’t respond in the same way as it did earlier.
Because the pervert human in front of him was too strong.
So while it was grunting in pain and also thinking what to do,
it heard the pervert human’s voice again.
"Look here kitty."
The lion turned toward Luke, where his hand was holding the same fruits which it wanted to eat.
But now, the pervert man was dangling them in front, like it should accept this fruit and become his pet.
Gulp!
Even knowing that this was a trap, the lion looked with longing toward the red fruit.
Because eating it would allow more refining of its bloodline, which could further increase its strength.
As it was struggling with the decision, it saw something from its side eyes which nearly freaked it out.
’Why are there so many pervert humans here!’ It looked around and found that it was surrounded by more than 20 of the same human in its tiny form.
So just thinking if these humans also transformed and started beating it, it became afraid and finally accepted being a little kitty.
"Meow..." Upon this, Luke’s mouth twitched.
Even though he had done this trick knowingly, seeing a lion meowing was a new experience even for him.
"Good kitty." With that, he fed the red fruit to eat, before rubbing its head.
’Finally got one guardian pet.’ As he was smiling thinking this, the system’s ominous words came.
[Congratulations, Luke. You’ve tamed a B-rank beast. I’m sure your wife will be thrilled that you brought home another... creature. 😏]
’It’s a lion, System. Not a woman.’
[I know. I’m just saying, Aurielle might not see the difference. 😇]
At this his rubbing hand froze.
Because that was true.
But then he shook his head and said, ’System, look at its pure eyes and its pure smile.’
There, the lion was chewing the fruit happily, but its huge mane and bloodied mouth with sharp teeth didn’t look cute at all.
[I hope Luke you will survive.] The system sighed with a resigned expression.
[Because, you left Aurielle alone for 20 days, while spending your romantic honeymoon with your new summon.]
After saying that, the system paused for a moment before adding.
[And now, when you will return home, you would bring a huge cat, which is clearly a lion.]
Luke’s face turned worse with each of the system’s words. Because all of them were true.
’I hope I can control her anger and jealousy.’ So he prayed to the Goddess of Luck to make him lucky when he met his wife.
As he was thinking this, his eyes suddenly narrowed, while a dangerous smile appeared on his lips.
Seeing this, the chewing Lion froze and immediately pressed its body to the ground fearfully.
Because now Luke was radiating an intense aura of killing intent.
Like he was going to slaughter an entire race.
"I thought you left." Luke muttered dangerously, because just now, one of his clones sent him news.
That those five vampires were guarding the path of the Stormhowl Mountains which led to Blackstone Highlands.
"It’s fine that you didn’t leave." He muttered again, while his rubbing hand clenched tightly the fur of the Lion in his anger.
Which he didn’t notice, as the lion was wincing in pain.
But it didn’t dare to yelp, as it was afraid to face the wrath of its master.

"Little kitty, do you want more beating?"
But this time, the lion didn’t respond in the same way as it did earlier.
Because the pervert human in front of him was too strong.
So while it was grunting in pain and also thinking what to do,
it heard the pervert human’s voice again.
"Look here kitty."
The lion turned toward Luke, where his hand was holding the same fruits which it wanted to eat.
But now, the pervert man was dangling them in front, like it should accept this fruit and become his pet.
Gulp!
Even knowing that this was a trap, the lion looked with longing toward the red fruit.
Because eating it would allow more refining of its bloodline, which could further increase its strength.
As it was struggling with the decision, it saw something from its side eyes which nearly freaked it out.
’Why are there so many pervert humans here!’ It looked around and found that it was surrounded by more than 20 of the same human in its tiny form.
So just thinking if these humans also transformed and started beating it, it became afraid and finally accepted being a little kitty.
"Meow..." Upon this, Luke’s mouth twitched.
Even though he had done this trick knowingly, seeing a lion meowing was a new experience even for him.
"Good kitty." With that, he fed the red fruit to eat, before rubbing its head.
’Finally got one guardian pet.’ As he was smiling thinking this, the system’s ominous words came.
[Congratulations, Luke.
You’ve tamed a B-rank beast.
I’m sure your wife will be thrilled that you brought home another... creature. 😏]
’It’s a lion, System.
Not a woman.’
[I know.
I’m just saying, Aurielle might not see the difference. 😇]
At this his rubbing hand froze.
Because that was true.
But then he shook his head and said, ’System, look at its pure eyes and its pure smile.’
There, the lion was chewing the fruit happily, but its huge mane and bloodied mouth with sharp teeth didn’t look cute at all.
[I hope Luke you will survive.] The system sighed with a resigned expression.
[Because, you left Aurielle alone for 20 days, while spending your romantic honeymoon with your new summon.]
After saying that, the system paused for a moment before adding.
[And now, when you will return home, you would bring a huge cat, which is clearly a lion.]
Luke’s face turned worse with each of the system’s words.
Because all of them were true.
’I hope I can control her anger and jealousy.’ So he prayed to the Goddess of Luck to make him lucky when he met his wife.
As he was thinking this, his eyes suddenly narrowed, while a dangerous smile appeared on his lips.
Seeing this, the chewing Lion froze and immediately pressed its body to the ground fearfully.
Because now Luke was radiating an intense aura of killing intent.
Like he was going to slaughter an entire race.
"I thought you left." Luke muttered dangerously, because just now, one of his clones sent him news.
That those five vampires were guarding the path of the Stormhowl Mountains which led to Blackstone Highlands.
"It’s fine that you didn’t leave." He muttered again, while his rubbing hand clenched tightly the fur of the Lion in his anger.
Which he didn’t notice, as the lion was wincing in pain.
But it didn’t dare to yelp, as it was afraid to face the wrath of its master.

chapters.title: Chapter 245: “I Am Her Master.” The Vampires Just Made a Huge Mistake!
paragraphs: SirZontax, RedGrace87,
Sadly, each word counts money to everyone. I couldn’t thank everyone each time.
But believe me, your support is the main thing keeping this novel alive.
So thank you so much again.
After that Luke moved toward those vampires, while the previous injured Sunrath was also healed, after eating red fruit.
Yeah the name of the Lion was Sunrath, who was embarked on the path of supremacy, only to get captured by a pervert human.

Luke looked toward the area, where those vampires were hiding. "So these vampires hurt Theia." Luke muttered calmly, but if anyone close to him heard this, they would notice the hidden anger those words held.

"Master, what should I do?" Sunrath from the side asked with a little anticipative voice. Because after his earlier beating, he wanted to show off in front of Luke by beating those blood-sucking bats.
Luke didn’t reply to him, instead he walked slowly toward the vampires, who were hiding behind a few trees and boulders, each separated by 5km apart.
So they could rush to each other’s location easily.
Seeing someone coming, they immediately became alert.
Then they observed the newcomer carefully. Because earlier, they had already killed a few peak Gold rank adventurers who were passing through this area.
Since they didn’t know if the hero could change his appearance or not.
’Is that the Hero?’ But after observing the newcomer, they became confused.
Since the person looked similar to Luke, it was just his height, hair, and handsomeness was on another level.
So they exchanged questioning glances, deciding who would check the person.
"He is coming toward me." Ace said with surprise.
Upon this, the others, Ron, Dan, Max, and Rex also became surprised. Because this meant that the newcomer knew about their location.
"But how?" Which confused them. As they could sense the newcomer’s realm. It was around early Silver Knight.
"Whatever, go kill him." The other four said to him, on which he nodded.
As they were ordered to capture Luke Voidheart alive or dead. If not, then stall him until the 3rd day of Fructus month.
Since it was already 30th day of flora month, they had to present here for two more days only.
So Ace slowly stepped out of his hiding place, without any fear.
Currently he was being arrogant, thinking he couldn’t be harmed by an early Silver Knight.
Luke saw the arrogant behavior of Vampire, but didn’t stop. He also continued walking toward the person with steady steps.
Sunrath watched all of this from afar with a pitying look. Because he could feel that the vampire’s realm was slightly higher than his but still below Mid-B rank.
"Would he survive master’s punch?" He thought with curiosity. Because vampires were tough to kill even if they were not higher rank.
Ace stopped 100m away from Luke and shouted, "Little kid."
At this Luke didn’t stop, but continued walking toward him.
Ace felt annoyed seeing this, still he continued his words. "Did you see two people? One woman with purple hair and one man around 6 feet tall, with the same color as your hair and eyes..."
At the last words, he paused and felt something was wrong.
Because from the moment he had met this newcomer, he felt he couldn’t see through him. Which should be impossible.
Since he was a B rank, while the person in front of him was only a D rank.
As he was thinking this, Luke stopped 1m away from him. Then while looking down straight into his eyes, he said calmly.
"If you are talking about the purple-haired woman with green eyes..." After saying that, he paused. At which Ace became annoyed.
’What’s wrong with this person?’ He thought with irritation, but still he waited.
Waited for him to finish. Then he would finish him.
"Yeah, I saw her-" With that he brought his face close to Ace, whose eyes were little red, mixed with black, and his short white hair had a few strands hanging down.
"After all, I am her master."
Hearing this, Ace’s eyes became wide, while alarm rang in his mind. ’Danger.’
Though before he could react or understand why, a black sword penetrated deep into his kidney.
"Ugh..." His eyes went wide with horror, not because Luke was able to hurt him, which should be impossible.
But due to his injury.
Because he felt that the kidney where the sword pierced wasn’t healing at all, even with his body using blood essence.
The same essence, that held the power to even bring back a person who was at death’s door.
Then Luke’s voice came again, but this time it was cold.
"You attacked her there, right?" Luke asked with a cold face, while also rotating his sword to increase his pain.
"Ahh!" Ace grunted in pain, but still, instead of retaliating, he immediately backed away.
Seeing this scene, the other four vampires also appeared beside Ace and gave wary looks toward Luke’s weapon.
Because they didn’t know how the sword could injure Ace.
Of course they would never be able to find out. Since Luke used Authority of Severance.
Earlier at Bronze realm, he could only use physical severance.
But now, he could use energy severance as well.
That was why he was able to injure Ace’s B rank body without transforming into a titan and also cut the energy supply toward his kidney region.
The result, his kidney was not getting any essence at all. Even his vampire regeneration was struggling.
"Phew..." Luke exhaled to calm down his anger.
Which he didn’t know, when took control of him.
’Because Theia got injured while protecting me?’ He shook his head to remove those thoughts and transformed into Atlas titan.
"Azrion ascension." Those words calmly escaped his mouth, but the result was far from calm.
Soon, under the same reaction which Sunrath had felt, the five vampires saw Luke’s transformation into a 50-foot tall muscular giant.
Seeing this, only one question came into their minds. ’Since when! was he able to become so huge?’
And that was not the only thing that bugged them.
’B rank strength?’ Ace and the others exchanged wary looks, because Luke’s giant form was exuding B rank pressure, as its whole body contained huge amount of raw power.
Then Ace shouted toward Luke.
"Even though we don’t know why your body is exuding B rank raw power..." He paused after this, and the next moment, his body started glowing as well.
And the other four bodies also followed suit.
"But you are going to die today."
"Vampire Lord Arts."
"BLOOD LORD’S DOMINION!!!"
They shouted at the same time, and the very next moment, their bodies dissolved into pools of blood.

chapters.title: Chapter 246: They Summoned an S-Rank Being?!
paragraphs: And from that, huge pillars of blood rose which combined together to form a blood giant of 50 feet in height.
The blood giant face contain only two crimson glowing eyes without any mouth, while the whole body was made up of pure blood, which constantly flowed throughout the whole body.
Soon five blood giants appeared in front of Luke. Each power also increased by 10 times.
Sunrath got worried seeing this. Because he never expected that the vampires had an ascension series that even seemed high level.
But Luke didn’t care about Vampire’s new size. So with his Nullex armor on, he charged toward them.
BAM!
His punch collided with Ace’s blood giant, resulting in a huge hole forming there.
Which the next moment closed, trapping Luke’s hand in between them.
"Gotcha." Ace smiled smugly, but since his face had no mouth, it didn’t appear on his face.
The other four blood giants, seeing this, summoned their crowd control ability to trap Luke.
"Blood Prison." Their voices came out in sync, followed by thick blood chains released from their bodies.
Which one by one bound Luke’s hands, legs, shoulders, and even his face.
"Hah!" They forcefully pulled the blood chains toward them. While Ace used his third move of Vampire blood arts.
"Blood Tide Wave."
He raised his hand, and the next moment, a huge amount of blood released from his body and gathered above his head.
Then in a swift motion, he brought his hand down. Which resulted in the huge amount of blood also coming down toward Luke like a tidal wave.
"Master..." Sunrath whispered worriedly seeing this scene, but didn’t dare to go himself.
Since even he didn’t expect those vampires to be so strong. So he was hoping that Luke’s other clones would appear soon.
But his worry was for nothing.
"Solar burst."
Luke whispered calmly, but the result?
BOOOM!
A huge wave of solar flare burst from his body, which shattered all the chains before they vaporized.
Then it blasted Ace backward, who was close to Luke. Even after that, it didn’t stop, but collided with the other four blood giants.
Who rather than facing this attack head-on, chose to dodge.
BOOM!
So the solar flare collided with the ground and trees, resulting in another explosion, followed by insane burning that reduced them to ashes and lava.
"Now it feels good." Luke muttered while stretching, because those chains were a little uncomfortable.
On the contrary, the expressions of the four blood giants and the half-burnt Ace were full of horror.
’How the heck did he become so strong suddenly?’ And this question rang in their minds.
Seeing their expressions, Luke smiled calmly.
Because from the start, Luke knew that these vampires could use blood attacks and they also had insane regeneration.
So his physical attack would be futile. That was why he needed energy attacks.
For that he had Myrkhal’s transformation or his Authority of Severance.
But he came to notice that Authority consumes a huge amount of stamina. Or maybe because he was using it against B rank while being D rank.
Which came down to his new cosmic bodies.
A dwarf red star.
’Caelith’s cosmic system is sure great.’ Luke thought with satisfaction. Since currently inside him was rotating a complete solar system.
In which a dwarf red star rotating in the center, while 10 planets of different elements orbited in disc formation.
And then, each planet had 100 different element moons orbiting them.
Followed by thousands of asteroids and comets at the outer orbit, circling the solar system in disc formation.
Each of his previous celestial bodies had multiplied by 10.
So now his strength also increased.
’But the most interesting thing is this sun.’ Luke thought with little anticipation, before raising his right hand toward the sky.
"Cosmos Manifestation." The moment those words escaped his lips, the whole cosmic system came out above Luke.
"What!!!" Seeing the scene, the pupils of everyone present, from Sunrath to the vampires, turned to horror.
Especially for the vampires.
Even though they didn’t fear sunlight like some low-level vampires, but they did take special damage from anything related to light.
Which was the reason for the earlier huge damage.

And now, Luke had summoned an entire fucking 1km wide red fireball above, which was followed by 500m huge 10 boulders, and surrounded them were the 100m small boulders. As for the last small objects, forget about them.
"Master is so strong." Sunrath muttered with an excited expression. Since he was an inferno lion, he could feel the fire element most.
"If I can summon that huge fireball, mom would be so happy." He thought with happiness. As he decided he would ask Luke to teach him.
Teach him how to create that fireball.
For that he even thought about how to behave like a good kitty.
Which was a comical scene.
A lion thinking of behaving like a kitty.
Luke and the vampires didn’t know what was going on in Sunrath’s mind.
Even if they knew they wouldn’t care, since the vampires were already feeling the hot intense light from that red fireball.
"We have to do that." So Ace muttered with an ugly expression. Because currently even their essence wasn’t working properly.
And the result, their blood giants wouldn’t heal at all.
So the other four also exchanged glances, before remembering the orders of the royal prince.
"Do whatever you can, to capture or cripple the hero."
"If not, then kill him."
Thinking about that, they nodded to each other.
Because what they were about to do was a forbidden technique. After that, they would die for sure.
Then they shouted, their voices came in perfect sync.
"From the veins of a hundred lords, a king is born."
Once those words were spoken, their giant blood bodies again melted into pools of blood.
Before flowing toward each other.
Slowly they combined to form a large blood pool.
Then came the last sentence, from the blood pool.
"Behold the Blood Monarch’s Descent."
CRACKLE!
The sky crackled with crimson lightning, as someone was summoning a high rank being from afar.
But due to the huge distance, the being couldn’t descend.
Though it didn’t even want that. Instead the being sent his little consciousness and also the power toward the blood pool.
As this was happening, Sunrath’s eyes widened to the extreme, because he knew what this power was.
"Law." Those words escaped his mouth.
As on Valtharion, only King tier, S rank beings and above could use law.
