paragraphs: But seeing that the real body had not descended, he breathed a sigh of relief.
However, he was still worried about Luke. Because even though those vampires wouldn’t be able to use law,
their realm could touch mid-B rank being.
Meanwhile, the surrounding area of the Stormhowl Mountains, which had a few days of peace, suddenly again erupted in fear.
As any being lower than B rank sensed that power, they immediately ran far away from it.
While a few A rank beings which were residing in the deep of Stormhowl Mountains just gave a curious look before letting it be.
After all, they weren’t foolish enough to provoke an S rank being.
Luke also looked above with curiosity.
Because when those crimson lightning appeared in the sky, even his dwarf red star seemed to struggle with burning.
Though after a few moments it became normal.
Then, from the sky, a small bolt of crimson lightning came down and collided with the blood pool.
KRRRRAAAAAAK!!!
The deafening sound was very high, even Luke felt numb in his ears, which returned to normal a few seconds later.
"Oh?" But when he looked toward the front again, he saw a 100-foot tall blood giant had appeared.
With four blood hands, each holding different weapons of sword, halberd, bow, and spear appeared.
On the blood giant’s head, a king’s crown could also be seen.
Which he didn’t know if it was done by the earlier power or if this form had a king’s crown already.
As these thoughts crossed his mind, the blood giant asked a question.
"Who are you?"
Upon this, Luke became surprised. ’Aren’t this blood giant is the earlier five vampires?’
Then he thought something else. "Blood monarch."
The blood monarch heard Luke’s voice, but he didn’t answer. Instead he asked again, but this time even more clearly.
"You can’t be Hero Luke Voidheart."
"Since that person couldn’t hold this much power."
Luke heard everything calmly. But it didn’t matter much to him. if the person was the blood monarch or not.
Since today these five vampires would die for sure. And he would make it true.
"Even earlier heroes weren’t this powerful." He finished his words, before pointing all of his weapons toward Luke and repeated his question again.
"So, tell me."
"Who are you."
Hearing this, Luke brought a mocking smile to his lips and slowly returned back to his normal form.
Though the solar system stayed in the sky without any sign of instability.
Seeing this scene, the Blood Monarch became confused, but then Luke’s voice came.
"I am your death."
Upon this, the Blood Monarch got stunned and one thought came into his mind. ’Does he not know who I am?’
’Or does he not know about the terror of Law being?’
But Luke didn’t give him more chance to think, before uttering the name of the new titan.
Which he got from Myrkhal after his breakthrough.
[Colossar — The Colossus Titan
The Ancient Lore:

Those who witnessed him described the same vision—a mountain of crimson flesh, so vast that his head was barely visible above the horizon of his own shoulders. Veins like rivers of molten blood pulsed beneath his skin. Muscles like mountain ranges rippled with every breath. His body was not forged from stone or metal. It was living flesh—so dense that even divine weapons could not pierce it.]
"Existence yields before my form."
"Colossar, awaken."
The very next moment, his body rapidly expanded and grew.
In an instant, a 100-foot-tall flesh-covered mountain took shape.
His enormous thighs were thick as pillars, maintaining nearly the same width all the way down to his legs, giving his massive body an overwhelming sense of stability.
His chest and stomach were equally monstrous—barrel-chested and impossibly broad, covered in dense layers of muscle that looked like walls of flesh.
Yet compared to his enormous torso and legs, his head appeared surprisingly small, making his gigantic physique look even more intimidating.
The Blood Monarch narrowed his eyes, because even among the few beings at D rank he had seen, none were this huge.
But Luke didn’t stop with this, instead he used a new ability of Myrkhal.
Yeah, the fourth ability. Which he had unlocked after breakthrough.
[Fourth Ability : Form Fusion]
"The Faceless Titan remembers what it means to be whole."

Unlock Realm: Silver Knight
Titan: Myrkhal, The Faceless Titan
Description:
The Faceless Titan was never meant to be fragmented. Its true nature was unity—the ability to fuse countless lineages into a single, perfect existence.
Now, as the wielder grows stronger, that forgotten power awakens.
Form Fusion allows the user to merge two unlocked Titan Faces into one, gaining the full physical characteristics, abilities, and stat multipliers of both.
The resulting form is not merely a combination—it is a new existence, born from the perfect union of two lineages.
After reading this, he could say only one thing, ’Myrkhal never disappoints.’
Then he activated Form Fusion.
[Form Fusion Activated]
Fusing: Atlas Titan + Colossar Titan = Atlas Colossar Titan (The Titan of Absolute Strength)
Synchronization: 100%
Stat Multiplier: 5× + 5× = 10×
Size: 50 ft + 100 ft = 150 ft
Abilities Unlocked:
-Absolute Strength...
[Error-]
[The user is holder of SSS+ rank Origin Skill, Nexus Titan.]
[Allow full use of every ability.]
Abilities Unlocked:
-Nyx (The Void Titan) [ALL]
-Caelith (The Cosmic Heart Titan) [ALL]
-Myrkhal (The Faceless Titan) [All form transformation abilities could be used.]
The moment he merged two forms, a long list of new data appeared in front of his eyes.
But Luke just read the starting part and didn’t dwell on the rest, since his body transformation had already occurred.
So under the shocked gazes of Sunrath and the Blood Monarch, his body grew again.
But this time, his muscles changed as well, becoming far more defined and powerful.
The previously barrel-shaped chest and pillar-like legs of red flesh gradually transformed into a far more balanced and perfect physique.
His entire body continued expanding.
Until finally...
A 150-foot-tall Titan stood before them.
Its appearance was unmistakably similar to the Atlas Titan, yet everything about it had been magnified to a monstrous scale.
"Nah, not enough." He muttered with disappointment, while clenching his fist.
Because even with all these, he felt a barrier, which divided mid B rank from early B rank.
The Blood Monarch heard Luke’s words and felt that he should beat this cocky brat.
Because Luke already had increased his strength so much without using law power, which should not supposed to be possible.
And here he was saying it was not enough.
Though Luke didn’t know his thoughts, and even if he knew, he wouldn’t care.
’Descend Elythos.’ He called upon Caelith’s armor, which appeared the next moment.

Luke heard everything calmly.

Since today these five vampires would die for sure.
And he would make it true.
"Even earlier heroes weren’t this powerful." He finished his words, before pointing all of his weapons toward Luke and repeated his question again.
"So, tell me."

chapters.title: Chapter 248: The Blood Monarch Just Met a Cheat Character!
paragraphs: Soon his whole body got covered by shiny golden armor.
Then he felt the strength, which could even shatter small planets.
[Current Stat Multiplier: 5× + 5× = 10× multiply (3×) = 30×.]
Of course this was an illusion created by a huge surge of stats multipliers. But still it was broken.
’So those stats multipliers have no limit.’ Luke thought with a surprised expression, as he clenched his fist.
Which created a shockwave of enough strength to destroy normal hills.
But the next moment he shook his head. ’This body couldn’t bear this for long.’
Yeah, even his new form fusion body couldn’t handle the influx of huge stats multipliers.
As he was thinking this, the Blood Monarch shouted with a voice that was shocked beyond the core.
"You that’s..."
"IMPOSSIBLE!"
His bloodied giant face was filled with horror. Because now he could feel that Luke’s body was exuding mid-B rank aura.
Which couldn’t be done by his early D rank cultivation at all.
At this, Luke just smiled. "I know."
Then he tilted his giant head. "I am just a cheat character."
The Blood Monarch didn’t understand the words, but he didn’t dare to wait any longer or wonder who this person was anymore.
Since they had already formed a feud with this person, Luke knew he couldn’t leave any possibility of future trouble.
He had to erase his existence here, once and for all.
"Blood Dragon."
He shouted the words as he raised both hands toward the sky.
The next moment, the surrounding blood energy surged violently upward.
ROOOOAAAR!
A gigantic 1-kilometer-long blood dragon materialized in the sky.
Its body resembled a colossal flying serpent, formed entirely from condensed blood energy, as it twisted through the clouds and released a terrifying pressure over the battlefield.
"Futile attempt."
Luke muttered with mockery.
The Blood Monarch’s face twisted in anger. Even though he couldn’t use his full power with this body,
being looked down upon by a D rank didn’t sit right with him.
Though the next moment, he shut his mouth, which was just about to rebuke.
Luke used Form Assimilation to bring the Cosmic Heart and replace the Atlas Colossar Titan’s heart with that.
Which immediately started pumping a huge amount of cosmic energy throughout his body.
Then Luke lazily raised his right hand and activated Elythos’ Cosmic Construct ability.
"Cosmic Dragon."
The moment those words escaped his mouth, the inside cosmic energy surged.
BOOOOOOM!
A colossal 1-kilometer-long Eastern Dragon materialized in the sky.
Its enormous body wasn’t made of flesh or energy.
Instead, it was forged from solid materials, resembling a living construct made from rare metals and other precious cosmic materials.
At the tip of its mouth, a small red solar core burned intensely.
Yet that tiny core contained terrifying power.
Crimson solar flames constantly flowed across the dragon’s body, wrapping its metallic scales in the blazing fire of a Dwarf Star.
The enormous Eastern Dragon slowly opened its eyes.
HUMMMMM...
The surrounding air began to distort from the sheer heat radiating from its body.
"Go." He said with an already victorious expression.
While the Blood Monarch’s face turned ugly, since he could feel that the dragon created by Luke held much more power than his creation.
’From where is he getting that much energy?’ So he thought confusedly.
Sadly for him, no one was there to answer him.
As these thoughts crossed his mind, both dragons collided...
No, they didn’t collide.
Instead, the moment the blood dragon got close to Luke’s dragon, it vaporized from the red solar core.
"Damn it." Seeing this, a curse escaped his mouth, but the eastern dragon didn’t care about the vampire’s curses.
Since its new target was him.
The Blood Monarch also noticed this, but he didn’t retaliate with attacks.
Considering the weird way of Luke’s attack, he knew that none of his attack could harm him or win against his attacks.
Which confused him, ’He definitely isn’t using essence, then how?’
This question’s answer even Luke didn’t know. Because it was recently that he had come to understand a little bit of his own titan power.
Since all the beings on Valtharion used aether, then essence, and so on.
Luke thought that his titans were also using the same.
Which he came to understand earlier, that it was wrong.
Because people used aether to imitate certain elements, while essence was even close to imitation.
But his energy? Like Void and Cosmic energy, they were different.
As even at their lowest purity, they were real, not an imitation. It was just diluted to the extreme.
So Luke didn’t have to imitate fire to create a fake fire.
Using his Cosmic energy, he could literally create real fire. Which his dwarf red star also contained.
That was why Caelith was known as a forbidden titan. Because this was creation power.
Sadly, he would need more time to understand this.
Luke didn’t look toward the Blood Monarch, who was going to die anyway.
Instead he looked straight toward the sky. There he felt Valtharion was watching him.
’The Valtharion doesn’t seem to have any work.’ His mouth twitched with annoyance.
Because the moment he used Form Fusion, Valtharion was glaring daggers at him.
Like, "you created another forbidden thing." Which was true.
Since he created an entirely new species.
"That’s why I didn’t use a large-scale attack." Luke muttered toward the sky, to Valtharion.
Or else, he would directly use his solar beam.
A beam released by his Dwarf red star.
BOOOOOM!
The sound of the explosion brought his attention back.
There, the eastern dragon had exploded, before taking down the Blood Monarch.
"Seems like it’s over." Luke muttered without much change in expression.
Maybe because the vampires he killed were already dead the moment they used this forbidden technique of merging.
Or summoning this Blood Monarch.
So he killed someone else.
After that he returned back to his original form, while the cosmic system also returned to his body in the form of cosmic energy.
But just then, as he was about to check the remains of the Blood Monarch, he heard a heavy voice.
"This time, you survived, Hero."
The voice echoed through the battlefield, filled with murderous intent.
"But next time, when you face my real body..."
A pause.
"YOU WILL DIE!"
BOOOOOOOM!
A massive blood-red explosion erupted, instantly swallowing the surrounding area.
But Luke had already reacted.
The moment he sensed the attack, Valzareth materialized over his body, covering it in its Void Armor.
Then—
WHOOSH!
Luke teleported far away from his original location, narrowly escaping the center of the devastating explosion.
"Guessed you would do this." He said with a mocking smile. Though no reply came.
"Even next time we met, I will be superior to you." He calmly muttered, before sending one clone toward the remains to inspect.
Which didn’t get anything.
"Tch!"
"Poor bastard." Seeing this, Luke cursed him and his rank.
Before he moved toward Theia with Sunrath the kitty, who was wagging his lion tail continuously.
’Will Theia like this kitty?’ So this thought came into his mind.

chapters.title: Chapter 249: Theia Is Dying, and Luke Has One Way to Save Her!
paragraphs: After travelling half an hour, Luke reached the cave location.
"You stay here." He said sternly to Sunrath, clearly warning him not to run.
"Meow~" Sunrath meowed, wagging his tail. Clearly he didn’t have any intention of running.
Hell, now even if Luke wanted him to run away, he wouldn’t.
Seeing he was behaving properly, Luke teleported inside the cave.
"Theia." He called out her name, and moved close towards the stone slab.
But even after his calling, Theia didn’t respond.
Seeing this he got worried and brought his hand to check her condition.
’So cold.’ After touching her forehead, Luke became more worried. Because even after his touch, she was not opening her eyes.
’Please be safe.’ So while suppressing those ominous thoughts, he felt her breath with his hand.
"It’s low, but it’s there." He breathed a sigh of relief upon this. Then Luke shook her body gently.
"Theia, wake up." But even after that, he didn’t get any response.
’System, what’s happening?’ With no option left, he asked in confusion.
[She seems to have fallen into a deep sleep because of the blood poison.] The system pointed toward her kidney and liver wounds.
And told him that if he didn’t remove that poison, then she could fall into a coma.
"I want to heal her."
"But how?" He looked toward the fruit in his hand and then toward the deep-sleeping Theia.
Because even if he tried to feed her, she wouldn’t able to eat. And the same was with the fruit juice.
As he was thinking what to do, the system sighed with inevitability.
[Sigh.]
"What?"
Hearing Luke’s confused and slightly irritated voice, the system told him the only solution.
The solution of *affair*.
[Luke, you have to feed her mouth to mouth.]
[??! Just do it Luke! what’s with this speechlessness?]
But Luke remained standing in silence. Because the system said mouth to mouth feed. Then why the heck was he showing some weird, wrong meaning emoji!!!
[Sigh. Luke it’s time for you to become a man.]
"I am already a man."
The system ignored Luke’s words and continued.
[All the good times, you tried to be an loyal husband. Even though you already lost your first time with other wives.]
"That was not necessary to mention."
[And now it’s time for you to become a good lord.]
Hearing this, Luke again looked toward his hand, where the red fruit was shining with a red glow.
[Then toward Theia’s lips, which were also shining with a red glow...]
"Hey! that’s not what I was thinking!" Luke complained to the system, who instead of reading his thoughts, said those words by himself.
But still, he swallowed after seeing Theia’s lips.
"System, why does Theia look more attractive than my other summons?" So he asked this question, which had been bugging him the entire time.
As he noticed that he somehow felt more attraction toward Theia rather than Aurora and Vaelira or even Elena.
Of course they were beautiful, but compared to Theia, their charm was reduced by a large margin.
[Well, there are many factors...] The system paused after this, before explaining in simple terms.
[But the main things are.]
[First, she is a B rank being. Which I had told you earlier. That each higher realm brings a person toward perfection. Doesn’t matter if it’s about strength or looks.]
[So even if you don’t accept it, her beauty has already reached the level of some queens.]
[Second, she saved your life, so definitely you feel closer to her.]
[Third, your bonding with her as a summoner.]
[Fourth...]
[You!]
"Me?" Luke got stunned upon this. As he didn’t understand what this meant.
Seeing Luke’s confusion, the system cleared his doubt.
[Because, now you are a real titan.]
[As human beings tend to be loyal to their love partners. Which was even more true in your case, since you are from the modern world, where polygamy doesn’t exist.]
Luke nodded at this, because that was the truth. That was why he always felt something was weird when he suddenly got five wives.
[And those golden chains connecting to your hearts also amplify your emotions...]
[Especially towards your five wives.] The system mentioned this again, but didn’t tell him why.
Because if he wanted to find the answer why, then he had to find the Goddess of Light herself.
Luke touched his heart, where five golden chains were still binding. But this time, something was different.
"Huh? why are my end chains coating with symbols?" He asked in confusion.
[And that’s related to you being a titan.]
Still, Luke didn’t understand why it was related to him being a titan.
Since he couldn’t identify the symbols on the chains.
Which were the same mysterious symbols that formed upon his cocoon. As he was in deep sleep at that time.
So the system told him this and also other things.
[That’s why your pure titan lineage was trying to break those chains.]
"WHAT!" Luke’s eyes became wide, because breaking these chains meant he and his wives would die.
Even though after the chains broke, everyone would get 1 year to live, but still, this was crazy.
[That, you have to see...] The system didn’t clarify this part, but still gave him reassurance that these chains wouldn’t break soon.
Hearing that, he breathed a sigh of relief.
"At least I have time."
Then the system told him that after becoming a real titan, his mindset and emotions were changing slowly.
At which he agreed.
[That’s why, now your titan instinct wants you to mate with other powerful beings, so you can continue your lineage.]
After that, the system also added that since Theia was the only opposite sex present here and even a beautiful one,
that was why Luke felt more attracted toward Theia right now.
"Hah..." Hearing all this, he sighed with complicated emotions.
"So from now on, my body would crave more sex?" He asked while caressing Theia’s cheek worriedly.
[Unless you complete your bloodline.]
[Yes.]
Luke nodded at the system’s words. Which meant that before reaching a higher rank, his urges would often create problems for him.
"I can’t lose her." He whispered slowly, before taking a small bite of the red fruit.
After chewing it a few times, he brought his lips close to Theia’s lips.

Seeing this he got worried and brought his hand to check her condition.

And told him that if he didn’t remove that poison, then she could fall into a coma.
"I want to heal her."
"But how?" He looked toward the fruit in his hand and then toward the deep-sleeping Theia.
Because even if he tried to feed her, she wouldn’t able to eat.
And the same was with the fruit juice.
As he was thinking what to do, the system sighed with inevitability.

Hearing Luke’s confused and slightly irritated voice, the system told him the only solution.
The solution of *affair*.

Just do it Luke! what’s with this speechlessness?]

Because the system said mouth to mouth feed.
Then why the heck was he showing some weird, wrong meaning emoji!!!

"That was not necessary to mention."
[And now it’s time for you to become a good lord.]
Hearing this, Luke again looked toward his hand, where the red fruit was shining with a red glow.
[Then toward Theia’s lips, which were also shining with a red glow...]

But still, he swallowed after seeing Theia’s lips.

As he noticed that he somehow felt more attraction toward Theia rather than Aurora and Vaelira or even Elena.
Of course they were beautiful, but compared to Theia, their charm was reduced by a large margin.
[Well, there are many factors...] The system paused after this, before explaining in simple terms.
[But the main things are.]
[First, she is a B rank being.
Which I had told you earlier.
That each higher realm brings a person toward perfection.
Doesn’t matter if it’s about strength or looks.]
[So even if you don’t accept it, her beauty has already reached the level of some queens.]
[Second, she saved your life, so definitely you feel closer to her.]
[Third, your bonding with her as a summoner.]
[Fourth...]
[You!]
"Me?" Luke got stunned upon this.
As he didn’t understand what this meant.
Seeing Luke’s confusion, the system cleared his doubt.
[Because, now you are a real titan.]
[As human beings tend to be loyal to their love partners.
Which was even more true in your case, since you are from the modern world, where polygamy doesn’t exist.]
Luke nodded at this, because that was the truth.
That was why he always felt something was weird when he suddenly got five wives.
[And those golden chains connecting to your hearts also amplify your emotions...]
[Especially towards your five wives.] The system mentioned this again, but didn’t tell him why.
Because if he wanted to find the answer why, then he had to find the Goddess of Light herself.
Luke touched his heart, where five golden chains were still binding.
But this time, something was different.
"Huh? why are my end chains coating with symbols?" He asked in confusion.
[And that’s related to you being a titan.]
Still, Luke didn’t understand why it was related to him being a titan.
Since he couldn’t identify the symbols on the chains.
Which were the same mysterious symbols that formed upon his cocoon.
As he was in deep sleep at that time.
So the system told him this and also other things.
[That’s why your pure titan lineage was trying to break those chains.]

Hearing that, he breathed a sigh of relief.

At which he agreed.

that was why Luke felt more attracted toward Theia right now.

[Yes.]
Luke nodded at the system’s words.
Which meant that before reaching a higher rank, his urges would often create problems for him.
"I can’t lose her." He whispered slowly, before taking a small bite of the red fruit.
After chewing it a few times, he brought his lips close to Theia’s lips.
